meaning: 只读存储器;只读存储器

examples.en: The old game came on a ROM cartridge you slotted into the console.
examples.zh: 这款老游戏装在插进游戏机的ROM卡带里。

meaning: n. 奖章获得者

examples.en: The Olympic medallist visited our school and showed us her gold medal.
examples.zh: 奥运奖牌得主来我们学校展示了她的金牌。

meaning: a. <澳新俚>完全不讲章法的,混乱的, 无组织的

examples.en: Rafferty borrowed our tent for the weekend camping trip.
examples.zh: 拉弗蒂借走了我们的帐篷去周末露营。

meaning: n. 分娩的痛苦, 阵痛, 辛劳;vi. 发生阵痛, 辛劳

examples.en: She wrote a memoir about the travail of building a business alone.
examples.zh: 她写了一本回忆录,讲述独自创业的艰辛。

meaning: n. 偏爱, 偏袒

examples.en: The coach was accused of favoritism after picking his own son.
examples.zh: 教练选了自己的儿子,被指责偏心。

meaning: n. 印度教

examples.en: Our world religions class began with a unit on Hinduism this week.
examples.zh: 这周我们的世界宗教课从印度教单元开始。

meaning: 杜威

examples.en: Dewey filed the old reports by date in a dusty binder.
examples.zh: 杜威把旧报告按日期归档到积灰的文件夹里。

meaning: n. 短纵梁

examples.en: Carling poured tea for everyone while the meeting ran late.
examples.zh: 会议开到很晚,卡琳给大家倒了茶。

meaning: vt. 含蓄着, 内涵着, 意味着

examples.en: In many cultures, white candles connote peace and quiet remembrance.
examples.zh: 在许多文化里,白蜡烛意味着安宁与静思。

meaning: n. 法国马赛市

examples.en: They took a slow train from Paris down to Marseille.
examples.zh: 他们乘慢车从巴黎南下到马赛。

meaning: n. 罗马甜瓜

examples.en: She cut a ripe cantaloupe into cubes for the morning fruit salad.
examples.zh: 她把熟透的哈密瓜切成块,拌早晨的水果沙拉。

meaning: a. 天使的, 天使般的

examples.en: The twins looked angelic in their matching white dresses.
examples.zh: 双胞胎穿着同款白裙子,显得像小天使。

meaning: n. 非犹太人, 异邦人, 非伊斯兰教徒;a. 非犹太人的, 异教徒的, 非摩门教徒的

examples.en: Her Gentile neighbors joined the family's Passover dinner every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天,她非犹太教的邻居都会来参加家宴。

meaning: n. 萨克斯（汽车零配件生产厂商）

examples.en: Sachs will present the budget report at Thursday's meeting.
examples.zh: 萨克斯将在周四的会议上做预算报告。

meaning: 梅尔罗斯(美国马萨诸塞州东部一城市)

examples.en: They strolled along Melrose Avenue window-shopping on a sunny afternoon.
examples.zh: 晴朗的下午,他们沿着梅尔罗斯大道逛街看橱窗。

meaning: a. 侏罗纪的, 侏罗系的;n. 侏罗纪

examples.en: The boys love the Jurassic dinosaur exhibit at the natural history museum.
examples.zh: 男孩们喜欢自然历史博物馆的侏罗纪恐龙展。

meaning: a. 没有得到通知的, 未被告知的, 无知的, 不学无术的, 未受教育的, 蒙昧的;未被告知的, 未得通知的, 无知的

examples.en: Voters made an uninformed choice because the debate was canceled.
examples.zh: 辩论被取消了,选民们做出了不明就里的选择。

meaning: a. 有设立权的, 有制定权的, 组成的, 基本的;n. 要素

examples.en: The teacher argued that practice is constitutive of real language learning.
examples.zh: 老师认为练习是真正语言学习的基本组成部分。

meaning: n. 田鼠, 大满贯;vi. 赢得大满贯, 全胜

examples.en: A small vole darted across the hiking trail this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上,一只小田鼠飞快地跑过远足小径。

meaning: n. 布特尔（英国英格兰西北部自治市）

examples.en: Grandma grew up in Bootle before the family moved to London.
examples.zh: 奶奶在布特尔长大,后来全家搬到了伦敦。

meaning: 过滤

examples.en: The app is filtering spam messages before they reach your inbox.
examples.zh: 这个应用会在垃圾短信到达收件箱前进行过滤。

meaning: n. 双簧管

examples.en: She has played the oboe in the school orchestra since September.
examples.zh: 从九月起,她就在学校管弦乐团吹双簧管。

meaning: interj. 再会, 再见, 干杯

examples.en: Cheerio, then; see you at the pub on Friday night!
examples.zh: 那就再见啦,周五晚上酒吧见!

meaning: n. 叮当声;v. (使)发叮当声

examples.en: We heard the clink of glasses from the kitchen during the toast.
examples.zh: 敬酒时,我们听见厨房传来杯子的叮当声。

meaning: n. 获得成功的人

examples.en: Mia is a high achiever who balances schoolwork and swimming.
examples.zh: 米娅是个学业游泳两不误的优秀学生。

meaning: n. 重碳酸盐;碳酸氢盐; 酸式碳酸盐

examples.en: The recipe uses bicarbonate of soda to make the batter rise.
examples.zh: 这份食谱用小苏打让面糊膨胀起来。

meaning: 安定药, 镇定药

examples.en: The vet gave the anxious dog a mild tranquilizer before the flight.
examples.zh: 兽医在飞行前给焦虑的狗用了温和的镇静剂。

meaning: vt. 剥夺...的席位, 使失去资格, 使退位, 罢免, 使去职, 使退职

examples.en: The scandal threatened to unseat the mayor before the fall election.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻可能让市长在秋季选举前下台。

meaning: n. 食人者, 吃同类的动物;a. 食同类的, 吃人肉的

examples.en: The horror movie is about a cannibal who haunts a remote cabin.
examples.zh: 这部恐怖片讲的是出没于偏远小屋的食人魔。

meaning: n. 肝硬化;硬变; 肝硬变

examples.en: Years of heavy drinking left him with cirrhosis of the liver.
examples.zh: 长年酗酒让他患上了肝硬化。

meaning: vt. 使成为数字, 使计数化, 使数字化;数字化

examples.en: The library plans to digitize its collection of old handwritten letters.
examples.zh: 图书馆计划把馆藏的旧手写信件数字化。

meaning: n. 小发明, 小玩意儿

examples.en: Dad bought another kitchen gizmo that promises perfect boiled eggs.
examples.zh: 爸爸又买了个号称能煮出完美鸡蛋的小玩意。

meaning: n. 大叫, 呐喊, 一点点;vi. 叫喊, 鸣叫

examples.en: The kids let out a whoop when the fireworks began.
examples.zh: 烟花开始时,孩子们发出一阵欢呼。

meaning: a. 可到达的, 可得到的

examples.en: Set attainable goals, like reading ten pages a day.
examples.zh: 设定可实现的目标,比如每天读十页书。

meaning: 神经元; 轴索; 脑脊髓轴(罕用)

examples.en: Each neurone in the brain connects to thousands of others.
examples.zh: 大脑里的每个神经元都连接着数千个同伴。

meaning: n. 显微镜使用, 用显微镜检查, 显微镜学;显微镜检查

examples.en: Using powerful microscopy, the researchers watched the cells divide in real time.
examples.zh: 借助强大的显微技术,研究人员实时观察细胞分裂。

meaning: n. 超速行驶

examples.en: A speeding car nearly hit the cyclist at the corner.
examples.zh: 一辆超速汽车在拐角处差点撞上骑车的人。

meaning: n. 花彩;vt. 结彩于

examples.en: They festoon the hall with paper streamers before every school dance.
examples.zh: 每次学校舞会前,他们都会用纸彩带装点礼堂。

meaning: n. 转世化身, 再生

examples.en: Grandma jokes that her cat is the reincarnation of an ancient king.
examples.zh: 奶奶开玩笑说,她的猫是一位古代国王转世。

meaning: a. 分类学的, 分类的;分类的

examples.en: The scientist gave a taxonomic description of the newly discovered beetle.
examples.zh: 科学家对这种新发现的甲虫做了分类学描述。

meaning: n. 传感器（传感元件, 探测设备）

examples.en: Sen's research on famine changed how economists think about poverty.
examples.zh: 森关于饥荒的研究改变了经济学家对贫困的看法。

meaning: n. 娜塔莎(亦作Natascha)(f.)

examples.en: Natasha keeps a small garden on her apartment balcony.
examples.zh: 娜塔莎在自家阳台上打理一个小花园。

meaning: n. 助手, 副官;a. 辅助的

examples.en: The colonel's adjutant typed orders late into the night.
examples.zh: 上校的副官连夜打印命令。

meaning: 布兰多； 布兰多

examples.en: Brando rehearsed his lines until the director finally smiled.
examples.zh: 布兰多反复排练台词,直到导演终于笑了。

meaning: v. 畏惧( fear的过去式和过去分词 ); 为…忧虑（或担心、焦虑）; 敬畏（神等）; 感到害怕

examples.en: The feared examiner turned out to be a kind old man.
examples.zh: 那位令人畏惧的考官原来是位和善的老人。

meaning: n. 氰化物;vt. 用氰化物处理

examples.en: The detective found traces of cyanide in the empty teacup.
examples.zh: 侦探在空茶杯里发现了氰化物的痕迹。

meaning: n. 灌肠剂;灌肠法, 灌肠剂

examples.en: The nurse explained how the enema would be administered before the scan.
examples.zh: 护士解释了扫描前如何进行灌肠。

meaning: n. 放射疗法;放射疗法, 放射治疗

examples.en: After surgery, he started six weeks of radiotherapy at the city hospital.
examples.zh: 手术后,他在市立医院开始了六周放射治疗。

meaning: n. 瞪羚

examples.en: Ariel hung the laundry out before the rain arrived.
examples.zh: 艾莉尔赶在下雨前把衣服晾了出去。

meaning: a. 带蓝色的

examples.en: The evening sky turned a soft bluish gray over the harbor.
examples.zh: 黄昏时,港口上空变成了柔和的蓝灰色。

meaning: a. 巴拉汀伯爵的, 在领地内行使王权的, 腭的, 宏伟的, 壮丽的;n. 巴拉汀伯爵, 宫廷官吏, 毛皮围巾

examples.en: The dental student studied the palatine region in anatomy class today.
examples.zh: 这位牙科学生今天在解剖课上学了腭部区域。

meaning: a. 内源的;内生的, 内原的

examples.en: Economists debated whether the growth was endogenous or driven by exports.
examples.zh: 经济学家争论增长是内生的还是出口驱动的。

meaning: n. 横档, 横楣, 横梁;气窗, 门顶窗, 光窗

examples.en: Sunlight streamed through the small transom window above the office door.
examples.zh: 阳光透过办公室门上方的气窗照了进来。

meaning: n. 婆罗双树, 盐;盐

examples.en: Sal keeps the workshop keys on a red lanyard.
examples.zh: 萨尔把车间钥匙挂在红色挂绳上。

meaning: 农地

examples.en: The drought turned much of the region's cropland into dust.
examples.zh: 干旱让该地区大片农田变成了尘土。

meaning: abbr. 直接存取情报（Direct Access Information）

examples.en: Dai folded paper cranes for the wedding decorations.
examples.zh: 戴为婚礼装饰折了纸鹤。

meaning: a. 对立的, 正相反的

examples.en: His messy desk is antithetical to his tidy, careful personality.
examples.zh: 他凌乱的书桌与他整洁细致的性格截然相反。

meaning: pron. 任何事

examples.en: You never get owt for nowt, my grandfather always said.
examples.zh: 我祖父常说,天下没有白得的东西。

meaning: n. 知更鸟

examples.en: Ruddock fixed our leaking roof in a single afternoon.
examples.zh: 拉多克一个下午就修好了我们漏水的屋顶。

meaning: n. 马里

examples.en: Mali is famous for its ancient mosques built of mud brick.
examples.zh: 马里以泥砖建造的古老清真寺闻名。

meaning: a. 数值的, 数字的;n. 数, 数字

examples.en: Please enter a numeric password with at least six digits.
examples.zh: 请输入至少六位的数字密码。

meaning: n. 核武器, 核电厂, 原子核;vt. 以核武器攻击, 把...打垮

examples.en: Just nuke the leftovers for two minutes before you eat.
examples.zh: 吃之前把剩菜用微波炉热两分钟就行。

meaning: n. 结构主义者, 结构语言学家

examples.en: The structuralist critic analyzed the folktale as a system of opposites.
examples.zh: 结构主义评论家把民间故事当作对立系统来分析。

meaning: n. 安托瓦内特(f.)

examples.en: Antoinette bakes a fresh loaf of bread every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 安托瓦内特每个周日早上都烤一条新鲜面包。

meaning: n. 夸克;夸克

examples.en: Physicists say a proton contains three quark particles bound together.
examples.zh: 物理学家说,质子由三个结合在一起的夸克组成。

meaning: 奥斯曼(1259-1326, 奥托曼 Ottoman 帝国的创建者)

examples.en: Osman rides his motorcycle to the bakery before dawn.
examples.zh: 奥斯曼天亮前就骑摩托车去面包房了。

meaning: n. 衬裤, 短衬裤

examples.en: Pack extra underpants and socks for the summer camp trip.
examples.zh: 去夏令营要多带几条内裤和袜子。

meaning: n. 入店行窃;冒充顾客进入商店行窃

examples.en: The teenager was fined for shoplifting candy from the corner store.
examples.zh: 那个少年因在街角商店偷糖果被罚款。

meaning: n. 奥古斯塔（美国一城市名）

examples.en: Augusta spends every August canoeing on the quiet northern lakes.
examples.zh: 奥古斯塔每年八月都在北方安静的湖上划独木舟。

meaning: a. 有缺口的, 用碎片组成的

examples.en: He drank his coffee from a chipped blue mug this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上用一只缺口蓝杯喝咖啡。

meaning: a. 书目有关的, 书目的

examples.en: Each chapter ends with a bibliographic list for further reading.
examples.zh: 每章结尾都附有供深入阅读的参考书目。

meaning: n. 阻止的人, 木塞, 制止器;vt. 用塞子塞住, 闭嘴

examples.en: Push the rubber stopper firmly into the laboratory flask.
examples.zh: 把橡胶塞紧紧塞进实验室烧瓶里。

meaning: n. 麻疯病患者, 受蔑视的人;麻风病人

examples.en: In old times, a leper was forced to live outside the village.
examples.zh: 古时候,麻风病人被迫住在村子外面。

meaning: a. 形式的, 样式的, 形态上的, 模态的;模态的

examples.en: Should and might are modal verbs that show possibility.
examples.zh: should和might是表示可能性的情态动词。

meaning: n. 阿月浑子树, 阿月浑子果实, 淡草绿色

examples.en: She sprinkled chopped pistachio nuts over the ice cream dessert.
examples.zh: 她在冰淇淋甜点上撒了碎开心果。

meaning: n. 电解物, 电解质, 电解液;电解质

examples.en: Athletes drink electrolyte solutions to replace salts lost through sweat.
examples.zh: 运动员喝电解质饮料,补充出汗流失的盐分。

meaning: n. 剥皮, 剥下的皮;去皮, 脱屑

examples.en: He was peeling potatoes for stew while the radio played.
examples.zh: 他一边听着广播,一边削土豆准备炖菜。

meaning: a. 与...有关的, 有所指的;参考的, 参照的, 指示的

examples.en: The poem's referential lines point clearly to the poet's childhood.
examples.zh: 诗中带指涉的诗句清楚地指向诗人的童年。

meaning: n. 蚯蚓

examples.en: An earthworm wiggled across the sidewalk after the morning rain.
examples.zh: 早上下雨后,一条蚯蚓在人行道上蠕动。

meaning: n. 骗子, 魔术师;骗子, 欺骗者

examples.en: In the old folk tale, a clever trickster outwits the greedy king.
examples.zh: 在古老的民间故事里,聪明的骗子智胜了贪婪的国王。

meaning: v. 将…切成小方块, 切成丁( dice的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: She diced the onions and threw them into the hot pan.
examples.zh: 她把洋葱切成丁,扔进了热锅。

meaning: adv. 舒适地, 整洁干净地, 紧密地

examples.en: The baby slept snugly under a thick woolen blanket.
examples.zh: 婴儿裹在厚毛毯里,睡得暖暖的。

meaning: 帝汶岛(马来群岛中一岛)

examples.en: Timor has beautiful reefs that attract divers from around the world.
examples.zh: 帝汶有美丽的珊瑚礁,吸引世界各地的潜水者。

meaning: abbr.European Free Trade Area 欧洲自由贸易地域;abbr.European Free Trade Association  欧洲自

examples.en: Norway belongs to EFTA while trading closely with the European Union.
examples.zh: 挪威属于欧洲自由贸易联盟,同时与欧盟密切贸易。

meaning: n. 关厂, 停业, 被关在外面的人, 不让对方得分;退关, 闭厂, 停业

examples.en: The goalkeeper earned a shutout in her very first professional game.
examples.zh: 守门员在职业首秀中就完成了零封。

meaning: a. 辗压的, 辊轧的, 轧制的

examples.en: She rolled the dough thin and cut circles for the pies.
examples.zh: 她把面团擀薄,切成圆形做馅饼。

meaning: 波形

examples.en: The technician checked the waveform on the oscilloscope screen.
examples.zh: 技术员检查了示波器屏幕上的波形。

meaning: a. 拉脱维亚的;n. 拉脱维亚人, 拉脱维亚语

examples.en: My Latvian neighbor taught us a song in her native language.
examples.zh: 我的拉脱维亚邻居用母语教了我们一首歌。

meaning: n. 构造, 形态, 完整的配置;构象

examples.en: The judge examined each horse's conformation before the show began.
examples.zh: 比赛开始前,裁判检查了每匹马的体格结构。

meaning: 俾斯麦(Otto von, 1815-1898, 德国政治家, 德意志帝国第一任首相)

examples.en: Bismarck unified the German states in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 俾斯麦在十九世纪统一了德意志各邦。

meaning: a. 绝好的, 极妙的;快速原子轰击离子源

examples.en: The hotel got fab reviews online, so we booked it.
examples.zh: 这家酒店网上好评如潮,我们就订了。

meaning: v. 播种, 产卵；大量生成（spawn的现在分词）

examples.en: The salmon return to this river for spawning every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天,鲑鱼都会回到这条河产卵。

meaning: n. 蜡杆, 蜡烛架

examples.en: A brass candlestick stood at each end of the long table.
examples.zh: 长桌两端各立着一只黄铜烛台。

meaning: n. 长老住宅, 长老, 区会, 教区, 司祭席

examples.en: The meeting of the presbytery was held in the stone chapel.
examples.zh: 长老会议在石头小教堂里举行。

meaning: a. 资金不足的

examples.en: The underfunded school could not afford new science equipment.
examples.zh: 这所经费不足的学校买不起新的理科设备。

meaning: a. 生有羽毛的, 柔软如羽毛的

examples.en: The feathery leaves of the fern brushed against our ankles.
examples.zh: 蕨类羽毛般的叶子轻扫着我们的脚踝。

meaning: 自动信息输入系统

examples.en: Ames drives to the coast whenever he needs to think.
examples.zh: 每当需要思考,艾姆斯就开车去海边。

meaning: vt. 使相等, 补偿;vi. 相等

examples.en: The striker managed to equalize in the final minute of play.
examples.zh: 前锋在比赛最后一分钟扳平了比分。

meaning: a. 公爵的, 象公爵的, 公爵领地的

examples.en: They wandered through the ducal palace and its painted gardens.
examples.zh: 他们在公爵宫殿和彩绘花园里漫步。

meaning: v. 出售, 从事贩卖

examples.en: Street vendors vend fresh coconut water along the beach road.
examples.zh: 海滩路上,小贩们叫卖新鲜的椰子水。

meaning: adv. 绝妙地; 极好地; 令人震惊地; 使人目瞪口呆地

examples.en: The resort sits on a stunningly beautiful bay with turquoise water.
examples.zh: 这家度假村坐落在美得惊人的碧绿海湾旁。

meaning: n. 自治市

examples.en: The old Scottish burgh holds a summer festival every July.
examples.zh: 这座古老的苏格兰自治镇每年七月举办夏日节。

meaning: n. 麦克阿瑟(美国五星上将)

examples.en: Macarthur led his troops through the difficult Pacific campaign.
examples.zh: 麦克阿瑟率领部队经历了艰难的太平洋战役。

meaning: 染色法, 染色

examples.en: The biologist is staining the cells to see them under the microscope.
examples.zh: 生物学家正在给细胞染色,好在显微镜下观察。

meaning: vt. 在...上长满, 长得太大使...不适用;vi. 长满, 长得过大

examples.en: Weeds will quickly overgrow the garden if you stop weeding.
examples.zh: 一停止除草,杂草很快就会长满花园。

meaning: a. 安置好的, 安居的;v. 舒服地坐( ensconce的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: Grandpa was ensconced in his armchair with a detective novel.
examples.zh: 爷爷窝在扶手椅里,读着侦探小说。

meaning: n. 用香料按摩

examples.en: She studied aromatherapy and now blends oils for tired office workers.
examples.zh: 她学了芳香疗法,现在为疲惫的上班族调精油。

meaning: a. 盐水的, 海产的, 海上的

examples.en: He keeps a saltwater aquarium with colorful fish and corals.
examples.zh: 他养了一缸五彩斑斓的海水鱼和珊瑚。

meaning: adv. 不能取消地, 不能撤回地

examples.en: The old theater was irrevocably changed after the fire.
examples.zh: 大火之后,老剧院被不可挽回地改变了。

meaning: n. 质问者, 发问者;质问者, 询问者

examples.en: The speaker smiled patiently at each nervous questioner after the talk.
examples.zh: 演讲后,演讲者对每位紧张的提问者报以微笑。

meaning: a. 胖的, 肥胖的

examples.en: Taff crossed the old stone bridge on his way to market.
examples.zh: 塔夫在去集市的路上走过古老的石桥。

meaning: a. 先付的

examples.en: She gave me a prepaid card worth fifty dollars for my birthday.
examples.zh: 她送我一张五十美元的预付卡当生日礼物。

meaning: n. 乡下人, 土头土脑的人, 反应迟钝的人

examples.en: City kids teased him as a hick when he first arrived.
examples.zh: 他刚到时,城里孩子嘲笑他是乡巴佬。

meaning: n. 绅士, 男人, 先生

examples.en: The waiter greeted Signor Rossi with a warm handshake at the door.
examples.zh: 服务员在门口热情地与罗西先生握手问候。

meaning: adv. 颤抖着, 摇动着, 不可靠地

examples.en: After the long illness, he stood up shakily from the hospital bed.
examples.zh: 大病初愈,他颤颤巍巍地从病床上站起。

meaning: adv. 保存地; 保守地; 谨慎地

examples.en: The office dress code asks us to dress conservatively for client meetings.
examples.zh: 公司着装规范要求我们见客户时穿得保守。

meaning: n. 希拉里（美国现任国务卿）

examples.en: Hillary organized the office party down to the last detail.
examples.zh: 希拉里把办公室聚会办得一丝不苟。

meaning: n. 玄武岩;玄武岩

examples.en: The trail climbs over black basalt columns left by ancient lava.
examples.zh: 小径翻过古熔岩形成的黑色玄武岩石柱。

meaning: vbl. 击落

examples.en: The storm downed power lines across the county last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨刮倒了全县的电线。

meaning: 物(体)的, 物质的, 实际的

examples.en: Hand me that silver thingy on the workbench, will you?
examples.zh: 把工作台上那个银色小玩意递给我,好吗?

meaning: n. 斯洛伐克

examples.en: They spent a week hiking through the mountains of Slovakia.
examples.zh: 他们在斯洛伐克的山区徒步了一周。

meaning: n. X线断层摄影术;X线体层照相术, X线断层照相术

examples.en: The doctors ordered a scan using computed tomography to check his lungs.
examples.zh: 医生安排了计算机断层扫描来检查他的肺。

meaning: n. 昏晕, 晕厥;vi. 昏晕, 着迷, 渐渐消失

examples.en: The fans would swoon whenever the singer smiled at the crowd.
examples.zh: 歌手每次对人群微笑,粉丝们都为之倾倒。

meaning: a. 河岸的, 生于河岸的;n. 河岸土地所有人

examples.en: The council protects the riparian zone along the river from developers.
examples.zh: 议会保护河岸带免受开发商破坏。

meaning: 不可预测性, 不可预知性

examples.en: Farmers struggle with the unpredictability of spring weather each year.
examples.zh: 农民每年都要应付春天天气的反复无常。

meaning: abbr. 国际月球实验室（Lunar International Laboratory）

examples.en: Lil keeps her grandmother's recipes in a blue tin box.
examples.zh: 莉尔把祖母的菜谱收在一个蓝色铁盒里。

meaning: n. 威洛比(m.)

examples.en: Willoughby promised to repaint the fence before the neighbors returned.
examples.zh: 威洛比答应在邻居回来前把栅栏重漆一遍。

meaning: n. 意第绪语,依地语(犹太人使用的国际语);a. 意第绪语的,依地语,<俚>犹太人的

examples.en: My grandfather still sings old Yiddish songs when he cooks.
examples.zh: 祖父做饭时还会哼古老的意第绪语歌谣。

meaning: n. 回答, 反扑, 退还;蹴后

examples.en: The official was jailed for taking a kickback on the construction deal.
examples.zh: 那名官员因在工程交易中收回扣而入狱。

meaning: Canyon National Park (美国)布赖斯峡谷国家公园(在犹他州南部)

examples.en: Bryce takes the early train so he can finish work by three.
examples.zh: 布赖斯乘早班火车,好赶在三点前完工。

meaning: vt. 使神秘化, 使难解, 迷惑;变幻线

examples.en: The magician's card tricks continue to mystify audiences around the world.
examples.zh: 魔术师的纸牌戏法仍让全世界观众摸不着头脑。

meaning: n. 库恩（德国化学家, 曾获1938年诺贝尔化学奖）

examples.en: Kuhn argued that science advances through sudden paradigm shifts.
examples.zh: 库恩认为,科学通过突然的范式转换而进步。

meaning: n. 奥赛罗

examples.en: Our class is reading Othello and discussing jealousy this month.
examples.zh: 这个月我们班在读奥赛罗,讨论嫉妒。

meaning: n. 起床者, 叛徒, 起义者, 竖板;上升管

examples.en: My grandmother is an early riser who walks at dawn.
examples.zh: 我祖母起得早,天一亮就去散步。

meaning: n. 纵帆船, 大酒杯

examples.en: The old schooner sailed into the harbor with its white sails.
examples.zh: 那艘老纵帆船扬着白帆驶进港口。

meaning: a. 强壮的, 严厉的, 苛刻的;n. (英)(非正式)吵闹, 骚乱, 粉末, 灰尘

examples.en: The artists set up their easels beside the River Stour.
examples.zh: 画家们在斯托尔河边支起画架。

meaning: n. 侧面堡垒, 侧面部队, 侧冲

examples.en: The flanker made a crucial tackle in the last rugby match.
examples.zh: 那名边锋在上一场橄榄球赛完成关键拦截。

meaning: n. 超级名模

examples.en: The supermodel spoke candidly about the pressure of the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 超模坦率地谈到了时尚行业的压力。

meaning: n. 飞机跑道

examples.en: Supplies arrive at the remote airstrip every second Tuesday.
examples.zh: 补给每隔一个周二运到偏远的简易机场。

meaning: n. 喇叭狗

examples.en: The wrinkly bulldog snored beside the fireplace all evening.
examples.zh: 那只皱巴巴的斗牛犬整晚在壁炉边打呼噜。

meaning: v. 将鼻插入, 用鼻掘, 蜷卧

examples.en: The horse would nuzzle my pocket, searching for apple slices.
examples.zh: 马儿用鼻子蹭我的口袋,找苹果片吃。

meaning: n. 音系学, 历时音系学;语音学

examples.en: Her linguistics course covers the phonology of English vowel sounds.
examples.zh: 她的语言学课讲英语元音的音系学。

meaning: a. 慷慨的, 宽大的

examples.en: The garden gave us a bountiful harvest of tomatoes this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天,花园里的番茄大丰收。

meaning: n. 甲基;甲基

examples.en: The label warned that the cleaner contains methyl compounds.
examples.zh: 标签警告说,这种清洁剂含甲基化合物。

meaning: n. 布商, 衣商

examples.en: His family has worked as clothiers in this town for generations.
examples.zh: 他的家族世代在这个镇上做布商。

meaning: n. 痛饮, 牛饮, 鲸饮;v. 满满一口喝下, 牛饮, 大喝特喝

examples.en: He took a long swig of water after the morning run.
examples.zh: 晨跑之后,他咕咚咕咚灌了一大口水。

meaning: 一六零五, 二乙基对硝基苯硫代磷酸酯(有机磷杀虫药)

examples.en: The senator's PAC raised millions for the autumn campaign.
examples.zh: 这位参议员的政治行动委员会为秋季竞选筹了数百万。

meaning: n. 商, 份额;商

examples.en: A high intelligence quotient does not guarantee success in life.
examples.zh: 智商高并不能保证人生成功。

meaning: n. 结构主义

examples.en: Structuralism influenced how scholars read myths, novels, and even fashion.
examples.zh: 结构主义影响了学者解读神话、小说乃至时尚。

meaning: n. 飕飕声, 精明的人, 专家;v. (使)飕飕作声

examples.en: The kids watched the cyclists whizz past the finish line.
examples.zh: 孩子们看着车手嗖嗖地冲过终点线。

meaning: n. 马赫数, 马赫;机器检查

examples.en: The jet reached Mach two during the test flight.
examples.zh: 这架喷气机在试飞中达到了两倍音速。

meaning: n. 火蜥蜴, 火怪, 耐火的人;蝾螈

examples.en: A small salamander hid under the wet log by the creek.
examples.zh: 一只小蝾螈藏在溪边潮湿的木头下。

meaning: v. （使某物）变黄或发黄( yellow的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: He found his grandmother's yellowed letters in the attic trunk.
examples.zh: 他在阁楼的旧箱子里发现了祖母泛黄的信件。

meaning: n. 氡;氡Rn

examples.en: We installed a detector because radon gas can seep into basements.
examples.zh: 我们装了检测器,因为氡气会渗进地下室。

meaning: a. 不信神的, 无信仰的, 异端的;n. 无信仰者, 异教徒, 异端

examples.en: The medieval chroniclers called their enemies infidels in dusty manuscripts.
examples.zh: 中世纪编年史家在旧手稿里称敌人为异教徒。

meaning: n. 特殊性, 特质, 个性, 细致, 苛求

examples.en: The essay studies the particularity of small coastal fishing towns.
examples.zh: 这篇文章研究小型沿海渔镇的独特性。

meaning: n. 上升, 耶稣升天

examples.en: The rocket's ascension was visible from beaches fifty miles away.
examples.zh: 五十英里外的海滩都能看见火箭升空。

meaning: n. 沉淀, 沉积;沉积作用; 沉降

examples.en: The geology class studied sedimentation layers along the river cliff.
examples.zh: 地质课研究了河流峭壁上的沉积层。

meaning: adv. 踏实地, 不变地; 岿然; 坚定不渝

examples.en: She steadfastly refused to reveal the secret recipe to anyone.
examples.zh: 她坚决拒绝向任何人透露秘方。

meaning: n. 蒂沃利（意大利中部城市）

examples.en: They admired the fountains of Tivoli on their Italian holiday.
examples.zh: 意大利度假时,他们欣赏了蒂沃利的喷泉。

meaning: n. 尘垢, 煤尘, 污点;vt. 使污秽, 使...弄脏

examples.en: Scrubbing the old oven removed years of greasy grime.
examples.zh: 擦洗旧烤箱,去掉了多年的油腻污垢。

meaning: 浆液, 血清;血清; 浆液

examples.en: The lab stored the blood sera in a cold room overnight.
examples.zh: 实验室把血清样本放在冷藏室过夜。

meaning: n. 花椰菜;花椰菜(菜花)

examples.en: She roasted the cauliflower with olive oil and garlic.
examples.zh: 她用橄榄油和大蒜烤花椰菜。

meaning: 豪华的宫殿, 邸宅

examples.en: The wedding reception was held in a grand palazzo in Florence.
examples.zh: 婚宴在佛罗伦萨一座宏伟的宫殿举行。

meaning: n. 实证论者, 实证主义者;实在法学派, 实证主义者, 实证论者

examples.en: The positivist scholar trusted only evidence he could measure directly.
examples.zh: 这位实证主义学者只信能直接测量的证据。

meaning: n. 放射学者;放射学家

examples.en: The radiologist examined the chest X-rays before the surgery.
examples.zh: 放射科医生在术前查看了胸部X光片。

meaning: a. 吹制的, 喘气的, 开着花的;blow的过去分词

examples.en: The glass ornament was blown by a local craftsman.
examples.zh: 这件玻璃饰品是当地工匠吹制的。

meaning: a. 著作者的

examples.en: Scholars debated the authorial intent behind the novel's strange ending.
examples.zh: 学者们争论小说离奇结尾背后的作者意图。

meaning: a. 许许多多的（等于umpteen）

examples.en: Steen painted lively scenes of Dutch family life long ago.
examples.zh: 斯滕很久以前画过生动的荷兰家庭生活场景。

meaning: vt. (使)吃过量

examples.en: I always overeat at my aunt's holiday dinners.
examples.zh: 在姨妈的节日晚餐上,我总是吃得太撑。

meaning: v. 解开, 拆散, 散开( unravel的过去式和过去分词 ); 阐明; 澄清; 弄清楚

examples.en: The old sweater unraveled when the loose thread finally snapped.
examples.zh: 松脱的线一断,旧毛衣就散了线。

meaning: adv. 嘶哑地, 刺耳地

examples.en: He spoke hoarsely after cheering at the concert all night.
examples.zh: 在演唱会上欢呼了一整晚,他说话都哑了。

meaning: n. <西>理想中的黄金国, 富庶之乡

examples.en: The explorers searched for Eldorado, the legendary city of gold.
examples.zh: 探险家们寻找传说中的黄金之城埃尔多拉多。

meaning: n. 捷克斯洛伐克人;a. 捷克斯洛伐克的, 捷克斯洛伐克人的

examples.en: My grandmother kept her old Czechoslovak passport in a velvet box.
examples.zh: 祖母把旧捷克斯洛伐克护照收在天鹅绒盒里。

meaning: vt.得分超过

examples.en: The home team managed to outscore the champions in overtime.
examples.zh: 主队在加时赛中得分超过了卫冕冠军。

meaning: n. 黑山

examples.en: They rented a small car and drove along the coast of Montenegro.
examples.zh: 他们租了辆小车,沿黑山海岸行驶。

meaning: a. 不关心政治的

examples.en: The general insisted the army must remain apolitical at all times.
examples.zh: 这位将军坚称军队必须始终保持政治中立。

meaning: a. 水陆两栖的, 能两栖作战的, 陆海空军协同作战的;两栖的

examples.en: The navy practiced an amphibious landing on the sandy shore.
examples.zh: 海军在沙滩上演练了两栖登陆。

meaning: n. 天堂

examples.en: Fans reached nirvana when the band played its classic encore.
examples.zh: 乐队奏响经典返场曲时,乐迷们如痴如醉。

meaning: 翻转, 翻模

examples.en: The driver walked away unhurt from the rollover crash on the highway.
examples.zh: 司机在高速翻车事故中安然无恙。

meaning: n. 希腊语第六个字母

examples.en: The Greek letter zeta appears in many advanced math formulas.
examples.zh: 希腊字母泽塔常出现在高等数学公式中。

meaning: a. 漂白的, 晒白的, 颜色变浅的;v. 使（颜色）变淡, 变白, 漂白( bleach的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The sun has bleached the curtains to a pale ivory.
examples.zh: 阳光把窗帘晒成了浅象牙色。

meaning: n. 肺气肿;气肿, 肺气肿

examples.en: Grandfather's emphysema forced him to quit smoking and start walking daily.
examples.zh: 祖父的肺气肿迫使他戒烟并每天散步。

meaning: n. 尤恩(Evan的异体)(m.)

examples.en: Ewan builds model airplanes on his bedroom desk every weekend.
examples.zh: 尤安每个周末都在卧室书桌上拼飞机模型。

meaning: n. 德黑兰

examples.en: Her father grew up in Teheran before studying medicine abroad.
examples.zh: 她父亲在德黑兰长大,后来出国学医。

meaning: 轴台, 垫块, 承载台

examples.en: Plummer fixed the leaking pipe under the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 普卢默修好了厨房水槽下漏水的管子。

meaning: a. 无重量的, 失重的, 不重要的

examples.en: Astronauts feel weightless as their spacecraft orbits the Earth.
examples.zh: 宇航员在飞船绕地球飞行时感到失重。

meaning: n. 起草者, 制图员, 图案工;绘图员

examples.en: The draftsman sketched the new bridge in precise pencil lines.
examples.zh: 制图员用铅笔画出新桥的精确图样。

meaning: n. 嘶嘶声, 失败;vi. 发嘶嘶声, 失败

examples.en: The party started with a bang but began to fizzle by midnight.
examples.zh: 派对开场热闹,到午夜就渐渐冷场了。

meaning: n. 组合主义者,社团主义者

examples.en: The corporatist policy brought unions and employers to one table.
examples.zh: 社团主义政策把工会和雇主拉到一张桌前。

meaning: n. 光谱学;光谱学

examples.en: Using spectroscopy, the chemists identified the elements inside the distant star.
examples.zh: 化学家用光谱技术辨认出遥远恒星内的元素。

meaning: n. 安特里（英国西北部利物浦市郊区）

examples.en: Thousands of racing fans travel to Aintree for the famous steeplechase.
examples.zh: 成千上万赛马迷前往安特里看著名障碍赛。

meaning: a. 德文郡的, 泥盆纪的;n. 德文郡人, 泥盆纪

examples.en: The hikers found Devonian fossils embedded in the cliff face.
examples.zh: 徒步者在崖壁上发现了泥盆纪化石。

meaning: n. 女式上衣的宽领

examples.en: Bertha knits woolen hats for the homeless every winter.
examples.zh: 伯莎每年冬天都为流浪者织羊毛帽。

meaning: n. 扭弄物体的人, 六便士银币, 饮酒作乐

examples.en: He apologized for his weekend bender and promised to slow down.
examples.zh: 他为周末的狂欢痛饮道歉,保证会节制。

meaning: n. 三个月, 一学期;三个月, 三月期

examples.en: The school divides the year into three trimesters for exams.
examples.zh: 这所学校把学年分成三个学期来考试。

meaning: a. 同时用两眼的, 两眼并用的;双眼的, 双目镜

examples.en: Owls have binocular vision, which helps them judge distance at night.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰有双目视觉,有助夜间判断距离。

meaning: n. 龙蒿;龙艾

examples.en: She flavored the chicken soup with fresh tarragon from the garden.
examples.zh: 她用花园里的新鲜龙蒿给鸡汤调味。

meaning: n. 肉馅小方包子

examples.en: We ordered cheese ravioli and a green salad for lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐我们点了奶酪意饺和一份蔬菜沙拉。

meaning: n. <主澳俚>=Christmas;n. <俚>菊花

examples.en: The family gathers at Grandma's place every Chrissie morning.
examples.zh: 每年圣诞节早上,全家都聚在奶奶家。

meaning: n. 神经外科医师;神经外科医师

examples.en: The neurosurgeon explained the delicate operation in calm, simple words.
examples.zh: 神经外科医生用平静简单的话讲解这台精细手术。

meaning: adv. 歇斯底里地

examples.en: The audience laughed hysterically at the clown's clumsy magic tricks.
examples.zh: 观众看小丑笨拙的魔术,笑得前仰后合。

meaning: v. (使)民主化

examples.en: Cheap online courses helped democratize higher education for millions.
examples.zh: 廉价网课让数百万人上得起高等教育。

meaning: a. 自治的, 自主的;自主的

examples.en: Breathing is controlled by the autonomic nervous system during sleep.
examples.zh: 睡眠时,呼吸由自主神经系统控制。

meaning: a. 自我陶醉的, 自恋的;自爱欲的

examples.en: His narcissistic behavior made it hard for teammates to trust him.
examples.zh: 他自恋的言行让队友很难信任他。

meaning: adv. 不典型地；非同寻常地

examples.en: Maya was uncharacteristically quiet during the entire drive to the airport.
examples.zh: 去机场的一路,玛雅反常地一言不发。

meaning: v. 重漆, 重画;重新绘制

examples.en: We plan to repaint the kitchen cabinets a soft sage green.
examples.zh: 我们打算把厨房橱柜重漆成柔和的鼠尾草绿。

meaning: n. 克拉丽莎(f.)

examples.en: Clarissa waters the office plants every Monday before stand-up.
examples.zh: 克拉丽莎每周一开站会前给办公室植物浇水。

meaning: a. 闯劲足的, 有力的

examples.en: Grandfather looked dashing in his navy uniform in old photos.
examples.zh: 老照片里的祖父穿着海军制服,英俊潇洒。

meaning: n. 明矾, 矾, 校友;明矾; 钾铝明矾

examples.en: She is an alum of the journalism program and mentors current students.
examples.zh: 她是新闻项目的校友,常辅导在读学生。

meaning: n. 布鲁特斯（罗马政治家）

examples.en: The play shows Brutus struggling with his loyalty to Rome.
examples.zh: 这部剧展现了布鲁图斯对罗马忠诚的挣扎。

meaning: n. 拖把, 药签;vt. 擦洗, 拭抹

examples.en: The nurse used a cotton swab to clean the cut.
examples.zh: 护士用棉签清洁伤口。

meaning: n. <美>直接对抗, 摊牌

examples.en: The exhausted hiker fell facedown onto his tent's sleeping bag.
examples.zh: 精疲力竭的徒步者趴倒在帐篷的睡袋上。

meaning: n. 淋病

examples.en: The clinic offers free and confidential testing for gonorrhoea.
examples.zh: 这家诊所提供免费保密的淋病检测。

meaning: n. 休假者；度假者

examples.en: Every summer, a cheerful vacationer rents the cottage by the lake.
examples.zh: 每年夏天都有快乐的度假者租下湖边小屋。

meaning: n. 使清洁的东西, 清洁剂, 清洁工;泸清器, 清洁器, 刮净器

examples.en: She uses a gentle facial cleanser before bed every night.
examples.zh: 她每晚睡前用温和的洗面奶洗脸。

meaning: n. 杜鹃

examples.en: A purple rhododendron bloomed beside the mountain cabin in May.
examples.zh: 五月,一株紫色杜鹃在山间小屋旁盛开。

meaning: adv. 漫无目的地, 无目标地

examples.en: We wandered aimlessly through the old town on a free afternoon.
examples.zh: 空闲的下午,我们在老城里漫无目的地闲逛。

meaning: a. 不整齐的, 未处理的, 未决定的;未决的, 未定的, 怀疑的

examples.en: The sudden news left the whole family feeling unsettled.
examples.zh: 突如其来的消息让全家人心神不宁。

meaning: n. 式样翻新;vt.vi. 式样翻新

examples.en: The city plans to retrofit old buses with electric engines.
examples.zh: 市里计划给旧公交车改装电动引擎。

meaning: n. '各阶级合作'主义

examples.en: The lecture compared corporatism with other economic systems in Europe.
examples.zh: 讲座把社团主义与欧洲其他经济体制作比较。

meaning: vi. 有浪漫思想, 以浪漫方式行事, 以浪漫风格描写;vt. 使浪漫化

examples.en: The film does not romanticize life as a sailor in the 1800s.
examples.zh: 这部电影没有把十九世纪水手的生活浪漫化。

meaning: a. 无情的, 无勇气的

examples.en: It seemed heartless to cancel the picnic without telling the kids.
examples.zh: 不告诉孩子们就取消野餐,显得很无情。

meaning: n. 女低音, 男声最高音, 女低音歌手

examples.en: She sings alto in the community choir every Thursday.
examples.zh: 她每周四在社区合唱团唱女低音。

meaning: n. 分析者, 分析器;分析器

examples.en: The engineer used a spectrum analyzer to find the strange noise.
examples.zh: 工程师用频谱分析仪查找那奇怪的噪音。

meaning: n. 欧洲隧道（世界上最长的海底隧道）；欧洲隧道公司

examples.en: The train carries cars through the Eurotunnel beneath the Channel.
examples.zh: 火车载着汽车穿过海峡下的欧洲隧道。

meaning: n. 机身

examples.en: Mechanics inspected the airframe for cracks after the rough landing.
examples.zh: 颠簸降落后,机务检查机身有无裂缝。

meaning: n. 工作服, 罩衫, 长罩衣;vt. 使穿上工作服, 缝制装饰用衣褶

examples.en: The children put on plastic smocks before painting their flowerpots.
examples.zh: 孩子们画花盆前先穿上塑料罩衣。

meaning: n. 记分卡

examples.en: The manager reviews a scorecard of key metrics each Monday.
examples.zh: 经理每周一查看关键指标的记分卡。

meaning: n. 切除, 删除, 切除之物;切除术

examples.en: The dermatologist recommended a simple excision of the small mole.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生建议把小痣做个简单切除。

meaning: n. 后援者, 附议者;附议人, 赞成人, 赞助人

examples.en: The motion needed a seconder before the committee could vote.
examples.zh: 动议需要有人附议,委员会才能表决。

meaning: n. 打的人, 拍打树丛惊起猎物的人, 搅拌器;打浆机

examples.en: She whipped the cream with an electric beater in two minutes.
examples.zh: 她用电动打蛋器两分钟就打好了奶油。

meaning: n. 海蒂（Adalheid的昵称）

examples.en: Heidi walks her two dogs along the canal every morning.
examples.zh: 海蒂每天早上沿运河遛两只狗。

meaning: n. 内省, 反省;内省

examples.en: A quiet weekend of introspection helped her choose a new career.
examples.zh: 一个安静自省的周末帮她选定了新职业。

meaning: a. 计量经济学的

examples.en: The team built an econometric model to forecast housing prices.
examples.zh: 团队建了计量经济模型来预测房价。

meaning: n. 桃金娘科植物;桃金娘

examples.en: The garden wall was covered with flowering myrtle in spring.
examples.zh: 春天,花园的墙上爬满开花的香桃木。

meaning: 无性系, 纯系(植物、细胞、细菌等)

examples.en: Researchers grew each clon of the fern in separate pots.
examples.zh: 研究人员把蕨类的每个克隆株分盆栽种。

meaning: n. 因果报应, 命运

examples.en: She believes good karma comes from helping your neighbors.
examples.zh: 她相信帮助邻居会带来好运气。

meaning: n. 沙袋鼠, 澳大利亚人

examples.en: We spotted a small wallaby hopping near the eucalyptus trees.
examples.zh: 我们在桉树附近看到一只蹦跳的小沙袋鼠。

meaning: n. (教堂)半圆形拱顶附带建筑

examples.en: The choir stood in the church's semicircular apse during the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会上,唱诗班站在教堂半圆后殿里。

meaning: n. 斯巴达（希腊南部的古代城邦）

examples.en: In history class we compared Sparta with its rival Athens.
examples.zh: 历史课上,我们比较了斯巴达与对手雅典。

meaning: n. （美）雅皮士（属于中上阶层的年轻专业人士）

examples.en: The sitcom pokes fun at a young yuppie buying his first condo.
examples.zh: 这部情景喜剧调侃买首套公寓的年轻雅皮士。

meaning: vt. 使不灭, 使名垂千古

examples.en: The poet tried to immortalize the town's fishing days in verse.
examples.zh: 诗人想用诗句让小镇的捕鱼岁月永存。

meaning: 证券市场; 证券交易所; 证券行情

examples.en: Grandpa checks the stockmarket prices with his morning coffee.
examples.zh: 爷爷喝早咖啡时必看股市行情。

meaning: a. 醉人的,使人兴奋的

examples.en: The jungle air was intoxicating after the long city winter.
examples.zh: 城市漫长冬天后来到丛林,空气令人陶醉。

meaning: a. 不清楚的, 朦胧的, 难以清楚辨认的

examples.en: His indistinct mumbling made the lecture hard to follow.
examples.zh: 他含糊的咕哝让人很难听懂讲课。

meaning: 福楼拜(Gustave, 1821-1880 , 法国小说家)

examples.en: Our book club is reading Flaubert this autumn.
examples.zh: 今年秋天,我们读书会在读福楼拜。

meaning: n. 跳飞, 跳弹;v. (使)跳飞

examples.en: The pebble seemed to ricochet off the frozen lake surface.
examples.zh: 鹅卵石仿佛从结冰的湖面上弹开了。

meaning: n. 靛青, 靛蓝色;a. 靛蓝色的

examples.en: She dyed the old scarf a deep indigo blue.
examples.zh: 她把旧围巾染成了深靛蓝色。

meaning: v. 占领( occupy的现在分词 ); 使用; 使从事; 任职

examples.en: The new family is occupying the corner apartment until June.
examples.zh: 新搬来的那家住拐角公寓,要住到六月。

meaning: n. 表现型, 有共同表现型的生物群体, 遗传环境互应结果;表型, 显型

examples.en: Wing color is a visible phenotype scientists use to track mutations.
examples.zh: 翅膀颜色是科学家追踪突变的可见表型。

meaning: n. 色谱法;色谱法; 层析法

examples.en: The students separated plant pigments using paper chromatography in the lab.
examples.zh: 学生在实验室用纸层析分离植物色素。

meaning: adv. 嘎声地

examples.en: She whispered huskily that the surprise party was almost ready.
examples.zh: 她沙哑地低声说,惊喜派对快准备好了。

meaning: a. Hellenist的, 希腊风格的, 希腊文化的

examples.en: The museum's Hellenistic statues show flowing robes and calm faces.
examples.zh: 博物馆的希腊化雕塑衣袂飘逸,面容宁静。

meaning: n. 压迫者, 压制者;压迫者, 压制者, 强迫者

examples.en: The folk hero dared to stand up against the cruel oppressor.
examples.zh: 民间英雄敢于反抗残暴的压迫者。

meaning: n. 神经节, 腱鞘囊肿;神经节, 腱鞘囊肿

examples.en: The doctor said the lump was a harmless ganglion on her wrist.
examples.zh: 医生说,她手腕上的肿块是无害的腱鞘囊肿。

meaning: a. 无争论之余地的

examples.en: Her talent is indisputable; even the harshest critics praise her singing.
examples.zh: 她的才华无可争议,连最苛刻的乐评人也称赞。

meaning: n. 沙里夫(m.)

examples.en: Sharif translates legal documents for a busy downtown firm.
examples.zh: 沙里夫为市中心一家繁忙的事务所翻译法律文件。

meaning: 摩加迪沙

examples.en: Her charity ships clean-water kits from Mogadishu each month.
examples.zh: 她的慈善机构每月从摩加迪发散发净水包。

meaning: n. 近战, 混战, 暗斗

examples.en: The committee's infighting delayed the playground project for a year.
examples.zh: 委员会的内斗让游乐场项目拖了一年。

meaning: n. 躺椅

examples.en: Dad fell asleep in his leather recliner watching the game.
examples.zh: 爸爸看比赛时,躺在皮躺椅上睡着了。

meaning: n. V形袖章, 锯齿形花饰;人字形

examples.en: The soldiers painted a bright chevron on the warehouse door.
examples.zh: 士兵们在仓库门上画了醒目的V形图案。

meaning: n. 安西娅(f.)

examples.en: Anthea collects seashells along the shore after every storm.
examples.zh: 每场风暴过后,安西娅都会去岸边捡贝壳。

meaning: n. 多愁善感;情感生活

examples.en: The film avoids cheap sentimentality while telling a moving story.
examples.zh: 这部电影讲故事动人,却不落俗套煽情。

meaning: abbr. 东亚银行有限公司（Bank of East Asia Ltd）；美国劳工部劳工统计局（Bureau of Economic Analysis）；英国

examples.en: Bea packs her lunch the night before to save time.
examples.zh: 碧为了省时间,前一晚就装好午餐。

meaning: n. 头带, 轮廓线, 带状物, 带子, 束发带, 肉片, 鱼片, 襻, 嵌条, 丘带, (内)圆角;vt. 用带缚, 把(肉/鱼)切成片, 用饰带装饰

examples.en: He ordered the filet mignon with roasted vegetables.
examples.zh: 他点了配烤蔬菜的菲力牛排。

meaning: n. 意大利人;a. 杜松子酒的,有杜松子酒味的

examples.en: Ginny painted her first watercolor of the harbor last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末,金妮画了第一幅港口水彩。

meaning: n. 露辛达(Lucy的异体)(f.)

examples.en: Lucinda practices the violin for an hour before breakfast.
examples.zh: 露辛达早餐前练一小时小提琴。

meaning: v. 冷藏( refrigerate的过去式和过去分词 ); 冷冻

examples.en: The vaccines were kept in refrigerated boxes during the long transport.
examples.zh: 长途运输中,疫苗一直存放在冷藏箱里。

meaning: n. 相同, 异体同形, 同族关系;同源性

examples.en: The textbook explains the homology between a human arm and a wing.
examples.zh: 教科书解释了人类手臂与翅膀的同源关系。

meaning: n. 斯托诺韦（英国城市）

examples.en: The ferry reaches Stornoway before lunch on a calm day.
examples.zh: 风平浪静时,渡轮午饭前就能到斯托诺韦。

meaning: 终端接口, 得州仪器公司, 变换实现;钛(22号元素)

examples.en: The children practiced the scale from do to ti.
examples.zh: 孩子们练习从哆到西的音阶。

meaning: a. 土制的, 陶制的

examples.en: Water stayed cool in the earthen jar on the patio.
examples.zh: 陶罐里的水在院子里保持清凉。

meaning: n. 木豆（等于dhal ）；木豆做的菜；一种带辣味的印度菜（用蚕豆, 豌豆或小扁豆制成）

examples.en: We ordered spicy dal with warm flatbread for dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐我们点了辣扁豆糊,配热乎的扁面包。

meaning: n. 肚带, 紧握, 必然(发生)的事情;vt. 给...系肚带, 紧握住, 抓牢

examples.en: Fixing a flat tire is a cinch once you practice.
examples.zh: 修爆胎这种事,练过一次就是小菜一碟。

meaning: n. 乌兹别克斯坦

examples.en: Her cousin teaches English in Uzbekistan for a volunteer program.
examples.zh: 她表姐参加志愿项目,在乌兹别克斯坦教英语。

meaning: vt. 到处搜索, 遍寻, 掠夺, 洗劫;洗劫, 抢劫, 掠夺

examples.en: Thieves ransacked the jewelry store and escaped before dawn.
examples.zh: 窃贼洗劫了珠宝店,天亮前逃走了。

meaning: n. 果仁糖浆

examples.en: The baker sculpted tiny roses from marzipan for the wedding cake.
examples.zh: 面点师用杏仁膏为婚礼蛋糕捏了小玫瑰。

meaning: a. 类风湿病的;风湿病样的

examples.en: Her grandmother manages rheumatoid arthritis with gentle swimming and medication.
examples.zh: 她祖母靠温和游泳和药物控制类风湿关节炎。

meaning: int. 唷(水手拉绳时一道发出的叫声)

examples.en: Yeo raises bees and sells honey at the farmers market.
examples.zh: 尤养蜂,还在农贸市场卖蜂蜜。

meaning: a. 上游的, 向水源的

examples.en: Salmon swim upriver each fall to reach their spawning grounds.
examples.zh: 每年秋天,鲑鱼逆流而上回到产卵地。

meaning: 沙巴(州)(旧称北婆罗州)

examples.en: They went diving off the coast of Sabah last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天,他们在沙巴海岸潜水。

meaning: n. 队长, 首领, 酋长;领班, 工头

examples.en: The village headman called a meeting under the big tree.
examples.zh: 村长在大树下召集了一次会议。

meaning: n. 欧洲债券

examples.en: The finance ministry issued a eurobond to fund new railways.
examples.zh: 财政部发行欧洲债券为新铁路筹资。

meaning: a. 喝醉的；受毒品麻醉的

examples.en: He ripped the envelope open to read his exam results.
examples.zh: 他撕开信封,查看考试成绩。

meaning: n. 小旅馆老板, 客栈老板

examples.en: The friendly innkeeper recommended a quiet trail behind the village.
examples.zh: 热心的客栈老板推荐了村后一条清静小径。

meaning: n. 吹哨, 吹笛；鸣汽笛

examples.en: The janitor moved down the hallway, whistling an old tune.
examples.zh: 清洁工哼着老调子,沿走廊走远了。

meaning: n. 部落男子

examples.en: A local tribesman guided the researchers through the mountain pass.
examples.zh: 一位当地部落人领着研究人员翻过山口。

meaning: n. 嗨！（表示惊异质问）

examples.en: He chuckled, 'Heh, that trick almost fooled me!'
examples.zh: 他轻声笑道:嘿,那招差点骗到我!

meaning: a. 禁止的, 抑制的;抑制的

examples.en: The drug has an inhibitory effect on nerve signal transmission.
examples.zh: 这种药对神经信号传递有抑制作用。

meaning: n. 大肠杆菌

examples.en: The lab tested the water for E. coli bacteria.
examples.zh: 实验室检测水中的大肠杆菌。

meaning: n. 理想主义者, 唯心主义者;a. 唯心论的, 理想主义的

examples.en: As a young idealist, she dreamed of ending world hunger.
examples.zh: 年轻时她是个理想主义者,梦想消除世界饥饿。

meaning: a. 下垂的,无力的

examples.en: The tulips were drooping sadly by the end of the heat wave.
examples.zh: 热浪结束时,郁金香垂头丧气。

meaning: n. （英国邮电系统的）快速电视电话咨询服务

examples.en: Grandpa remembers when Prestel delivered news over the telephone line.
examples.zh: 爷爷还记得用电话线传新闻的Prestel系统。

meaning: n. 大杂烩

examples.en: Grandma's seafood gumbo simmers on the stove every Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 每个平安夜,奶奶的海鲜浓汤都在炉上咕嘟。

meaning: n. 多孔性, 有孔性;多孔性

examples.en: The engineer measured the porosity of the new concrete mix.
examples.zh: 工程师测量了新混凝土的孔隙率。

meaning: n. 爸爸, 达达主义派的文艺作品

examples.en: The gallery's Dada exhibit challenges what people call art.
examples.zh: 美术馆的达达主义展挑战人们对艺术的定义。

meaning: a. 下面的, 下方的, 地下的;天然碱

examples.en: They explored the nether regions of the old cellar.
examples.zh: 他们探查了老地下室最深处的角落。

meaning: adv. 意味深长地

examples.en: Volunteering abroad helped her contribute meaningfully to the coastal village.
examples.zh: 海外志愿让她为海滨村庄做出了实在贡献。

meaning: abbr. 卫生部（Department of Health）

examples.en: Dad slapped his forehead and groaned, 'Doh, I locked the keys inside!'
examples.zh: 爸爸拍着额头叫苦:哎呀,我把钥匙锁里面了!

meaning: adv. 从人的角度, 充满人性地, 在人力所及范围

examples.en: The doctors did everything humanly possible to save the patient.
examples.zh: 医生们竭尽人力所能地抢救病人。

meaning: n. 二氧(杂)芑

examples.en: The factory scandal involved dioxin contamination of the local river.
examples.zh: 工厂丑闻涉及二恶英污染当地河流。

meaning: vt. 碾碎, 缩紧;vi. 嘎吱地响, 蜷缩

examples.en: She likes to scrunch the wrapping paper into a tight ball.
examples.zh: 她喜欢把包装纸揉成结实的纸团。

meaning: a. 团体之间的

examples.en: The workshop aims to reduce intergroup tension in the divided town.
examples.zh: 研讨会旨在缓解这座分裂城镇的群体间紧张。

meaning: a. 古生代的;n. 古生代

examples.en: The museum displays Palaeozoic trilobites from the local quarry.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出本地采石场出土的古生代三叶虫。

meaning: n. 有代销权的人(或团体);特许证持有人

examples.en: The new franchisee opened three coffee shops within a year.
examples.zh: 那位新加盟商一年内开了三家咖啡店。

meaning: n. 时代错误, 不合潮流的人(物);时代错误, 落伍的事物

examples.en: A wristwatch on the Roman soldier looked like a silly anachronism.
examples.zh: 罗马士兵腕上的手表显得滑稽而不合时代。

meaning: n. 重组, 重组物

examples.en: Scientists produced insulin using recombinant DNA techniques decades ago.
examples.zh: 几十年前,科学家就用重组DNA技术生产胰岛素。

meaning: n. 出租人;出租人

examples.en: The lessor agreed to repaint the flat before the new tenant arrived.
examples.zh: 出租方同意在新租客入住前重新粉刷。

meaning: n. 机器人;男性样的

examples.en: The museum guide is a friendly android that answers visitors' questions.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲解员是个友善的人形机器人。

meaning: v. （把…）弄碎, （使）碎成细屑( crumble的过去式和过去分词 ); 衰落; 坍塌; 损坏

examples.en: The old stone wall crumbled during the winter frost.
examples.zh: 古老的石墙在冬霜中坍塌破损。

meaning: n. 第纳尔(南斯拉夫、伊拉克的货币单位)

examples.en: She exchanged her euros for dinar at the airport counter.
examples.zh: 她在机场柜台把欧元换成了第纳尔。

meaning: n. 语用学;语用学

examples.en: Her linguistics thesis examines politeness through the lens of pragmatics.
examples.zh: 她的语言学论文用语用学视角研究礼貌。

meaning: n. 外形, 外在性

examples.en: The lecture explained how pollution is a negative externality of industry.
examples.zh: 讲座解释了污染如何成为工业的负外部性。

meaning: n. 枕套

examples.en: She embroidered tiny daisies on each white pillowcase.
examples.zh: 她在每只白枕套上绣了小雏菊。

meaning: n. 钡;钡Ba

examples.en: The patient drank a barium solution before the stomach X-ray.
examples.zh: 病人在胃部X光检查前喝下钡剂。

meaning: n. 摔跤, 翻筋斗;a. 斜的

examples.en: The children spent the afternoon tumbling on the trampoline.
examples.zh: 孩子们一下午都在蹦床上翻滚玩耍。

meaning: n. 电阻器;电阻器

examples.en: Replace the burnt resistor on the circuit board before testing again.
examples.zh: 再次测试前,先换掉电路板上烧坏的电阻。

meaning: n. 烟囱;烟堆

examples.en: The old factory smokestack towers over the small riverside town.
examples.zh: 老工厂的烟囱俯瞰着河边小镇。

meaning: n. 公债所有者;公债持有人, 证券持有人

examples.en: Each fundholder will receive the annual report by early March.
examples.zh: 每位基金持有人三月初会收到年报。

meaning: n. 呕吐, 呕吐物, 吐剂;v. 呕吐

examples.en: The poor kid puked on the twisting bus ride home.
examples.zh: 回家路上弯道不断,可怜的孩子吐了。

meaning: n. 个人简历;生活, 生存, 生命

examples.en: Please attach a short vita listing your teaching experience.
examples.zh: 请附一份简短履历,列出你的教学经历。

meaning: n. 黑板

examples.en: The teacher wrote the homework on the chalkboard before dismissal.
examples.zh: 放学前,老师把作业写在黑板上。

meaning: n. 巴利米纳（北爱尔兰城市）

examples.en: She grew up on a quiet farm outside Ballymena.
examples.zh: 她在巴利米纳郊外安静的农场长大。

meaning: n. 美洲驼

examples.en: The children fed a friendly llama at the county fair.
examples.zh: 孩子们在县集市上喂了一只友善的羊驼。

meaning: n. 马里亚纳群岛

examples.en: The documentary explores the depths of the Mariana Trench.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片探索马里亚纳海沟深处。

meaning: a. 不能调换的, 不能代替的;不能恢复原状的, 不能替代的, 无法弥补的

examples.en: Grandma's handwritten recipe book is truly irreplaceable to our family.
examples.zh: 祖母手写的菜谱对我们家无可替代。

meaning: n. 颚, 上颚, 嘴的上(或下)部;下颌骨

examples.en: The insect's mandible is strong enough to cut through leaves.
examples.zh: 这种昆虫的上颚锋利得能切开叶子。

meaning: n. 用力拉的人, 松紧扣, 过滤器;粗滤器; 滤网

examples.en: Pour the pasta through a strainer and shake off the water.
examples.zh: 把意面倒进滤篮,沥掉水分。

meaning: n. 女裁缝, 做针线活的妇女

examples.en: The talented seamstress altered my suit jacket overnight.
examples.zh: 手艺好的女裁缝一夜之间改好了我的西装。

meaning: n. 波尔卡舞, 女用紧身短上衣

examples.en: They learned a lively polka at the community dance class.
examples.zh: 他们在社区舞蹈班学了一支欢快的波尔卡。

meaning: a. 静脉的, 在静脉中的, 有脉的;静脉的

examples.en: The doctor explained the difference between venous and arterial blood flow.
examples.zh: 医生解释了静脉与动脉血流的区别。

meaning: a. 胞内的, 细胞内的;细胞内的

examples.en: The biologist filmed intracellular traffic moving inside a single cell.
examples.zh: 生物学家拍下了单个细胞内的胞内运输。

meaning: a. 白垩系的, 白垩纪的;n. 白垩纪, 白垩系

examples.en: The museum's Cretaceous hall features a towering Tyrannosaurus skeleton.
examples.zh: 博物馆白垩纪展厅有高耸的霸王龙骨架。

meaning: n. 呆子, 傻瓜;vt. 弄糟

examples.en: Don't worry about the typo; we all goof sometimes.
examples.zh: 别把错字放心上,谁都有犯迷糊的时候。

meaning: n. 跳羚

examples.en: A springbok leaped gracefully across the South African grassland.
examples.zh: 一只跳羚优雅地跃过南非草原。

meaning: n. （黎巴嫩）真主党（等于Hizbollah）

examples.en: The article traces the history of Hezbollah in Lebanese politics.
examples.zh: 这篇文章梳理真主党在黎巴嫩政坛的历史。

meaning: n. 布伦特里（美国地名）

examples.en: They bought a small colonial house in Braintree last autumn.
examples.zh: 去年秋天,他们在布雷因特里买了栋殖民风格小屋。

meaning: n. 克鲁格（现代寻租理论的创始人）；格尔（南非政治家）

examples.en: The safari group spotted lions at Kruger just after sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出后不久,观兽团就在克鲁格看到了狮子。

meaning: n. 运输者, 传达者, 承办产权转让事物的律师;撰写转让契据的律师

examples.en: The conveyancer checked every legal detail before we sold the flat.
examples.zh: 我们卖公寓前,过户律师核对了每个法律细节。

meaning: n. 喧闹, 大吹大擂的宣传, 投环套物游戏

examples.en: There was a lot of hoopla surrounding the new phone launch.
examples.zh: 新手机发布时被大肆炒作,热闹非凡。

meaning: n. 雏菊

examples.en: A single marguerite pushed through the crack in the patio stones.
examples.zh: 一株雏菊从庭院石板的缝隙里钻了出来。

meaning: a. 迷人的, 有魅力的

examples.en: The guide told captivating stories about the castle's hidden rooms.
examples.zh: 导游讲了城堡密室引人入胜的故事。

meaning: n. 起草者

examples.en: The drafter revised the bridge blueprints after the engineer's review.
examples.zh: 工程师审核后,制图员修改了桥梁图纸。

meaning: a. 刺激的, 刺激性的;n. 刺激物, 刺激剂

examples.en: The strong perfume acted as an irritant to her sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 浓烈的香水对她敏感的皮肤有刺激。

meaning: 陀斯妥也夫斯基(Fedor Mikhaylovitch, 1821-1881, 俄国小说家)

examples.en: Our reading group spent a month discussing Dostoevsky's long novel.
examples.zh: 我们读书会用一个月讨论陀思妥耶夫斯基的长篇。

meaning: a. 预知的, 有先见之明的

examples.en: Her prescient warnings about the housing bubble went largely ignored.
examples.zh: 她对房产泡沫的先见之明大多被忽视。

meaning: n. 清蛋白, 白蛋白;白蛋白; 清蛋白

examples.en: The blood test measures albumin levels to check liver function.
examples.zh: 验血通过白蛋白水平来评估肝功能。

meaning: n. 万寿菊, 金盏花;金盏花

examples.en: She planted marigold seeds along the garden path in April.
examples.zh: 四月,她沿花园小径播下万寿菊种子。

meaning: v. 旋开, 旋松

examples.en: Carefully unscrew the bottle cap before shaking the salad dressing.
examples.zh: 摇沙拉酱之前,先小心拧开瓶盖。

meaning: n. 肝素;肝素

examples.en: The nurse administered a heparin injection to prevent blood clots.
examples.zh: 护士注射肝素以防止血栓。

meaning: a. 自然化的, 归化的;v. 接收（外国人）入籍( naturalize的过去式和过去分词 ); 使归化; 将（植物等）引进异域种植; 吸收

examples.en: After a decade in Lisbon, she became a naturalized Portuguese citizen.
examples.zh: 在里斯本生活十年后,她入籍成为葡萄牙公民。

meaning: n. 通气管

examples.en: We rented a snorkel and fins to explore the coral reef.
examples.zh: 我们租了呼吸管和脚蹼去探索珊瑚礁。

meaning: n. 报童, 送报人, 新闻记者

examples.en: The veteran newsman reported from war zones for thirty years.
examples.zh: 这位资深新闻记者在战地报道了三十年。

meaning: a. 多项式的, 多词学名的;n. 多项式, 多词学名

examples.en: The homework asks us to factor one polynomial into binomials.
examples.zh: 作业要求我们把一个多项式分解成二项式。

meaning: 面向商业的通用语言

examples.en: The bank still runs its oldest accounts on COBOL systems.
examples.zh: 这家银行最老的账户仍跑在COBOL系统上。

meaning: v. 使政治化, 使具有政治性( politicize的过去式和过去分词 ); 使对政治有兴趣

examples.en: The school board election became surprisingly politicized this autumn.
examples.zh: 今年秋天,校董会选举出人意料地政治化。

meaning: n. 发狂, 狂热, 热中

examples.en: She laughed about the craziness of preparing two weddings in one month.
examples.zh: 她笑谈一个月筹备两场婚礼的疯狂。

meaning: 基因改造的, 基因被改变的(gene-altered)

examples.en: The lab uses transgenic mice to study a rare gene disorder.
examples.zh: 实验室用转基因小鼠研究一种罕见基因病。

meaning: a. 手术前的;手术前的

examples.en: The nurse reviewed the preoperative instructions with the nervous patient.
examples.zh: 护士和紧张的患者一起核对了术前须知。

meaning: n. 溃疡;溃疡形成; 溃疡

examples.en: The ointment eased the ulceration caused by the ill-fitting shoes.
examples.zh: 药膏缓解了不合脚鞋子造成的溃疡。

meaning: n. 伊米莉亚(Emily的异体)(f.)

examples.en: Emilia bakes cinnamon rolls for the whole office on Fridays.
examples.zh: 埃米莉亚每周五给全办公室烤肉桂卷。

meaning: a. 顺势疗法的

examples.en: She keeps a small box of homoeopathic remedies in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她在厨房放着一小盒顺势疗法药物。

meaning: n. 陵墓, 阴森森的大厦

examples.en: The ancient mausoleum stands on a hill above the harbor town.
examples.zh: 古老的陵墓耸立在海港小镇上方的山上。

meaning: n. 巴巴罗萨(神圣罗马帝国皇帝,1155-1190)

examples.en: The history podcast retold the campaigns of Barbarossa in detail.
examples.zh: 历史播客详细讲述了巴巴罗萨的征战。

meaning: n. 纱锭, 纺锤, 轴, 心轴;vi. 变细长

examples.en: The old spinning wheel's spindle still turns smoothly.
examples.zh: 老纺车的纱锭依然转得顺滑。

meaning: n. 长尾猕猴, 食蟹猴

examples.en: Machin painted the harbor scene in soft morning light.
examples.zh: 马钦用柔和晨光画了海港景色。

meaning: n. 排字工人

examples.en: The compositor set each line of type by hand in 1900.
examples.zh: 1900年,排字工仍要手工排每一行铅字。

meaning: n. 骗子, 诈手;骗子

examples.en: The game show banned the cheater who signaled answers to contestants.
examples.zh: 节目组封杀了向选手传递答案的作弊者。

meaning: a. 相应的, 同源的, 一致的;同种的(组织,血清), 同系的(化合物), 相应的, 类似的

examples.en: The two scientists confirmed the structures were homologous across species.
examples.zh: 两位科学家证实这些结构跨物种同源。

meaning: n. 余震

examples.en: A strong aftershock rattled windows a day after the main earthquake.
examples.zh: 主震后一天,一次强余震震得窗户作响。

meaning: a. 欣快症的, 欣快的;精神愉快的, 欣快的

examples.en: The runner felt euphoric as she crossed the marathon finish line.
examples.zh: 冲过马拉松终点线时,她欣喜若狂。

meaning: n. 多肽;多肽

examples.en: Each polypeptide chain folds into a precise three-dimensional shape.
examples.zh: 每条多肽链都折叠成精确的三维形状。

meaning: a. 没有开的, 未展开的, 未启封的

examples.en: The parcel sat unopened on the kitchen table all week.
examples.zh: 包裹在餐桌上放了一周都没拆。

meaning: a. 可以再度使用的;可重复使用的; 可再用的

examples.en: Bring a reusable bottle to refill at the gym fountain.
examples.zh: 带个可重复使用的水瓶,在健身房饮水机灌水。

meaning: n. 利库德集团(以色列右翼党派的政治联盟,长期为以色列执政党)

examples.en: The reporter analyzed the Likud party's strategy before the election.
examples.zh: 记者分析了选前利库德集团的策略。

meaning: n. 斯洛文尼亚人;a. 斯洛文尼亚人的

examples.en: Her Slovene grandmother taught her to bake holiday bread at Easter.
examples.zh: 斯洛文尼亚裔祖母教她复活节烤节日面包。

meaning: n. 林下灌丛

examples.en: A rabbit darted into the thick underbrush beside the trail.
examples.zh: 一只兔子窜进小径旁茂密的灌木丛。

meaning: n. 充实, 充满

examples.en: The committee will hold a plenum meeting to vote on reforms.
examples.zh: 委员会将召开全体会议表决改革事项。

meaning: n. 流行词

examples.en: Synergy became a corporate buzzword that nobody could clearly define.
examples.zh: 协同效应成了没人说得清的公司流行语。

meaning: n. <主英> = hybridization

examples.en: The botanist explained the hybridisation of wheat and rye in class.
examples.zh: 植物学家在课上讲了小麦与黑麦的杂交。

meaning: n. 教导, 教化;教育, 教训, 灌输

examples.en: The report warned against political indoctrination in public school classrooms.
examples.zh: 报告警告公立学校课堂要防政治灌输。

meaning: n. 交火,火战,炮战

examples.en: The soldiers were exhausted after a lengthy firefight near the border.
examples.zh: 边境附近长时间交火后,士兵们精疲力尽。

meaning: n. 面筋, 麸质;谷蛋白; 面筋

examples.en: The bakery now sells gluten-free bread for sensitive customers.
examples.zh: 面包店现在为敏感顾客卖无麸质面包。

meaning: n. 芝麻菜

examples.en: Toss the arugula with lemon juice, olive oil, and pepper.
examples.zh: 把芝麻菜和柠檬汁、橄榄油、胡椒拌匀。

meaning: a. 淫荡的;淫荡的, 猥亵的

examples.en: The comedian was fined for lewd jokes on live television.
examples.zh: 那名喜剧演员因直播里的下流笑话被罚款。

meaning: n. 主管史诗、历史的女神

examples.en: Clio spent the summer cataloging photos at the city archive.
examples.zh: 克莱奥夏天在市档案馆给照片编目。

meaning: a. 圣餐的, 圣体的

examples.en: The choir practiced eucharistic hymns before the Sunday service.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在周日礼拜前练圣体颂歌。

meaning: n. 电话听筒

examples.en: My old handset still works after five years of daily use.
examples.zh: 我那部旧手机天天用,五年了还能正常工作。

meaning: a. 反应迟钝的, 感受性迟钝的, 不回答的

examples.en: The laptop screen went unresponsive during the final presentation.
examples.zh: 最终展示时,笔记本电脑屏幕没了反应。

meaning: n. 埃古(莎士比亚悲剧《奥赛罗》)

examples.en: Iago whispers lies that slowly poison Othello's trusting mind.
examples.zh: 伊阿古的谎言慢慢毒害了奥赛罗的信任。

meaning: 打气, 膨胀

examples.en: His bag was bulging with library books after the study session.
examples.zh: 自习结束后,他的书包塞满了图书馆的书。

meaning: n. 评价人, 鉴定人, 估价人;估价者, 鉴定

examples.en: The appraiser valued the old farmhouse at twice the asking price.
examples.zh: 估价师给老农舍的估值是要价的两倍。

meaning: n. 拖网渔船;拖网船, 拖网捕鱼的船, 拖网捕鱼的人

examples.en: A fishing trawler returned to port loaded with fresh herring.
examples.zh: 一艘拖网渔船满载新鲜鲱鱼返港。

meaning: n. 山羊胡子

examples.en: Uncle Ben shaved his goatee after wearing it for twenty years.
examples.zh: 本叔留了二十年山羊胡,终于剃掉了。

meaning: a. 心肌的;心肌的

examples.en: The patient recovered well after a mild myocardial infarction last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天轻度心肌梗死后,病人恢复良好。

meaning: a. 四分之一决赛的;n. 四分之一决赛

examples.en: Our team advanced to the quarterfinal after a dramatic penalty shootout.
examples.zh: 经过戏剧性的点球大战,我们队闯入四分之一决赛。

meaning: a. 地狱的, 凶恶的, 令人毛骨悚然的

examples.en: The commuters described the hellish traffic during the subway strike.
examples.zh: 地铁罢工期间,通勤者形容交通如同炼狱。

meaning: a. 单克隆的

examples.en: The hospital uses monoclonal antibodies to treat certain severe allergies.
examples.zh: 医院用单克隆抗体治疗某些严重过敏。

meaning: v. 下狱, 监禁( imprison的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The journalist was imprisoned for reporting on government corruption.
examples.zh: 那名记者因报道政府腐败而入狱。

meaning: 子单元, 子单位;亚基

examples.en: Each subunit of the protein plays a distinct role.
examples.zh: 蛋白质的每个亚基都发挥着不同作用。

meaning: 前列腺素;前列腺素(分F,E,A,B四型)

examples.en: The drug reduces prostaglandin levels to ease menstrual pain.
examples.zh: 这种药通过降低前列腺素水平来缓解痛经。

meaning: n. 致病, 发病;发病机理

examples.en: Researchers clarified the pathogenesis of the rare skin disease.
examples.zh: 研究人员阐明了这种罕见皮肤病的发病机制。

meaning: a. 打褶裥的, 起褶的

examples.en: She wore a pleated skirt and white sneakers to graduation.
examples.zh: 她穿百褶裙和白球鞋参加毕业典礼。

meaning: n. 提花机, 提花织物

examples.en: The sofa is upholstered in a rich jacquard fabric.
examples.zh: 沙发包着华贵的提花面料。

meaning: n. 都市的郊区, 郊区居民, 郊区居民所特有的风俗习惯

examples.en: The novel paints suburbia as both comfortable and quietly lonely.
examples.zh: 这部小说把郊区生活写得舒适又悄然孤独。

meaning: n. 受让人, 受托者, 代理人;受让人

examples.en: The patent assignee must be listed on the application form.
examples.zh: 专利受让人必须列在申请表上。

meaning: a. 不确定的, 危险的, 冒险性的

examples.en: Driving through the mountain pass in fog is pretty dicey.
examples.zh: 大雾天开车翻山口相当冒险。

meaning: n. 排列, 搭配, 布置

examples.en: Strong coffee is a common collocation English learners meet early.
examples.zh: 浓咖啡是英语学习者早早遇到的常见搭配。

meaning: n. 坚固, 紧密;紧度; 严密度

examples.en: Gentle stretching eased the tightness in his shoulders after work.
examples.zh: 下班后,轻柔拉伸缓解了他肩部的紧绷。

meaning: n. 放射性碳, 碳-14;放射性碳

examples.en: The lab dated the ancient basket through radiocarbon analysis.
examples.zh: 实验室用放射性碳分析测定古篮子的年代。

meaning: a. 无心的, 不是故意的;非故意的, 无意的, 无心的

examples.en: Her omission of your name was clearly unintentional, so forgive her.
examples.zh: 她漏掉你的名字显然是无意的,别怪她。

meaning: n. 凡尔登（法国东北部城市）；凡尔登（加拿大东南部城市）

examples.en: The battlefield memorial near Verdun draws visitors every November.
examples.zh: 凡尔登附近的战场纪念馆每年十一月都迎来游客。

meaning: n. 中立状态,压制,中和(作用),中和,平衡

examples.en: The treaty promised the neutralisation of the small mountain state.
examples.zh: 条约承诺让这个山地小国中立化。

meaning: 等位基因, 对偶基因

examples.en: Each parent passes one allele for eye color to a child.
examples.zh: 父母各传给孩子一个决定眼睛颜色的等位基因。

meaning: 配体; 配基

examples.en: The molecule acts as a ligand that binds the receptor.
examples.zh: 这种分子作为配体与受体结合。

meaning: adv. 乱砍乱杀, 杀气腾腾地横冲直撞;杀人狂

examples.en: The printer ran amok and spat out two hundred blank pages.
examples.zh: 打印机失控了,吐出两百张白纸。

meaning: 吉布提

examples.en: Her uncle runs a small shipping office in Djibouti.
examples.zh: 她叔叔在吉布提经营一家小航运公司。

meaning: n. 腰腿, 臀部, 腰腿肉;臀部, 胯部

examples.en: The tiger crouched on its haunches before leaping at the deer.
examples.zh: 老虎后腿蹲伏,然后扑向鹿。

meaning: a. 细胞质的;胞质的, 胞浆的

examples.en: Protein synthesis happens mostly in the cytoplasmic region of the cell.
examples.zh: 蛋白质合成主要发生在细胞的细胞质区。

meaning: n. 咯咯的叫声;v. 咯咯叫

examples.en: Hens cluck softly to their chicks in the farmyard.
examples.zh: 农家院里,母鸡轻声咯咯呼唤小鸡。

meaning: a. 心室的, 膨胀的

examples.en: The cardiologist monitored the patient's ventricular rhythm after surgery.
examples.zh: 术后,心脏科医生监测患者的心室节律。

meaning: n. 弹拨(声);v. 漫不经心地弹, 漫不经心地奏

examples.en: He would strum his guitar while we sang around the campfire.
examples.zh: 我们围着篝火唱歌时,他就弹吉他伴奏。

meaning: a. 周壁的, 体壁的, 顶骨的, 侧膜的;n. 顶骨

examples.en: The scan showed activity in the parietal lobe during the puzzle.
examples.zh: 扫描显示,解谜时顶叶出现活动。

meaning: n. 顺势疗法

examples.en: Some patients prefer homoeopathy alongside their regular medical treatment.
examples.zh: 一些患者在常规治疗之外还偏好顺势疗法。

meaning: a. 中间的, 平均的, 普通的;n. 中间字母

examples.en: The striker felt a sharp medial pain in his left knee.
examples.zh: 前锋感到左膝内侧一阵剧痛。

meaning: n. (=deemster)英国曼岛的法官(共两位)

examples.en: Dempster loaded the delivery van before sunrise each morning.
examples.zh: 登普斯特每天日出前装好送货面包车。

meaning: n. 装饰衣服用的金属或塑料小圆片

examples.en: The designer sewed each tiny sequin onto the gown by hand.
examples.zh: 设计师手工把每片小亮片缝上礼服。

meaning: v. 修补( botch的过去式和过去分词 ); 搞坏, 搞砸, 笨拙地做

examples.en: The botched haircut made her wear hats for a month.
examples.zh: 剪坏的发型让她戴了一个月帽子。

meaning: a. 一致的, 符合的, 巧合的

examples.en: Meeting my old roommate in Tokyo was purely coincidental.
examples.zh: 在东京遇到老室友纯属巧合。

meaning: a. 顶端的;尖的, 尖端的

examples.en: The gardener trimmed the apical bud to make the bush wider.
examples.zh: 园丁修剪顶芽,让灌木长得更宽。

meaning: 尸体防腐者

examples.en: The ancient embalmer prepared the pharaoh's body with great care.
examples.zh: 古代防腐师精心处理法老的遗体。

meaning: vt. 赋予人性, 教化, 使通人情;vi. 变为有人性, 变得有情, 有教化

examples.en: The documentary tries to humanize the refugees behind the statistics.
examples.zh: 纪录片想让数字背后的难民有血有肉。

meaning: 错误知觉

examples.en: A common misperception is that lightning never strikes the same place.
examples.zh: 常见误解是闪电不会两次击中同一地点。

meaning: n. 油桐

examples.en: The tung seeds were pressed to make oil for wood finishing.
examples.zh: 桐树籽被榨成油,用于木器涂装。

meaning: n. 柯利牧羊狗

examples.en: The energetic collie herded the sheep across the misty field.
examples.zh: 活力充沛的牧羊犬把羊群赶过雾蒙蒙的田野。

meaning: n. 地形

examples.en: The students modeled each landform in clay for geography class.
examples.zh: 地理课上,学生们用黏土捏出各种地貌。

meaning: a. 过去的, 以往的, 死了的

examples.en: The guests departed quietly after the long farewell dinner.
examples.zh: 告别晚宴结束后,客人们悄悄离去。

meaning: n. 猪油;vt. 涂加猪油, 夹杂, 润色

examples.en: Grandmother fried the potatoes in lard for extra flavor.
examples.zh: 祖母用猪油煎土豆,味道更香。

meaning: n. 超自我

examples.en: In Freud's theory, the superego acts like an inner moral judge.
examples.zh: 在弗洛伊德的理论里,超我像内心的道德法官。

meaning: n. 组胺;麦胺; 组胺

examples.en: Antihistamines block the histamine released during an allergic reaction.
examples.zh: 抗组胺药阻断过敏时释放的组胺。

meaning: n. 豆科灌木（产于美国西南部和墨西哥）

examples.en: The chef grilled the steak over fragrant mesquite wood.
examples.zh: 厨师用芬芳的牧豆木烤牛排。

meaning: abbr. 争取散装啤酒运动（Campaign for Real Ale）

examples.en: Dad joined CAMRA to support traditional local breweries.
examples.zh: 爸爸加入了真麦酒运动,支持当地传统酒厂。

meaning: n. 塞布丽娜(f.)

examples.en: Sabrina organized a book swap for the entire apartment building.
examples.zh: 萨布丽娜为整栋公寓楼组织了换书活动。

meaning: 大, 头状骨

examples.en: The sommelier opened a magnum of champagne for the anniversary toast.
examples.zh: 侍酒师为周年祝酒开了一大瓶香槟。

meaning: n. 拉紧的绳索

examples.en: The mayor walks a tightrope between growth and preserving green space.
examples.zh: 市长在发展与护绿之间走钢丝。

meaning: n. 地形学

examples.en: She studies geomorphology, especially how rivers carve valleys over centuries.
examples.zh: 她研究地貌学,尤其关注河流如何冲出峡谷。

meaning: a. 一夫一妻制的

examples.en: Swans are famously monogamous, often pairing for life.
examples.zh: 天鹅以终身一夫一妻而闻名。

meaning: a. 二叠纪的, 二叠纪岩的;n. 二叠纪(岩)

examples.en: The Permian extinction wiped out most marine species long ago.
examples.zh: 二叠纪大灭绝很久前消灭了多数海洋物种。

meaning: 连通性, 连通度

examples.en: The mountain cabin finally got reliable internet connectivity this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天,山间小屋终于有了稳定网络。

meaning: a. 匆忙的, 仓促的, 草率的

examples.en: She hurried past the bakery to resist the smell of bread.
examples.zh: 她快步走过面包店,免得被面包香诱惑。

meaning: 磷酸化作用;磷酸化

examples.en: The paper describes how phosphorylation switches the enzyme on and off.
examples.zh: 论文描述了磷酸化如何开关这种酶。

meaning: n. （印度）人民团体；人民党（印度联合政党）

examples.en: The Janata coalition struggled to hold its members together.
examples.zh: 人民党联盟难以维系内部团结。

meaning: n. 倾斜, 倾向, 爱好

examples.en: The tower's slight leaning has drawn tourists for centuries.
examples.zh: 塔身轻微的倾斜几个世纪来吸引着游客。

meaning: n. 色姆(国会)(波兰的国家立法机构)

examples.en: The Polish Sejm debated the budget law late into the night.
examples.zh: 波兰议会就预算法案辩论到深夜。

meaning: a. 没有受伤的, 没有受害的, 无恙的, 平安的

examples.en: The hikers emerged from the storm unharmed but completely soaked.
examples.zh: 徒步者安然无恙地走出暴风雨,只是全身湿透。

meaning: n. 脑桥;桥, 脑桥

examples.en: The scan focused on the pons at the base of the brain.
examples.zh: 扫描聚焦于脑底部的脑桥。

meaning: v. 假扮( disguise的过去式和过去分词 ); 化装; 伪装; 掩盖

examples.en: The reporter disguised herself as a factory worker to film conditions.
examples.zh: 记者假扮工人,偷拍车间劳动条件。

meaning: a. 原姓...的, 原名...的;氖(10元素)

examples.en: They drove through NE on their way to Colorado.
examples.zh: 他们穿越内布拉斯加州前往科罗拉多。

meaning: n. (对野生动物、自然区、古迹和传统事物等的)保护主义者

examples.en: The preservationist fought to save the century-old train station.
examples.zh: 文物保护人士奋力拯救百年火车站。

meaning: n. 车前草, 大蕉;车前草

examples.en: She fried sweet plantain slices as a side for dinner.
examples.zh: 她炸了大蕉片当晚餐配菜。

meaning: n. 当当声, 铿锵声;vi. 发出当当声, 发铿锵声

examples.en: The heavy iron gate would clang shut every evening.
examples.zh: 每天傍晚,沉重的铁门都会哐当一声关上。

meaning: v. 判断错

examples.en: Don't misjudge her quietness; she has very firm opinions.
examples.zh: 别把她的安静看错,她其实很有主见。

meaning: interj. 瞧, 看

examples.en: Lo and behold, the missing keys were in my coat pocket.
examples.zh: 你瞧,丢了的钥匙就在我大衣口袋里。

meaning: n. 杂音;杂音, 吹气音

examples.en: The cheese souffle collapsed just before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到之前,奶酪舒芙蕾恰好塌了。

meaning: n. 储藏室, 库房;仓库货栈, 储藏室

examples.en: The janitor keeps the cleaning supplies in a locked storeroom.
examples.zh: 门卫把清洁用品锁在储藏室里。

meaning: n. 底板, 母板;母板, 主板

examples.en: The technician replaced the fried motherboard in my desktop computer.
examples.zh: 技术员换掉了我台式电脑烧坏的主板。

meaning: a. 未经审问的, 未经调查的, 无异议的, 不被怀疑的;不成问题的, 无疑的, 未被调查的

examples.en: For years, his authority in the lab went unquestioned.
examples.zh: 多年来,他在实验室的权威从未受质疑。

meaning: n. 小鸡, 母鸡, 下女, 女佣

examples.en: A yellow biddy cheeped loudly inside the warm incubator.
examples.zh: 一只黄色小鸡在温暖的孵化器里叽叽叫。

meaning: n. 次长, 副部长

examples.en: The undersecretary announced new funding for rural hospitals.
examples.zh: 次官宣布为乡村医院拨新资金。

meaning: a. 失事的（船）；迷幻的, 兴奋的

examples.en: The storm wrecked our camping plans for the second weekend.
examples.zh: 暴风雨毁了我们第二个周末的露营计划。

meaning: n. 梅罗文加王朝的王;a. 梅罗文加王朝的

examples.en: The museum displays delicate Merovingian gold jewelry from the sixth century.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出六世纪精美的墨洛温金饰。

meaning: n. 莫拉(Mary的异体)(f.)

examples.en: Maura tapes her practice interviews to hear how she speaks.
examples.zh: 莫拉录下模拟面试,听听自己说话的样子。

meaning: interj. 啊唷

examples.en: Ow! I stubbed my toe on the coffee table.
examples.zh: 哎哟!我的脚趾撞到茶几上了。

meaning: n. 杂交, 配种, 杂种培殖;杂化; 杂交

examples.en: Modern wheat arose through hybridization of older grass species.
examples.zh: 现代小麦由更古老的草本植物杂交而来。

meaning: 放大的

examples.en: Grandpa uses a magnifying glass to read the fine print.
examples.zh: 爷爷用放大镜阅读小字。

meaning: vi. 混响；余响

examples.en: The guitarist added reverb to make the empty hall sound bigger.
examples.zh: 吉他手加了混响,让空礼堂更显辽阔。

meaning: n. 稻草人, 衣衫褴褛的人

examples.en: The farmer placed a ragged scarecrow among the young corn plants.
examples.zh: 农夫在玉米苗中间立了个破旧稻草人。

meaning: a. 松软的, 水分过多的, 流鼻涕的

examples.en: The runny egg yolk soaked perfectly into the hot rice.
examples.zh: 流心蛋黄完美渗进了热米饭。

meaning: n. (苏格兰)冰上溜石游戏, 头发的拳曲, 蜷缩

examples.en: She watched the curling competition during the Winter Olympics.
examples.zh: 冬奥会期间,她看了冰壶比赛。

meaning: n. 所罗门王

examples.en: The novel follows Bathsheba as she manages her inherited farm.
examples.zh: 小说讲述芭丝谢芭经营继承农场的经历。

meaning: a. 具有涡卷装饰的；弯曲的

examples.en: He scrolled through his phone while waiting for the train.
examples.zh: 等火车时,他一直刷着手机。

meaning: n. 初见陆地, 到达陆地, 着陆

examples.en: The hurricane made landfall south of the fishing village at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分,飓风在渔村以南登陆。

meaning: adv. 合作地

examples.en: The two labs worked cooperatively to develop the rapid test.
examples.zh: 两家实验室合作开发快速检测。

meaning: 染色体组的

examples.en: Scientists compared the genomic data of wolves and domestic dogs.
examples.zh: 科学家比较了狼与家犬的基因组数据。

meaning: a. 不诚实的, 不忠实的;不正当的, 不信实的, 不正确的

examples.en: She left the relationship after discovering her unfaithful partner's messages.
examples.zh: 发现伴侣不忠的短信后,她结束了这段感情。

meaning: n. 薄板, 薄片, 薄层, 叶片;板, 层, 叶片(植物)

examples.en: Each thin lamina of the shell bends without breaking.
examples.zh: 贝壳的每一层薄片都能弯曲而不断。

meaning: n. 痘病, 痘, 瘟疫;痘, 梅毒(俗名)

examples.en: The diary described a pox outbreak in the village long ago.
examples.zh: 日记描述了很久以前村里的一次痘疫。

meaning: adv. 陡峭地, 陡然地, 出乎意料地

examples.en: The trail drops precipitously toward the turquoise lake below.
examples.zh: 小径陡然下落,直抵下方碧绿的湖。

meaning: n. 灌注, 充满;灌注

examples.en: The scan showed normal perfusion of blood through the heart muscle.
examples.zh: 扫描显示心肌血流灌注正常。

meaning: a. 达不到的, 碰不着的, 管不到的, 不可批评的, 碰不得的, 不可捉摸的, 无形的

examples.en: The champions seemed untouchable, winning every match that season.
examples.zh: 那个赛季冠军队场场获胜,似乎无可撼动。

meaning: 颊, 颧骨

examples.en: She counts each breath with a strand of mala beads.
examples.zh: 她用一串念珠数着每一次呼吸。

meaning: n. 否定性, 消极性

examples.en: The coach asked the team to drop its negativity after halftime.
examples.zh: 中场休息后,教练要求球队摒弃消极情绪。

meaning: a. 浮在表面的;上层的, 上层清液

examples.en: The technician carefully pipetted the clear supernatant off the top.
examples.zh: 技术员小心地吸走上层清液。

meaning: n. 电感, 感应系数;电感

examples.en: The physics demo measured the inductance of a simple copper coil.
examples.zh: 物理演示测量了简单铜线圈的电感。

meaning: n. （无线电）固定播送时间

examples.en: Check the sched before booking your flight home.
examples.zh: 订回家的航班前,先看看日程表。

meaning: a. 弯曲的

examples.en: They walked the curving road up to the lighthouse at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时,他们沿着弯路走上灯塔。

meaning: a. 直接证明的

examples.en: Words like here and now are deictic, pointing to the context.
examples.zh: 像这里、现在这样的词是指示词,依赖语境。

meaning: a. 嗜中性的;n. 嗜中性白细胞, 嗜中性白血球

examples.en: A neutrophil is often the first cell to reach a wound.
examples.zh: 中性粒细胞往往是到达伤口的第一种细胞。

meaning: n. 警戒, 机敏

examples.en: Short naps improved the pilots' alertness on long flights.
examples.zh: 小睡提升了飞行员长途飞行的警觉度。

meaning: a. 类鸦片（引起）的;n. 类鸦片活性肽

examples.en: The clinic offers alternatives to opioid painkillers after surgery.
examples.zh: 诊所提供术后阿片类止痛药的替代方案。

meaning: a. 祭司的

examples.en: He inherited the priestly duty of tending the temple flame.
examples.zh: 他继承了照看圣殿火种的祭司职责。

meaning: adv. 神学地, 神学上地

examples.en: The debate was theologically complex but full of warmth and respect.
examples.zh: 这场辩论神学上复杂,却充满温情与尊重。

meaning: a. 月光照耀的

examples.en: They paddled across the moonlit lake toward the small island.
examples.zh: 他们划过月光粼粼的湖面,朝小岛去。

meaning: n. 费金(狄更斯小说中的人物), (教唆儿童犯罪的)教唆犯;山毛榉素

examples.en: The villain Fagin trains orphans to pick pockets in the novel.
examples.zh: 小说里,反派费金训练孤儿扒窃。

meaning: n. 样品, 样本

examples.en: The painter held a fabric swatch against the living room wall.
examples.zh: 油漆匠拿织物小样比对客厅墙面。

meaning: n. 执行委员会;主席团, 常务委员会

examples.en: The congress elected a new presidium to oversee the reforms.
examples.zh: 大会选举了新主席团来监督改革。

meaning: n. 那鸿希伯莱的先知, 那鸿书

examples.en: Nahum prophesied the fall of a great ancient city.
examples.zh: 那鸿预言了一座古代大城的陷落。

meaning: n. 切除术;切除

examples.en: The surgeon performed a bowel resection to remove the blockage.
examples.zh: 外科医生做了肠切除手术来清除梗阻。

meaning: 妥协, 让步的, 缺乏抵抗力的, 缺乏免疫力的, 妥协的

examples.en: The firewall failed because the admin's password was compromised.
examples.zh: 由于管理员密码泄露,防火墙失效了。

meaning: n. (定冠词、指示代词等的)指示功能, 直示(系统)

examples.en: The linguistics lecture covered deixis in spoken and signed languages.

examples.zh: 地质学家绘制了干谷地下的矿化带。

examples.zh: 这所大学运营老龄化研究数据交换中心。

examples.zh: 辣餐过后,我们以冰凉柠檬雪葩收尾。

examples.zh: 她跨骑灰马,朝教练咧嘴笑。

meaning: a. 魁伟的, 巨大的;n. 绑扎法, 裹伤胶带, 鞭打

examples.en: A strapping young firefighter carried the grandmother down six flights.
examples.zh: 一位魁梧的年轻消防员背着老奶奶下了六层楼。

meaning: n. 十分, 完全；彻底

examples.en: Her thoroughness caught two errors nobody else had noticed.
examples.zh: 她的细致发现了别人都没注意的两处错误。

meaning: a. 可做的, 切实可行的

examples.en: Finishing the report by Friday is tight but doable.
examples.zh: 周五前完成报告虽然紧张,但可行。

meaning: n. 划分者, 分隔物, 间壁;除法器

examples.en: The librarian placed a low divider between the study desks.
examples.zh: 图书管理员在自习桌间装了低隔板。

meaning: vt.用链锯割,<喻>肢解

examples.en: The groundskeeper started the chainsaw to clear the fallen branches.
examples.zh: 园丁启动电锯,清理断落的树枝。

meaning: n. 剧痛, 阵痛;剧痛

examples.en: The old empire collapsed in the final throes of war.
examples.zh: 旧帝国在战争的最后阵痛中崩溃。

meaning: a. <美><加> 闪光的, 耀眼的, 眩目的

examples.en: They stayed at a glitzy hotel with a rooftop pool.
examples.zh: 他们住在一家带屋顶泳池的浮华酒店。

meaning: a. 为残疾人设计的

examples.en: Assistive software lets him type by tracking eye movements.
examples.zh: 辅助软件让他通过眼球追踪打字。

meaning: a. 可消费的, 消耗性的, 可牺牲的, 值得消耗的, 可消耗的;n. 消耗物, 可牺牲的人, 可牺牲的物

examples.en: The villain treated his crew as expendable pawns in the scheme.
examples.zh: 反派把手下当作阴谋中可牺牲的棋子。

meaning: n. 短暂, 简短

examples.en: The report's brevity made it easy for everyone to read.
examples.zh: 报告的简短让大家都容易阅读。

meaning: a. 弥赛亚的

examples.en: The young leader had a messianic zeal for changing the world.
examples.zh: 这位年轻领袖有着改变世界的救世主般热情。

meaning: 多用途的, 通用的, 多功能的

examples.en: We bought a multipurpose cleaner for the kitchen and bathroom.
examples.zh: 我们买了一瓶厨房浴室都适用的多功能清洁剂。

meaning: adv. 惊人地

examples.en: The two strangers had startlingly similar childhood stories.
examples.zh: 那两个陌生人的童年故事惊人地相似。

meaning: a. 颤动的, 抖动的

examples.en: Her hands were quivering as she opened the exam results.
examples.zh: 她打开考试成绩时，双手在发抖。

meaning: n. 松脂, 松木油, 松节油;vt. 涂以松节油

examples.en: The painter cleaned her brushes with turpentine after finishing the portrait.
examples.zh: 画家画完肖像后，用松节油清洗画笔。

meaning: vt. 解开, 拆开

examples.en: You must disassemble the bike before shipping it overseas.
examples.zh: 你必须先把自行车拆开才能运往海外。

meaning: adv. 肃静地, 沉默地

examples.en: The two companies tacitly agreed not to cut prices further.
examples.zh: 两家公司心照不宣地同意不再降价。

meaning: a. 无毒的

examples.en: Parents prefer nontoxic paint for their children's bedroom walls.
examples.zh: 父母喜欢给孩子卧室的墙面用无毒涂料。

meaning: a. 无法了解的, 难解的, 莫明其妙的

examples.en: The lecture was so technical that it sounded unintelligible to beginners.
examples.zh: 讲座太专业，初学者听着一头雾水。

meaning: n. 声明, 断言, 反对, 抗议;抗议, 异议, 反对

examples.en: Despite his protestation of innocence, nobody believed a word.
examples.zh: 尽管他声明自己清白，但没人相信。

meaning: n. 受雇暴徒, 愚笨者, 呆子

examples.en: The villain sent a goon to scare the shop owner.
examples.zh: 反派派了一个打手去吓唬店主。

meaning: n. 占卜, 卜卦, 预测

examples.en: The ancient Chinese used divination to predict important events.
examples.zh: 中国古人用占卜来预测重大事件。

meaning: 靠模机, 靠模切削

examples.en: The police were accused of racial profiling at traffic stops.
examples.zh: 警方被指控在交通拦截中进行种族定性。

meaning: a. 生苔的, 似苔的, 陈腐的

examples.en: A narrow mossy path led up to the old temple.
examples.zh: 一条长满青苔的小径通向古庙。

meaning: vt. 使受喜爱, 使受钟爱

examples.en: Her warm smile will endear her to new classmates quickly.
examples.zh: 她热情的微笑会很快让新同学喜欢上她。

meaning: n. 柔滑, 平滑, 平坦;平稳性; 平稳度

examples.en: The smoothness of the chocolate made it melt on the tongue.
examples.zh: 巧克力的丝滑口感让它入口即化。

meaning: adv. 浪漫地, 小说般地, 空想地

examples.en: The couple walked romantically along the beach under the moonlight.
examples.zh: 这对情侣在月光下浪漫地沿着海滩散步。

meaning: 协同操作

examples.en: The two departments are cooperating on the new research project.
examples.zh: 两个部门正在新研究项目上开展合作。

meaning: n. 隐匿处

examples.en: The police finally discovered the robber's hideout in the mountains.
examples.zh: 警方终于在山里找到了劫匪的藏身处。

meaning: a. 生活过得有价值的, (生活)过得去的, 值得过的, 适于居住的

examples.en: Fresh paint and new furniture made the old apartment livable again.
examples.zh: 新刷的油漆和新家具让旧公寓重新宜居。

meaning: n. 源头, 上游

examples.en: The expedition followed the river up to its headwaters.
examples.zh: 探险队沿着河流一路上行到源头。

meaning: a. 超人的, 人类能力所不能及的

examples.en: It took superhuman effort to finish the marathon in that heat.
examples.zh: 那样的高温下跑完马拉松需要超人的毅力。

meaning: n. 全息照相图;全息照相, 全息图

examples.en: The museum used a hologram to show the famous singer performing.
examples.zh: 博物馆用全息图展示那位著名歌手的演唱。

meaning: a. 不流行的, 不时髦的, 过时的

examples.en: His unfashionable jacket still keeps him warm every winter.
examples.zh: 他那件过时的夹克每年冬天仍能保暖。

meaning: adv. 无意中, 非存心地, 不知不觉地

examples.en: They unknowingly left the campsite gate open all night.
examples.zh: 他们无意中让营地大门开了一整夜。

meaning: n. 创造宇宙说, 特别创造说

examples.en: The science teacher explained why creationism is not a scientific theory.
examples.zh: 科学老师解释了神创论为何不是科学理论。

meaning: v. (使)上岸, (使)登陆

examples.en: Passengers will disembark from the ferry at nine tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 乘客们明天上午九点走下渡轮。

meaning: n. 固体性, 坚硬, 坚固, 稳健, 体积

examples.en: The solidity of the old bridge impressed every visiting engineer.
examples.zh: 老桥的坚固给每位来访的工程师留下深刻印象。

meaning: n. 墓石, 墓碑

examples.en: Each gravestone in the yard told a family's story.
examples.zh: 墓园里的每块墓碑都讲述着一个家族的故事。

meaning: n. 以取得优势的开局棋法, 开场白, 话题

examples.en: Offering free coffee was her opening gambit to attract customers.
examples.zh: 提供免费咖啡是她吸引顾客的开场策略。

meaning: a. 退步的, 退化的, 变质的;变性的, 退化的, 变质的

examples.en: Grandpa struggles with a degenerative disease that affects his memory.
examples.zh: 爷爷患有一种影响记忆的退行性疾病。

meaning: a. 漫不经心的, 非故意的

examples.en: An inadvertent click deleted his entire homework document.
examples.zh: 一次不小心的点击删掉了他的整份作业。

meaning: n. 废品旧货栈

examples.en: The old car was finally sold to the local junkyard.
examples.zh: 那辆旧车最终被卖给了当地的废品回收场。

meaning: n. 裂缝, 裂隙

examples.en: She cleaned every nook and cranny before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到来之前，她把每个角落都打扫干净。

meaning: a. 缺乏想象力的, 无趣的

examples.en: The unimaginative menu offered the same three dishes every week.
examples.zh: 这份缺乏创意的菜单每周都是同样的三道菜。

meaning: a. 关节脱位的, 脱臼的, 脱节的, 没有条理的, 次序混乱的, 杂乱的, 支离的;不交的

examples.en: His disjointed speech confused most of the audience.
examples.zh: 他杂乱无章的演讲让多数听众一头雾水。

meaning: a. 过分热忱的

examples.en: The overzealous fan waited outside the hotel all night.
examples.zh: 那个过分狂热的粉丝在酒店外等了一整夜。

meaning: n. 玉米粉蒸肉

examples.en: Grandmother taught us how to wrap a tamale with corn dough.
examples.zh: 祖母教我们用玉米面团包玉米粉蒸肉。

meaning: adv. 刻苦地；勤勉地

examples.en: She assiduously practiced the piano for two hours daily.
examples.zh: 她每天勤勉地练习两小时钢琴。

meaning: n. 生来就有的权利, 长子继承权

examples.en: Education should be every child's birthright, not a privilege.
examples.zh: 教育应是每个孩子与生俱来的权利，而非特权。

meaning: n. 方阵, 密集队列, 密集的人群(或兽群), 指骨, 趾骨;指骨

examples.en: A phalanx of reporters waited outside the courtroom doors.
examples.zh: 一大群记者密密麻麻地等在法庭门口。

meaning: adv. 潜意识地

examples.en: He subconsciously checked his phone whenever he felt nervous.
examples.zh: 他一紧张就会下意识地看手机。

meaning: v. 歪曲( skew的过去式和过去分词 ); 曲解; 使不公允; 影响…的准确性

examples.en: The survey results were skewed because only young people answered.
examples.zh: 调查结果有偏差，因为只有年轻人作答。

meaning: n. 转移, 新陈代谢, 移位变化;移位变化; 失α-微粒变化; 转移

examples.en: The doctors found no metastasis after the latest scan.
examples.zh: 最新扫描显示没有出现肿瘤转移。

meaning: n. 解放者, 释放者

examples.en: The statue honors the liberator who freed the slaves.
examples.zh: 这座雕像纪念解放奴隶的那位解放者。

meaning: a. 不愿的, 勉强的

examples.en: He gave a grudging apology after losing the argument.
examples.zh: 输掉争论后，他不情愿地道了歉。

meaning: n. 货车运输业；货车运输；以货易货

examples.en: He worked in trucking for twenty years before retiring.
examples.zh: 他在货运行业干了二十年后退休。

meaning: a. 可称誉的, 声誉好的, 可信的

examples.en: The team earned a creditable draw against the champions.
examples.zh: 球队战平卫冕冠军，表现值得称赞。

meaning: a. 定向的；经指导的；被控制的

examples.en: She directed the school play with patience and humor.
examples.zh: 她以耐心和幽默执导了校园话剧。

meaning: 打碎, 捶薄, 混合

examples.en: The ship took a battering from the storm last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚那艘船在暴风雨中饱受摧残。

meaning: n. 带步人, 标兵, 起搏器;起搏点, 起搏器

examples.en: Grandfather's new pacemaker keeps his heart beating steadily.
examples.zh: 爷爷的新起搏器让心脏稳定跳动。

meaning: a. 不神圣的, 不虔诚的, 邪恶的

examples.en: The kids made an unholy mess in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 孩子们把厨房弄得一团糟。

meaning: a. 可忍受的, 支承得住的

examples.en: Good music makes the long bus ride bearable.
examples.zh: 好听的音乐让漫长的车程变得可以忍受。

meaning: n. 滴答响的东西, 断续器;股票行情自动收录器

examples.en: He checks the stock ticker on his phone every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上都在手机上查看股票行情。

meaning: n. 一把, 相当大的数量

examples.en: The boy pulled a fistful of coins from his pocket.
examples.zh: 男孩从口袋里掏出一把硬币。

meaning: adv. 在地区范围内, 地区性地

examples.en: The company sells its furniture regionally before expanding nationwide.
examples.zh: 这家公司先在地区内销售家具，再向全国扩展。

meaning: n. 不注意, 粗心, 疏忽

examples.en: The accident was caused by the driver's brief inattention.
examples.zh: 事故是司机一时疏忽造成的。

meaning: a. 有视力的, 不盲的

examples.en: The charity pairs sighted volunteers with blind runners every weekend.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构每周末为盲人跑者搭配明眼志愿者。

meaning: adv. 谦逊地, 卑贱地, 低声下气地

examples.en: He humbly accepted the award and thanked his whole team.
examples.zh: 他谦逊地领奖，并感谢了整个团队。

meaning: adv. 任性固执地; 蓄意地

examples.en: She wilfully ignored every rule the teacher set.
examples.zh: 她故意无视老师定下的每条规矩。

meaning: n. 巨型独石, 大独石碑

examples.en: A weathered monolith stands at the center of the plaza.
examples.zh: 一块风化的巨石立在广场中央。

meaning: n. 掸子, 打扫灰尘的人

examples.en: She used a feather duster to clean the bookshelves.
examples.zh: 她用鸡毛掸子清洁书架。

meaning: n. 消灭, 根绝

examples.en: The farmers used traps for the extermination of rats.
examples.zh: 农民们用捕鼠器来消灭田里的老鼠。

meaning: n. 油漆的表面
