examples.en: Years of sunshine had damaged the paintwork on the fence.
examples.zh: 多年的日晒损坏了栅栏上的漆面。

meaning: n. 不相关, 离题, 不相关的事物(言论);不相关性, 不恰当组合

examples.en: The old rule faded into irrelevance after the internet arrived.
examples.zh: 互联网出现后，旧规则渐渐变得无关紧要。

meaning: n. 狂欢者, 欢宴者

examples.en: A cheerful reveler handed out candy during the parade.
examples.zh: 游行队伍里，一位狂欢者开心地分发糖果。

meaning: a. 潦草的, 刺痛的, 发痒的, 凑合的, 发擦刮声的, 乖戾的

examples.en: His scratchy handwriting made the note hard to read.
examples.zh: 他潦草的笔迹让便条很难辨认。

meaning: n. 超级高速公路

examples.en: The new superhighway cut the travel time in half.
examples.zh: 新的超级高速公路使行程时间缩短一半。

meaning: adv. 悲惨地

examples.en: The picnic turned disastrously wrong when the rain arrived.
examples.zh: 一场大雨把野餐搞得一片狼藉。

meaning: vi. 使劲地嚼, 格格地咬

examples.en: The horse began to chomp happily on the fresh apples.
examples.zh: 马儿开心地大嚼新鲜的苹果。

meaning: n. 钟表装置, 发条装置;时钟开关

examples.en: The antique clockwork bird sings when you turn its key.
examples.zh: 拧动钥匙，那只古董发条鸟就会唱歌。

meaning: a. 浆硬的, 拘泥刻板的

examples.en: The chef wore a starched white uniform in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 大厨在厨房里穿着浆得笔挺的白制服。

meaning: n. 熄灭者, 灭火器, 消灭者;灭火器; 灭火剂

examples.en: Every floor of the office has a red fire extinguisher.
examples.zh: 办公楼每层都有一个红色灭火器。

meaning: a. 含糖的, 糖一般的, 甜的

examples.en: The dentist told him to cut down on sugary drinks.
examples.zh: 牙医让他少喝含糖饮料。

meaning: n. 调整员, 调停者, 调节器;调节器; 校正器

examples.en: The insurance adjuster inspected the damaged roof yesterday.
examples.zh: 保险理算员昨天检查了受损的屋顶。

meaning: n. 重新估计, 重新评价;重新估价

examples.en: The museum's collection deserves a fresh reappraisal by modern scholars.
examples.zh: 博物馆的藏品值得现代学者重新评价。

meaning: adv. 充满危险地, 危机四伏地

examples.en: The hikers walked perilously close to the cliff edge.
examples.zh: 徒步者们走到了离悬崖边极近的地方。

meaning: n. 隐匿, 隐蔽, 躲藏;隐瞒, 匿报

examples.en: The soldier used leaves for concealment behind the old wall.
examples.zh: 士兵用树叶在旧墙后隐蔽自己。

meaning: a. 攻不破的, 不容置疑的, 无懈可击的;无可反驳的, 无懈可击的

examples.en: Her argument was backed by facts and seemed unassailable.
examples.zh: 她的论点有事实支撑，似乎无懈可击。

meaning: n. 呼吸暂停, 窒息;呼吸暂停, 窒息

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed his loud snoring as sleep apnea.
examples.zh: 医生诊断他响亮的打鼾为睡眠呼吸暂停。

meaning: 三齿嵩

examples.en: The high desert plain was covered with silvery sagebrush.
examples.zh: 高原荒漠上长满了银色的三齿蒿。

meaning: adv. 无条件地

examples.en: Her parents loved her unconditionally through every mistake.
examples.zh: 无论她犯什么错，父母都无条件地爱她。

meaning: a. 服务不周到的,服务水平低下的

examples.en: Mobile clinics bring care to underserved rural communities.
examples.zh: 流动诊所为服务不足的农村社区送去医疗。

meaning: n. 诊断学, 症候, 症状;诊断学

examples.en: The mechanic ran diagnostics to find the engine problem.
examples.zh: 修车工运行诊断程序来查找发动机故障。

meaning: vt.vi. 使地方化, 使具有地方性, 使限制于局部, 确定起源, 集中, 局限;局部化, 定位, 定域

examples.en: Doctors must localize the infection before starting treatment.
examples.zh: 医生必须先确定感染部位再开始治疗。

meaning: adv. 不可测量地, 无限地, 广大无边地

examples.en: Her encouragement improved my confidence immeasurably over the years.
examples.zh: 这些年，她的鼓励极大地提升了我的自信。

meaning: a. 多花的, 绚丽的, 华丽的

examples.en: He gave a long, flowery speech full of big words.
examples.zh: 他发表了一篇辞藻华丽的长篇演讲。

meaning: n. 双重性, 二元论;二元论

examples.en: The philosophy seminar discussed the mind-body dualism at length.
examples.zh: 哲学研讨会深入讨论了身心二元论。

meaning: a. 莫测高深的, 深不可测的, 无底的

examples.en: The depth of the ocean trench remains unfathomable to most people.
examples.zh: 大多数人仍觉得海沟的深度深不可测。

meaning: n. 掘, 选择, 挑选, 采摘, 撬开, 采得物, 捡得物, 赃物, 扒窃物;挑拣

examples.en: September is the best month for picking apples here.
examples.zh: 九月是这里采摘苹果的最佳月份。

meaning: n. 载重马, 做重活的人

examples.en: That old truck has been the farm's workhorse for decades.
examples.zh: 那辆旧卡车几十年来一直是农场的主力。

meaning: a. 尖的

examples.en: The kitten's ears are small and pointy like triangles.
examples.zh: 小猫的耳朵又小又尖，像三角形。

meaning: n. 严格的素食主义者;绝对素食者

examples.en: My sister became a vegan and stopped eating all animal products.
examples.zh: 我姐姐成了严格素食者，不吃任何动物制品。

meaning: n. 背包旅行者

examples.en: A backpacker asked us for directions to the hostel.
examples.zh: 一名背包客向我们打听去旅舍的路。

meaning: n. 粗麻布;粗麻布

examples.en: The farmer packed the onions in rough burlap sacks.
examples.zh: 农民用粗糙的麻袋装洋葱。

meaning: n. 反主流文化

examples.en: The 1960s counterculture changed music, fashion, and politics.
examples.zh: 二十世纪六十年代的反主流文化改变了音乐、时尚和政治。

meaning: n. 交换, 更动, 排列;排列

examples.en: She tried every permutation of the letters to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 她尝试了字母的每一种排列来解开谜题。

meaning: n. 公园道路, 驾车专用道路

examples.en: We took the scenic parkway instead of the busy highway.
examples.zh: 我们走了风景优美的景观大道，避开了繁忙的高速公路。

meaning: vt. 改种, 在...再植, 使移居

examples.en: Volunteers helped replant trees after the forest fire.
examples.zh: 森林大火后，志愿者帮忙重新种树。

meaning: n. 肯定, 赞成, 赞成票;赞成票, 投赞成票者, 赞成者

examples.en: The committee voted yea on the new library budget.
examples.zh: 委员会就新图书馆预算投了赞成票。

meaning: n. 无力, 无能为力

examples.en: She felt deep powerlessness watching her savings disappear.
examples.zh: 看着积蓄消失，她深感无能为力。

meaning: n. 水蛭, 吸血鬼, 榨取他人利益的人;vt. 以水蛭吸血

examples.en: The swimmer found a leech stuck to his ankle.
examples.zh: 游泳的人发现脚踝上叮着一条水蛭。

meaning: a. 冷淡的, 不适于居住的, 不相容的

examples.en: The desert seems inhospitable until you notice its hidden life.
examples.zh: 沙漠看似不宜居住，直到你发现其中隐藏的生命。

meaning: adv. 精力充沛地, 积极地

examples.en: The children energetically waved at the passing parade floats.
examples.zh: 孩子们起劲地朝经过的游行花车挥手。

meaning: vt. 溅, 中伤;vi. 飞溅

examples.en: Be careful not to spatter grease on the new stove.
examples.zh: 小心别把油溅到新炉灶上。

meaning: n. 运动员精神

examples.en: True sportsmanship means congratulating the winner honestly.
examples.zh: 真正的体育精神是真诚地祝贺胜者。

meaning: 自动驾驶仪

examples.en: The plane flew on autopilot while the pilots rested.
examples.zh: 飞行员休息时，飞机由自动驾驶仪控制。

meaning: a. 无伴侣的, 无伴随的, 无伴奏的

examples.en: Children under twelve cannot travel unaccompanied on international flights.
examples.zh: 十二岁以下儿童不能单独乘坐国际航班。

meaning: n. 凶手, 谋杀者;a. 杀人的, 残酷的

examples.en: The restaurant business is cutthroat in this crowded city.
examples.zh: 在这座拥挤的城市，餐饮业竞争残酷。

meaning: a. 杂色的, 斑驳的, 富于变化的;杂色的, 斑驳的

examples.en: The garden looked bright with its variegated leaves and flowers.
examples.zh: 杂色的叶片和花朵让花园显得亮丽。

meaning: a. 穿用的, 使疲惫的, 磨损的

examples.en: Looking after three toddlers is a wearing job.
examples.zh: 照看三个蹒跚学步的孩子很累人。

meaning: adv. 厚颜无耻

examples.en: She unashamedly ordered dessert before her main course arrived.
examples.zh: 她毫不掩饰地在主菜上来前先点了甜点。

meaning: n. 重打声;v. 重打

examples.en: Wham, the ball hit the window and cracked the glass.
examples.zh: 砰的一声，球撞上窗户，把玻璃打裂了。

meaning: a. 赤贫的, 贫穷的

examples.en: He arrived in the city penniless but full of hope.
examples.zh: 他身无分文却满怀希望地来到这座城市。

meaning: vt. 使归化, 使国有化, 使成国家, 使民族化

examples.en: The government decided to nationalize the struggling railway company.
examples.zh: 政府决定将陷入困境的铁路公司国有化。

meaning: n. 龙骨, 平底船;vt. 装以龙骨, 使倾覆

examples.en: The sailors carefully checked the keel before the long voyage.
examples.zh: 远航之前，水手们仔细检查了龙骨。

meaning: a. 粉的, 粉状的

examples.en: The baker mixed the powdery cocoa into the warm milk.
examples.zh: 面包师把粉状可可混入温牛奶中。

meaning: a. 洪水的, 灾变的, 政治和社会大变动的

examples.en: The novel describes a cataclysmic earthquake that splits the continent.
examples.zh: 小说描写了一场撕裂大陆的灾变性地震。

meaning: n. 玻璃纸;赛璐玢; 玻璃纸

examples.en: She wrapped the gift basket in clear cellophane and ribbon.
examples.zh: 她用透明玻璃纸和丝带包好了礼篮。

meaning: a. 特别的, 特殊的;特别的, 特殊的

examples.en: Clean water is of especial importance during a flood.
examples.zh: 洪水期间，清洁用水尤为重要。

meaning: adv. 不知羞耻地

examples.en: He shamelessly jumped the long queue at the bakery.
examples.zh: 他厚着脸皮插到了面包店的长队前面。

meaning: n. （天体）红移, 红向移动

examples.en: Astronomers measured the redshift to estimate the galaxy's distance.
examples.zh: 天文学家通过测量红移来估算星系的距离。

meaning: n. 头, 脑袋, 头脑;头盖(旧名)

examples.en: The sun warmed the old man's bald pate.
examples.zh: 阳光晒暖了老人的秃顶。

meaning: a. 无比的, 不能比较的

examples.en: The view from the summit was an incomparable reward for climbing.
examples.zh: 山顶的景色是对登山者无与伦比的回报。

meaning: n. 扶手, 靠手

examples.en: She fell asleep with her head against the plane's armrest.
examples.zh: 她靠在飞机的扶手上睡着了。

meaning: a. 有关卡的；带栅门的

examples.en: They live in a gated community with a private swimming pool.
examples.zh: 他们住在带私人泳池的封闭式小区。

meaning: n. 孤立主义者

examples.en: The senator supported an isolationist policy on foreign trade.
examples.zh: 这位参议员支持对外贸易上的孤立主义政策。

meaning: n. 发送, 派遣, 发射, 信件, 神赐, 天降;发送

examples.en: The office is sending three interns to the Shanghai conference.
examples.zh: 公司派三名实习生去上海参加会议。

meaning: n. 锅（源自广东话）；炒菜锅

examples.en: Heat the wok before adding the oil and vegetables.
examples.zh: 先把炒锅烧热，再放油和蔬菜。

meaning: n. 适合, 一致, 和谐

examples.en: There is a clear congruence between their goals and ours.
examples.zh: 他们的目标和我们的目标明显一致。

meaning: n. 子宫切除;子宫切除术

examples.en: Her mother recovered quickly after a routine hysterectomy last spring.
examples.zh: 她母亲去年春天做完子宫切除手术后恢复很快。

meaning: n. 屁;vi. 放屁

examples.en: Dad blamed his fart on the sleeping dog.
examples.zh: 爸爸把他的屁赖在了睡着的狗身上。

meaning: a. 血淋淋的, 满是血的, 血污的

examples.en: I skipped the gory battle scenes in the war movie.
examples.zh: 我跳过了战争片中血腥的战斗场面。

meaning: n. 提高者, 饲养者, 招募者

examples.en: The pig raiser wakes at five to feed his animals.
examples.zh: 那位养猪户每天五点起床喂猪。

meaning: n. 分光计, 谱仪;分光计; 分光仪

examples.en: The lab uses a spectrometer to analyze the mineral samples.
examples.zh: 实验室用分光计分析矿物样本。

meaning: a. 渴望的, 痒的, 生疥疮的

examples.en: The itchy sweater made the long meeting unbearable.
examples.zh: 那件让人发痒的毛衣使漫长的会议难以忍受。

meaning: 判定

examples.en: The deciding goal came in the final minute of play.
examples.zh: 制胜进球在比赛的最后一分钟到来。

meaning: n. 交通信号灯

examples.en: We waited at the stoplight while the fire truck passed.
examples.zh: 消防车驶过时，我们在信号灯前等候。

meaning: n. <主美>(冰球等中的)防守队员

examples.en: The defenseman blocked the shot and saved the game.
examples.zh: 防守队员封堵射门，保住了比赛。

meaning: n. 剧场, 儿童之家, 玩具房

examples.en: The kids turned the garden shed into a playhouse.
examples.zh: 孩子们把花园小屋改成了游戏房。

meaning: a. 无齿的;无牙的

examples.en: Critics called the new rule a toothless attempt at reform.
examples.zh: 批评者称新规是没有威慑力的改革尝试。

meaning: n. 壮丽, 盛观, 夸耀

examples.en: The graduation ceremony was full of pomp and proud parents.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼场面隆重，家长们满脸自豪。

meaning: n. 诙谐者, 家伙, 巧计;曲笔

examples.en: The office joker keeps everyone laughing during coffee breaks.
examples.zh: 办公室里的开心果总在茶歇时逗大家笑。

meaning: n. 至, 至日, 至点, 极限, 决定性时刻

examples.en: The town holds a bonfire celebration every summer solstice.
examples.zh: 小镇每年夏至都举办篝火庆祝活动。

meaning: adv. 酥脆地, 爽快地

examples.en: The fresh apple snapped crisply when she took a bite.
examples.zh: 她咬下去时，新鲜的苹果发出脆响。

meaning: n. 防水衣, 雨衣, 骗子;抹镘

examples.en: The fisherman wore a yellow slicker in the pouring rain.
examples.zh: 渔夫在下大雨时穿着黄色雨衣。

meaning: n. 刺激, 激励, 提示;提示; 提醒

examples.en: With a little prompting, the shy student shared her poem.
examples.zh: 在小小的鼓励下，害羞的学生朗诵了她的诗。

meaning: n. 暗示, 提示, 通知;告知, 通知, 暗示

examples.en: Her yawn was the first intimation that she was tired.
examples.zh: 她打哈欠是说明她累了的第一个暗示。

meaning: n. 多配偶(制), 多偶性;多配(一雌多雄或一雄多雌,一妻多夫或一夫多妻)

examples.en: The anthropology lecture discussed polygamy in different historical societies.
examples.zh: 人类学讲座探讨了不同历史社会中的多配偶制。

meaning: v. 电视广播;n. 电视广播

examples.en: The ceremony will telecast live to over fifty countries.
examples.zh: 颁奖典礼将向五十多个国家进行电视直播。

meaning: v. 血污的( bloody的过去式和过去分词 ); 流血的; 屠杀的; 残忍的

examples.en: He returned from the match with a bloodied lip.
examples.zh: 他带着流血的嘴唇结束了比赛。

meaning: 绞盘

examples.en: The furniture hauler delivered the new sofa this morning.
examples.zh: 家具搬运工今天上午送来了新沙发。

meaning: a. 鼓舞人心的, 令人振奋的

examples.en: The charity received heartening support from the local community.
examples.zh: 慈善机构得到了当地社区令人振奋的支持。

meaning: a. 婚前的

examples.en: They attended premarital counseling before their autumn wedding.
examples.zh: 他们在秋季婚礼前参加了婚前咨询。

meaning: n. 巡视者, 巡逻者, 巡警;巡逻人, 巡逻警察

examples.en: The patrolman helped the lost tourist find her hotel.
examples.zh: 巡警帮迷路的游客找到了酒店。

meaning: n. 打桩, 打桩工程( piling的名词复数 )

examples.en: The old pier rests on wooden pilings driven deep below.
examples.zh: 老码头架在深深打入水下的木桩上。

meaning: a. 胶粘的, 自作多情的;n. 胶粘物, 性格软弱的人

examples.en: The cookie has a gooey chocolate center everyone loves.
examples.zh: 这种饼干有大家喜爱的软黏巧克力夹心。

meaning: n. 穿孔, 孔眼, 贯穿, 贯通;穿透

examples.en: Tear the coupon along the perforation before mailing it in.
examples.zh: 邮寄前请沿孔线把优惠券撕下来。

meaning: n. 笔直, 率直

examples.en: Her directness surprised the team, but everyone valued the honesty.
examples.zh: 她的直率让团队意外，但大家都很珍视这份诚实。

meaning: n. 贴边, 鞭痕, 殴打;vt. 加贴边, 鞭打

examples.en: The tight boot left a red welt on his ankle.
examples.zh: 太紧的靴子在他的脚踝上留下了一道红痕。

meaning: adv. 幸福地, 充满喜悦地

examples.en: The baby slept blissfully through the thunderstorm last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚打雷时，宝宝美美地睡了一整夜。

meaning: a. 栩栩如生的, 逼真的, 酷象实物的

examples.en: The wax museum's lifelike figures startled many visitors.
examples.zh: 蜡像馆里栩栩如生的蜡像吓到了不少游客。

meaning: v. 对（质量、能力等）估价过高( overrate的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: Honestly, I think that famous burger place is totally overrated.
examples.zh: 说实话，我觉得那家有名的汉堡店被大大高估了。

meaning: n. 重新定义

examples.en: Streaming caused a complete redefinition of the music industry.
examples.zh: 流媒体彻底重新定义了音乐产业。

meaning: a. 消瘦的, 疲倦的

examples.en: After a week of flu, her face looked pinched and pale.
examples.zh: 一周流感过后，她面容消瘦苍白。

meaning: a. 一般

examples.en: The warm winter weather was untypical for this northern city.
examples.zh: 暖冬天气在这座北方城市并不多见。

meaning: a. 古怪的, 奇怪的;n. 古怪的人

examples.en: Everyone loves the oddball uncle who collects vintage toasters.
examples.zh: 人人都喜欢那个收集老式烤面包机的怪叔叔。

meaning: n. 厄尔(英国旧时量布的长度单位), 字母L, L形物

examples.en: In medieval England, cloth traders measured fabric by the ell.
examples.zh: 在中世纪的英格兰，布商用厄尔计量布料。

meaning: a. 不明确的, 未下定义的;未阐明的, 未解释的, 不确定的, 不明确的

examples.en: The app crashed because a variable stayed undefined.
examples.zh: 因为一个变量未定义，应用崩溃了。

meaning: vi. 脱去假面具;vt. 暴露

examples.en: The reporter worked to unmask the charity's hidden fraud.
examples.zh: 记者努力揭露那家慈善机构的隐秘欺诈。

meaning: a. 梦一般的, 梦幻的

examples.en: Walking through the foggy forest felt dreamlike and strangely quiet.
examples.zh: 走在雾蒙蒙的森林里，如梦似幻，格外安静。

meaning: a. 区别性的, 有识别力的, 有差别的

examples.en: Only the most discriminating buyers noticed the painting's fine details.
examples.zh: 只有最有眼光的买家注意到了画作的精妙细节。

meaning: 布置, 敷设;敷设; 铺设(管道等)

examples.en: The workers finished laying the new pipes on our street.
examples.zh: 工人们完成了我们街上新管道的铺设。

meaning: a. 有格子图案的, 闭音节的, 选中的;选中的

examples.en: She checked the oven twice before leaving the house.
examples.zh: 出门前，她把烤箱检查了两遍。

meaning: n. 拔塞钻;a. 螺旋形的

examples.en: The waiter opened the wine bottle with a silver corkscrew.
examples.zh: 服务生用银质开瓶器打开了葡萄酒。

meaning: vt. 烧成灰, 火葬

examples.en: The family chose to cremate their grandfather by his wish.
examples.zh: 家人按照祖父的遗愿选择了火化。

meaning: n. 笨蛋, 傻瓜

examples.en: He muttered 'useless fucker' at the jammed printer.
examples.zh: 他对着卡纸的打印机低声骂了句粗话。

meaning: a. 二分的, 叉状分枝的;二分的; 二叉的, 二歧的

examples.en: The survey forced a dichotomous choice between yes and no.
examples.zh: 这份调查迫使人们在是与非之间二选一。

meaning: v. 抹黄油于…上( butter的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The kids asked for buttered toast with their morning eggs.
examples.zh: 孩子们早餐要了抹黄油的吐司配鸡蛋。

meaning: n. 车站旁牲畜栏的使用, 牲畜栏使用费;站内栏舍的使用权, 使用站内栏舍的费用

examples.en: She bought extra yardage of fabric for the curtains.
examples.zh: 她多买了几码布料来做窗帘。

meaning: n. 谄上欺下, 势利

examples.en: The wine club was full of snobbery and overpriced bottles.
examples.zh: 那家品酒俱乐部满是势利气和高价酒。

meaning: n. 被弃之物, 落选者;a. 拒绝的

examples.en: She felt sad when her paper was rejected twice.
examples.zh: 论文两次被拒，她感到很失落。

meaning: n. 持有人, 所有人;拥有的, 所有者, 持有人

examples.en: He is the proud possessor of every album the band made.
examples.zh: 他是乐队全部专辑的骄傲拥有者。

meaning: n. 鹈鹕鸟, 伽蓝鸟

examples.en: A pelican dove into the water and caught a fish.
examples.zh: 一只鹈鹕潜入水中，抓到了一条鱼。

meaning: n. 精神病理学;精神病理学, 病理心理学

examples.en: The course covers psychopathology and common mental health disorders.
examples.zh: 这门课程涵盖精神病理学与常见心理障碍。

meaning: n. 苯丙胺, 安非他明;苯丙胺; 苯异丙胺; 安非他民; 1-苯基-2-丙胺

examples.en: Doctors stopped prescribing amphetamine pills for simple tiredness decades ago.
examples.zh: 几十年前，医生就不再为普通疲劳开安非他明。

meaning: v. 在（硬物）上雕刻（字, 画等）( engrave的过去式和过去分词 ); 将某事物深深印在（记忆或头脑中）

examples.en: She gave him an engraved watch for his retirement.
examples.zh: 她送他一块刻字手表作为退休礼物。

meaning: n. 抛弃, 否认, 拒付;遗弃, 废弃, 否认

examples.en: The senator's statement was a clear repudiation of the policy.
examples.zh: 参议员的声明是对该项政策的明确否定。

meaning: n. 岩鱼

examples.en: The fishermen brought back baskets of fresh rockfish this morning.
examples.zh: 渔民们今天早上带回了一筐筐新鲜的岩鱼。

meaning: n. 显著, 卓越, 突出, 突起, 特征

examples.en: The study examined the salience of color in brand logos.
examples.zh: 该研究考察了颜色在品牌标志中的显著性。

meaning: n. 统治者的职位/任期

examples.en: She announced her campaign for the state governorship last week.
examples.zh: 她上周宣布竞选州长职位。

meaning: v. 建立( constitute的过去式和过去分词 ); 指定; （合法或正式地）成立; 构成

examples.en: The new rules constituted a major change for the whole school.
examples.zh: 新规定给全校带来了一次重大变革。

meaning: n. 崭新, 新奇, 珍奇

examples.en: The newness of the classroom made the children extra curious.
examples.zh: 教室的崭新感让孩子们格外好奇。

meaning: a. 风味极佳的, 可口的, 味香的;n. 开胃菜

examples.en: The bakery sells both savoury pies and sweet cakes.
examples.zh: 这家面包店既卖咸味派，也卖甜蛋糕。

meaning: n. 萨克斯管

examples.en: He plays sax in a small jazz band downtown.
examples.zh: 他在市中心一个小爵士乐队吹萨克斯。

meaning: n. 二, 一对, 二元一位;二价元集(或基); 双; 对; 成对之物; 并矢

examples.en: The research studied the mother-infant dyad during feeding times.
examples.zh: 该研究观察了喂奶时的母婴二元组合。

meaning: a. 动人的, 引人的, 迷人的

examples.en: She wore a fetching blue scarf to the winter party.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条迷人的蓝围巾去参加冬季聚会。

meaning: n. 恶意, 邪恶, 恶性肿瘤;恶性

examples.en: The biopsy showed no sign of malignancy, which relieved everyone.
examples.zh: 活检没有发现恶性迹象，大家都松了口气。

meaning: a. 不谨慎的, 不注意的, 粗心的, 易上当的

examples.en: The scam targets unwary travelers at busy train stations.
examples.zh: 这种骗局专门在繁忙车站盯上疏忽大意的旅客。

meaning: a. 无头的, 无领导者的, 无知的

examples.en: The headless statue in the museum is two thousand years old.
examples.zh: 博物馆里那尊无头雕像已有两千年历史。

meaning: adv. 不适宜地; 不利地; 反对地; 令人不快地

examples.en: The new policy compares unfavourably with the programs of neighboring cities.
examples.zh: 与邻市的项目相比，新政策相形见绌。

meaning: a. 无足轻重的, 无意义的, 不足道的

examples.en: The results were nonsignificant, so the team redesigned the experiment.
examples.zh: 结果不显著，团队重新设计了实验。

meaning: vt. 等候, 住, 忍耐, 等待

examples.en: He chose to bide his time before asking for a raise.
examples.zh: 他决定等待时机成熟再提出加薪。

meaning: a. 未被吓住的

examples.en: Undeterred by rain, the runners finished the charity race.
examples.zh: 跑者们没有被大雨吓退，完成了慈善赛跑。

meaning: n. 摘要, 记事表;vt. 在...上附加摘要

examples.en: The judge added fifteen new cases to Monday's docket.
examples.zh: 法官把十五起新案件排进了周一的日程。

meaning: n. 房地产经纪人;房地产经纪人

examples.en: Our realtor showed us five houses near the good school.
examples.zh: 房产经纪人带我们看了好学区附近的五套房子。

meaning: n. 女神职人员, 女祭司

examples.en: The ancient temple was served by a high priestess.
examples.zh: 那座古庙由一位地位崇高的女祭司主持。

meaning: a. 超导的, 超导电的;超导

examples.en: The lab built a superconducting magnet for the new experiment.
examples.zh: 实验室为新实验建造了超导磁体。

meaning: adv. 快速地, 急速地

examples.en: Work on the new stadium continued apace despite the rain.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨，新体育场的施工仍在快速推进。

meaning: n. 黎明

examples.en: The fishermen set out at daybreak to catch the morning tide.
examples.zh: 渔民们黎明时分出发去赶早潮。

meaning: adv. 不情愿地, 勉强地; 勉勉强强

examples.en: He unwillingly agreed to skip the concert and study instead.
examples.zh: 他不情愿地同意放弃音乐会，改去学习。

meaning: a. 不适宜的, 不适合的, 不适当的

examples.en: She soon realized she was unsuited for the night shift.
examples.zh: 她很快意识到自己不适合上夜班。

meaning: vt. 虐待, 胡乱处理

examples.en: The airline managed to mishandle two of our three suitcases.
examples.zh: 航空公司把我们三件行李中的两件处理失当。

meaning: a. 没有味道的, 没有香味的, 难吃的, 难闻的, 令人不快的, 不可接受的

examples.en: The bar attracted some unsavoury characters late at night.
examples.zh: 这家酒吧深夜会招来一些不三不四的人。

meaning: adv. 无礼地, 粗鲁地, 粗陋地

examples.en: The customer rudely interrupted the clerk mid-sentence.
examples.zh: 那位顾客粗鲁地打断了店员的话。

meaning: v. 使分化为不同的看法( polarize的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The controversial issue deeply polarized the town's residents.
examples.zh: 这个有争议的问题使镇上居民严重分化。

meaning: vt. 解开纠结, 解开, 整顿

examples.en: It took an hour to untangle the knotted Christmas lights.
examples.zh: 花了一个小时才解开缠成一团的圣诞彩灯。

meaning: n. 佛罗伦萨人, 佛罗伦萨绸;a. 佛罗伦萨的

examples.en: The chef prepared an eggs florentine special for Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 大厨为母亲节准备了菠菜烘蛋特餐。

meaning: n. 猛禽

examples.en: A raptor circled the field, searching for mice in the grass.
examples.zh: 一只猛禽在田野上盘旋，寻找草里的老鼠。

meaning: vt.vi. 重新装饰

examples.en: They plan to redecorate the living room before the holidays.
examples.zh: 他们打算在节前重新装修客厅。

meaning: a. 粗鲁的, 固执己见的, 好胜而爱出风头的

examples.en: The pushy salesman followed us through the entire store.
examples.zh: 那个咄咄逼人的推销员在店里一路跟着我们。

meaning: n. 鬣蜥

examples.en: An iguana sunbathed on the warm rocks by the pool.
examples.zh: 一只鬣蜥在泳池边温暖的岩石上晒太阳。

meaning: n. 流动性, 流质, 流状;流动性; 流度

examples.en: Dancers move with remarkable fluidity during the opening scene.
examples.zh: 舞者在开场舞段中动作流畅非凡。

meaning: n. 鲁莽, 不慎重, 轻率;言行失检, 轻率, 不慎重

examples.en: One youthful indiscretion followed the politician for his whole career.
examples.zh: 年轻时的一次言行失检伴随了他的整个职业生涯。

meaning: n. 薄片, 修胡须, 削;刮屑

examples.en: Dad left a mirror and shaving cream by the sink.
examples.zh: 爸爸把镜子和剃须膏放在了洗手池边。

meaning: 描述符; 描述词; 解说符

examples.en: Choose a clear descriptor for each image in the dataset.
examples.zh: 为数据集中的每张图片选择一个清晰的描述词。

meaning: n. (飞机的)操纵杆;控制杆, 操纵杆

examples.en: The pilot gripped the joystick tightly during the strong crosswind.
examples.zh: 强侧风下，飞行员紧紧握住操纵杆。

meaning: n. 发抖, 兴奋;vi. 发抖

examples.en: Stop dithering and choose an ice cream flavor already.
examples.zh: 别犹豫了，快选一个冰淇淋口味吧。

meaning: a. 相同的;n. 等级, 家族, 亲属, 种类

examples.en: He refuses to watch movies of that cheesy ilk.
examples.zh: 他不看那种俗气类型的电影。

meaning: a. 少女的, 少女似的, 适于女子的

examples.en: The twins share a girlish love of sparkly dresses.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎对亮片裙有着少女般的喜爱。

meaning: 磁带开始标志, 计算机角色;肤蝇幼虫

examples.en: A bot automatically deletes spam comments on my blog.
examples.zh: 一个机器人自动删除我博客上的垃圾评论。

meaning: n. 喷气客机

examples.en: The jetliner touched down smoothly despite the gusty wind.
examples.zh: 尽管阵风不断，喷气客机仍平稳着陆。

meaning: vt. 使用过度;n. 过度使用, 任意驱使

examples.en: Try not to overuse the same adjective in every paragraph.
examples.zh: 写作时不要在每一段都反复用同一个形容词。

meaning: n. 农业综合经营;农产品行业

examples.en: Huge agribusiness firms dominate the region's fruit and vegetable trade.
examples.zh: 大型农业企业主导着该地区的水果蔬菜贸易。

meaning: n. 铺被单, 覆盖, 被单料子, 阔幅平布, 薄膜, 压片, 挡板, 板栅, 护墙板, 护堤板

examples.en: Workers covered the furniture with plastic sheeting before painting.
examples.zh: 刷漆前，工人们用塑料布把家具盖好。

meaning: a. 预防的, 防止的;n. 预防法, 预防措施, 预防物, 预防药

examples.en: Regular stretching is a simple preventative measure against back pain.
examples.zh: 定期拉伸是预防背痛的简单措施。

meaning: vt. 从...取下, 解开...的钩子

examples.en: Please unhook the hose from the tap before winter arrives.
examples.zh: 冬天来之前，请把软管从水龙头上取下来。

meaning: a. 十字的, 划掉的, 交叉的;交叉的

examples.en: She crossed the street carefully with her little brother.
examples.zh: 她带着弟弟小心地过了马路。

meaning: adv. 兴奋地

examples.en: The students worked feverishly to finish the project before midnight.
examples.zh: 学生们拼命赶在午夜前完成项目。

meaning: a. （人们出于某种特殊目的）成群的, 聚集的, 联合的

examples.en: Massed crowds gathered along the route for the victory parade.
examples.zh: 大批人群聚集在游行路线两旁。

meaning: n. 誊写者, 模仿者, 抄写员;复制机

examples.en: The office copier is broken again, so email the report.
examples.zh: 办公室的复印机又坏了，把报告发邮件吧。

meaning: a. 第一胎生的;n. 初生儿, 长男, 长女

examples.en: Their firstborn started kindergarten this September with a big smile.
examples.zh: 他们的第一个孩子今年九月开心地上了幼儿园。

meaning: vt. 再拿到手, 取回;重新获得

examples.en: The bank sent agents to repossess the man's unpaid truck.
examples.zh: 银行派人收回了那男子未付款的卡车。

meaning: adv. 令人毛骨悚然地

examples.en: The hotel room was appallingly dirty, so we left immediately.
examples.zh: 酒店房间脏得吓人，我们立刻离开了。

meaning: n. 套环, 投环, 按铃者, 敲钟者

examples.en: The new intern is a ringer for the company founder.
examples.zh: 新来的实习生长得酷似公司创始人。

meaning: a. 多情的, 表示爱情的, 恋爱的

examples.en: The film's amorous scenes made the whole family uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 影片中的爱情戏让全家人不太自在。

meaning: n. 北美黄鹂鸟

examples.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare firebird at the lakeside this spring.
examples.zh: 观鸟者今年春天在湖边发现了一只罕见的黄鹂。

meaning: n. 教学日；学生时代

examples.en: A normal schoolday at our school ends at three thirty.
examples.zh: 我们学校的教学日到下午三点半结束。

meaning: a. 最远的, 最遥远的;adv. 最远, 最大, 最

examples.en: The library is the furthest walk from our dormitory.
examples.zh: 图书馆是离我们宿舍最远的地方。

meaning: a. 每两星期一次的, 隔周发行的;n. 双周刊

examples.en: The team holds a fortnightly meeting to review progress.
examples.zh: 团队每两周开一次会检查进度。

meaning: n. 挥霍者, 挥金如土的人;挥金如土者, 挥霍钱财者

examples.en: He is a careful spender who tracks every dollar.
examples.zh: 他花钱精打细算，每一美元都有记录。

meaning: adv. 令人失望地

examples.en: Attendance at the fair was disappointingly low this weekend.
examples.zh: 本周末集市的人气低得令人失望。

meaning: a. 烦恼的, 焦急的, 生气的, 为难的, 恼怒的, 争论不休的

examples.en: The committee was vexed by the missing budget documents.
examples.zh: 委员会为丢失的预算文件恼火不已。

meaning: a. 高级的, 高档的, 高端的

examples.en: The brand moved upmarket with its new line of watches.
examples.zh: 该品牌以新腕表系列进军高端市场。

meaning: a. 充满敬畏的, 畏怯的

examples.en: Visitors stood awed before the ancient temple's massive stone columns.
examples.zh: 游客们敬畏地站在古庙巨大的石柱前。

meaning: a. 内切的；记名的；有铭刻的

examples.en: The trophy was inscribed with the winner's name and year.
examples.zh: 奖杯上刻着获胜者的姓名和年份。

meaning: n. 沙箱, 沙盒

examples.en: The children spent the whole afternoon building castles in the sandbox.
examples.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在沙坑里堆城堡。

meaning: a. 恐慌的, 惊慌失措的;恐慌的, 由恐慌引起的

examples.en: Stay calm and don't get panicky during the fire drill.
examples.zh: 消防演习时要保持冷静，不要慌张。

meaning: n. 洒, 撒, 少量, 点滴, 稀落

examples.en: Add a light sprinkling of salt before serving the soup.
examples.zh: 上汤前撒少许盐就可以了。

meaning: n. 马镫, 镫具, U形物;钢箍

examples.en: The rider lost a stirrup but stayed balanced in the saddle.
examples.zh: 骑手掉了一只马镫，但仍稳坐在马鞍上。

meaning: n. 普遍性

examples.en: The professor questioned the generalizability of the small survey study.
examples.zh: 教授质疑这项小型调查的普遍性。

meaning: n. 急速拍打声, 轻快脚步声, 行话, 快板, 饶舌;vi. 急速地说, 滴答地响, 祷告, 念经, 念顺口溜

examples.en: We relaxed to the soft patter of rain on the roof.
examples.zh: 屋顶上轻柔的雨声让我们放松下来。

meaning: n. 辩护者, 教义辩护文作者;辩护者, 辩解者

examples.en: The author became a famous apologist for the environmental movement.
examples.zh: 这位作家成了环保运动的著名辩护者。

meaning: n. 鱼鳞, 鳞片排列, 去鳞, 鳞片剥落, 攀登进攻, 按比例测量, 按比例缩放;缩放比例

examples.en: Scaling a fish is easier with the right knife.
examples.zh: 用对刀具，给鱼刮鳞会更容易。

meaning: a. 顶点的, 高潮的

examples.en: The novel's climactic battle takes place on a snowy mountain.
examples.zh: 小说高潮部分的战斗发生在雪山上。

meaning: v. 飘动( flutter的现在分词 ); （心）快速跳动; 振翼, 拍翅膀

examples.en: Colorful flags kept fluttering above the stadium during the final.
examples.zh: 决赛期间，彩旗一直在体育场上空飘扬。

meaning: adv. <俚> 不,不是, 没有(用以表示否定的回答)

examples.en: Naw, I'd rather stay home and cook tonight.
examples.zh: 不啦，我今晚宁愿待在家做饭。

meaning: a. 犹豫的, 蹒跚的, 支吾的

examples.en: She rebuilt the faltering company within two busy years.
examples.zh: 她用两年时间重振了那家摇摇欲坠的公司。

meaning: a. 泰然自若的, 从容的；被控制的

examples.en: The fire was contained within an hour by the quick crew.
examples.zh: 反应迅速的消防队一小时内控制住了火势。

meaning: a. 未加糖的, 不甜的

examples.en: I prefer unsweetened yogurt with fresh fruit on top.
examples.zh: 我喜欢无糖酸奶配上新鲜水果。

meaning: n. 簿记;簿记, 簿记学

examples.en: Accurate bookkeeping helps small businesses survive their first year.
examples.zh: 准确的记账有助于小企业撑过第一年。

meaning: 联络小巷

examples.en: The old map marked a narrow thril behind the market.
examples.zh: 旧地图上标着市场后面的一条窄巷。

meaning: a. 顺风的;adv. 顺风

examples.en: Standing downwind of the bakery, we could smell fresh bread.
examples.zh: 站在面包店的顺风处，我们能闻到新鲜面包的香味。

meaning: n. 觉醒, 清醒

examples.en: Voters' disenchantment grew as prices kept rising that year.
examples.zh: 那一年物价不断上涨，选民的失望日益加深。

meaning: v. 辩论（debate的ing形式）

examples.en: The students are debating whether phones should be allowed in class.
examples.zh: 学生们正在辩论课堂上该不该允许带手机。

meaning: vt.使镜头交切;vi.作镜头交切

examples.en: The director chose to intercut the wedding with flashback scenes.
examples.zh: 导演选择把婚礼与闪回镜头交切。

meaning: 屈, 屈曲

examples.en: The therapist measured the knee's flexion after six weeks.
examples.zh: 治疗师测量了六周后膝盖的屈曲角度。

meaning: n. 保障, 壁垒, 防波堤

examples.en: The seawall serves as a bulwark against winter storms.
examples.zh: 海堤是抵御冬季风暴的屏障。

meaning: a. 非民主的, 不民主的

examples.en: Many citizens viewed the sudden new rule as undemocratic.
examples.zh: 许多公民认为突然出台的新规不民主。

meaning: n. 邮递员

examples.en: Our mailman always waves hello when he delivers the packages.
examples.zh: 我们的邮递员送包裹时总会挥手打招呼。

meaning: 完美地; 毋庸置疑地; 无瑕疵地

examples.en: The hotel staff were impeccably polite throughout our stay.
examples.zh: 我们入住期间，酒店员工礼貌得无可挑剔。

meaning: a. 心不在焉的, 不注意的

examples.en: An uncaring landlord ignored the tenants' heating complaints all winter.
examples.zh: 冷漠的房东整个冬天无视租客的供暖投诉。

meaning: n. 回音；反照现象；呼应

examples.en: The echoing hallway made our footsteps sound strangely loud.
examples.zh: 回声阵阵的走廊让脚步声显得格外响亮。

meaning: a. 不可变的, 不变的, 不能变的

examples.en: The laws of physics seem immutable across the entire universe.
examples.zh: 物理定律在整个宇宙中似乎恒定不变。

meaning: n. 鼓动, 煽动, 教唆;主使, 教唆, 煽动

examples.en: At his uncle's instigation, Sam finally applied for the scholarship.
examples.zh: 在叔叔的鼓动下，山姆终于申请了奖学金。

meaning: a. 晴朗的, 无云的

examples.en: They married on a cloudless morning beside the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 他们在无云的清晨于静谧的湖边成婚。

meaning: n. 赞赏, 嘉奖, 推荐

examples.en: The firefighter received a commendation for his brave river rescue.
examples.zh: 那名消防员因勇敢的激流救援获得嘉奖。

meaning: n. 王权, 王位标识, 标记, 徽章;王权, 王室的特权, 王权的标记

examples.en: The graduates wore full regalia for the university ceremony.
examples.zh: 毕业生们身穿学位服参加毕业典礼。

meaning: n. 呼吸者, 使人喘气的事, 剧烈的运动;通气器

examples.en: Let's take a short breather after climbing these steep stairs.
examples.zh: 爬完这段陡台阶后，我们歇口气吧。

meaning: n. 不被使用, 废弃;vt. 停止使用, 废止

examples.en: The old railway station fell into disuse after the floods.
examples.zh: 洪水过后，老火车站逐渐废弃了。

meaning: a. 被风吹的, 风飘型的

examples.en: The hilltop trail offers views of windblown grass and distant farms.
examples.zh: 山顶小径能看到随风起伏的草地和远处的农场。

meaning: a. 腰的, 腰部的;n. 腰动脉, 腰神经, 腰椎

examples.en: The ergonomic chair gives proper lumbar support during long workdays.
examples.zh: 这把人体工学椅为长时间工作提供腰部支撑。

meaning: a. 不衰退的, 不减弱的

examples.en: The rain continued unabated through the entire weekend trip.
examples.zh: 整个周末旅行期间，大雨下个不停。

meaning: a. 兄弟的, 亲兄弟似的, 亲切的

examples.en: He offered his teammate some brotherly advice after the tough loss.
examples.zh: 惨败后，他给队友提出了兄长般的忠告。

meaning: n. 鹿皮鞋, 软帮鞋;噬鱼蝮蛇, 水生噬鱼蝮蛇

examples.en: Grandfather still wears soft leather moccasins around the house.
examples.zh: 爷爷在家里仍穿着软皮莫卡辛鞋。

meaning: a. 松开的, 紊乱的;unstick的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The window finally came unstuck with one strong push.
examples.zh: 用力一推，卡住的窗户终于松开了。

meaning: a. <医>耳语的, 低语的;v. 低声说( whisper的过去式和过去分词 ); 私语; 小声说; 私下说

examples.en: She whispered the secret to her best friend at lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时，她把秘密悄悄告诉了好朋友。

meaning: n. 移植, 鼓吹, 灌输;植入法, 移植法, 植入, 埋入法(如药物等)

examples.en: The doctor explained the implantation of the new hearing device.
examples.zh: 医生解释了新型助听装置的植入过程。

meaning: n. 刚性结合；撑法；加劲；拉线

examples.en: Staying hydrated is important during long summer hikes.
examples.zh: 夏季长时间徒步时，补水很重要。

meaning: n. 混乱, 杂乱, 放荡

examples.en: The sociology course examined changing attitudes toward promiscuity over time.
examples.zh: 这门社会学课程考察了人们对性开放态度的变化。

meaning: a. 未被邀请的, 未经请求的

examples.en: An uninvited guest showed up halfway through the dinner party.
examples.zh: 宴会进行到一半，来了一位不速之客。

meaning: adv. 圆圆地, 直率地, 严厉地, 全面地

examples.en: The mayor was roundly criticized for closing the public library.
examples.zh: 市长因关闭公共图书馆受到严厉批评。

meaning: adv. 清爽地, 有精神地

examples.en: The interview was refreshingly honest compared with usual political answers.
examples.zh: 与常见的政客套话相比，这次采访坦率得令人耳目一新。

meaning: n. 殖民地开拓者, 殖民者, 移入选民

examples.en: The island's oldest fort was built by an early colonizer.
examples.zh: 岛上最古老的堡垒由早期殖民者修建。

meaning: n. 咯咯声, 高笑声, 饶舌, 闲谈;vi. 咯咯地叫, 咯咯地笑, 喋喋不休

examples.en: Grandma's loud cackle filled the kitchen when Dad told jokes.
examples.zh: 爸爸讲笑话时，奶奶的咯咯大笑充满厨房。

meaning: 调遣, 部署, 操纵

examples.en: Careful manoeuvring got the wide sofa through the narrow doorway.
examples.zh: 经过小心挪移，宽沙发才通过了窄门。

meaning: a. 内藏的；嵌入的；内置的

examples.en: The caravan has an inbuilt kitchen and two sleeping berths.
examples.zh: 这辆房车有内置厨房和两个睡铺。

meaning: n. 自然主义, 本能行动

examples.en: The painter is famous for the naturalism of his rural scenes.
examples.zh: 这位画家以乡村风景的自然主义画风闻名。

meaning: a. 愚勇的, 有勇无谋的

examples.en: Crossing the frozen river alone was a foolhardy decision.
examples.zh: 独自横穿冰封的河面是有勇无谋的决定。

meaning: a. 用薄片层压制成, 切成薄片, 把...分成薄片, 由薄片迭成/覆盖的, 层压板;层压的, 叠层的

examples.en: She keeps her bus pass in a laminated plastic sleeve.
examples.zh: 她把公交卡放在塑封的塑料套里。

meaning: n. 短剑, 钻孔锥;机载探测地面雷达电子系统

examples.en: She took her stiletto heels off after the long gala night.
examples.zh: 漫长的晚会结束后，她脱下了细高跟鞋。

meaning: a. 皮似的, 皮质的, 皮般吞坚韧的

examples.en: The runner's feet had tough, leathery soles from barefoot training.
examples.zh: 多年赤脚训练让跑者的脚底坚硬如革。

meaning: adv. 可论证地, 明确地, 凭论证

examples.en: The new vaccine is demonstrably safer than the older version.
examples.zh: 新疫苗明显比旧版本更安全。

meaning: n. 麻醉学者;麻醉学家

examples.en: The anesthesiologist explained how she would manage the surgery pain.
examples.zh: 麻醉师解释了手术中如何管理疼痛。

meaning: n. 神经系统科学( 指神经病学、 神经化学等)

examples.en: Recent neuroscience research reveals how sleep strengthens memory.
examples.zh: 最新神经科学研究揭示了睡眠如何巩固记忆。

meaning: v. 将（某物）更新( revamp的过去式和过去分词 ); 翻新; 改变; 修改

examples.en: The club revamped its menu with fresh, local ingredients.
examples.zh: 俱乐部用新鲜的本地食材更新了菜单。

meaning: a. 难到达的, 不可得到的

examples.en: The summit once seemed unattainable, but we reached it anyway.
examples.zh: 山顶曾显得遥不可及，但我们还是登上了。

meaning: n. 意大利熏火腿(切成薄片, 常与甜瓜或无花果配成一道菜)

examples.en: The waiter suggested melon wrapped in thin slices of prosciutto.
examples.zh: 服务员推荐了薄火腿片裹甜瓜。

meaning: a. 未经证实的, 未得到支持的, 未得到赞助的, 未得到支援的, 无支撑的;无赞助的, 无支持的, 未经证实的

examples.en: His dramatic claim remained unsupported by any real evidence.
examples.zh: 他耸人听闻的说法没有任何真实证据支持。

meaning: a. 海面下的;adv. 在海面下

examples.en: The documentary shows undersea volcanoes teeming with strange creatures.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片展现了充满奇特生物的海底火山。

meaning: vi. 闷烧, 郁积;n. 闷烧

examples.en: The barbecue coals will smoulder for hours after cooking ends.
examples.zh: 烧烤结束后，木炭还会闷烧好几个小时。

meaning: n. 风湿病;风湿病

examples.en: Grandma's rheumatism aches more whenever the weather turns damp.
examples.zh: 天气一转潮，奶奶的风湿病就更疼。

meaning: n. 闪锌矿；扑克牌的二十一点；包革金属棍棒

examples.en: The visitors played blackjack until two in the casino.
examples.zh: 游客们在赌场玩二十一点玩到凌晨两点。

meaning: a. 给人休息的, 素雅的, 安静的

examples.en: The lakeside cabin offered a restful break from city noise.
examples.zh: 湖边小屋让人远离城市喧嚣，得以好好休息。

meaning: 行骗

examples.en: The student was caught cheating during the final math exam.
examples.zh: 那名学生在数学期末考试中作弊被抓。

meaning: a. 救助的；救援的

examples.en: The relieving nurse arrived early to take over the night shift.
examples.zh: 接班的护士提前到岗，接管了夜班。

meaning: n. 短小, 简略, 不足;脆性; 蓝脆性; 冷脆性

examples.en: The shortness of the meeting surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 会议如此简短，让在场每个人都感到意外。

meaning: n. 无, 皆无, 水中精灵;interj. 停, 不要, 不行

examples.en: The board decided to nix the plan for new offices.
examples.zh: 董事会决定否决新办公室的计划。

meaning: n. 外屋;附属建筑物

examples.en: Tools and old bikes filled the brick outbuilding behind the house.
examples.zh: 房子后面的砖砌杂屋里堆满工具和旧自行车。

meaning: n. 狭小, 小气

examples.en: The narrowness of the mountain path worried the new hikers.
examples.zh: 山路狭窄，让初来的徒步者心生担忧。

meaning: n. 大蟒, 巨蟒

examples.en: A huge python lay quietly in the reptile house.
examples.zh: 爬虫馆里一条巨蟒静静地趴着。

meaning: vt.使用于操作,使开始运转,实施

examples.en: The team must operationalize the plan before the pilot launch.
examples.zh: 团队必须在试点启动前将计划付诸实施。

meaning: adv. 无情地, 残忍地

examples.en: The comedy show teased the mayor's mistakes mercilessly.
examples.zh: 喜剧节目毫不留情地调侃市长的失误。

meaning: a. 样子好的, 定形的, 形状美好的

examples.en: The vase has a shapely curve that collectors admire.
examples.zh: 这只花瓶的优美弧线深受藏家喜爱。

meaning: 最高

examples.en: The company just posted its highest quarterly sales ever.
examples.zh: 公司刚刚公布了有史以来最高的季度销售额。

meaning: vt. 使随机化;随机化

examples.en: The researchers will randomize participants into two treatment groups.
examples.zh: 研究人员会将参与者随机分为两个治疗组。

meaning: n. 索具, 装备;提价

examples.en: The sailors checked the rigging before the wind picked up.
examples.zh: 起风之前，水手们检查了索具。

meaning: n. 大庄园

examples.en: The old hacienda now welcomes guests as a country hotel.
examples.zh: 那座老庄园如今成了接待客人的乡村旅馆。

meaning: a. 牛顿的, 牛顿学说的;n. 信仰牛顿学说的人

examples.en: Newtonian mechanics still predicts the pendulum's swing with great accuracy.
examples.zh: 牛顿力学仍能精准预测钟摆的摆动。

meaning: n. 键区;键区

examples.en: Enter the code on the keypad beside the main entrance.
examples.zh: 在正门旁的数字键盘上输入密码。

meaning: a. 关节炎的;关节炎的; 关节炎患者

examples.en: Her arthritic hands still knit sweaters for every grandchild.
examples.zh: 她患关节炎的手仍为每个孙辈织毛衣。

meaning: a. 有强大推进力的, 劲头十足的;用力推, 强拉, 猛拉

examples.en: The young manager's thrusting energy impressed the whole sales team.
examples.zh: 年轻经理的闯劲给整个销售团队留下深刻印象。

meaning: n. 杂烩

examples.en: The seafood shack serves creamy clam chowder in bread bowls.
examples.zh: 那家海鲜小店的奶油蛤蜊浓汤盛在面包碗里。

meaning: 闷烧, 低温炼焦, 低温干馏

examples.en: A smouldering cigarette butt started the dry grass fire.
examples.zh: 一支闷燃的烟头引燃了干草。

meaning: n. 白蜡；青灰色

examples.en: The antique shop sells pewter mugs from the last century.
examples.zh: 古董店出售上个世纪的锡制大杯。

meaning: n. 呼喊, 喊话

examples.en: We heard neighbors shouting happily when the home team scored.
examples.zh: 主队进球时，我们听到邻居们欢呼大喊。

meaning: n. 食欲过盛;善饥, 食欲过盛

examples.en: The campus clinic offers support for students recovering from bulimia.
examples.zh: 校医院为患贪食症的学生提供康复支持。

meaning: n. 谄媚, 过分的称赞

examples.en: The young singer seemed embarrassed by the fans' loud adulation.
examples.zh: 年轻歌手似乎被粉丝的狂热吹捧弄得很不好意思。

meaning: n. 公共汽车, 公共马车, 精选集, 汇编;a. 综合性的, 总括的, 作多种用途的

examples.en: The network released an omnibus edition of the whole season.
examples.zh: 电视台发布了整季剧集的合集版。

meaning: n. 将来, 来世;adv. 此后, 将来, 来世

examples.en: Hereafter, all meeting notes will be shared by email weekly.
examples.zh: 从今以后，会议纪要将每周通过邮件共享。

meaning: n. 复赛, 重赛

examples.en: Fans are eager for a rematch between the two champions.
examples.zh: 粉丝们期待两位冠军再次交手。

meaning: v. 开采( exploit的过去式和过去分词 ); 利用（…为自己谋利）; 运用; 剥削

examples.en: The report showed how workers were exploited at the factory.
examples.zh: 报告揭示了工人在工厂如何被剥削。

meaning: v. （使）增强, （使）加剧( intensify的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The storm intensified overnight, closing schools across the region.
examples.zh: 暴风雨夜间加强，导致全区学校停课。

meaning: n. (报纸)写标题的记者

examples.en: The festival's headliner will take the main stage at nine.
examples.zh: 音乐节的压轴艺人九点登上主舞台。

meaning: n. 征募, 服役期限

examples.en: His four-year enlistment in the navy ends this coming June.
examples.zh: 他四年的海军服役期将于今年六月结束。

meaning: n. 荷兰人

examples.en: The Dutchman shared his recipe for thick pea soup.
examples.zh: 那位荷兰人分享了他的浓豌豆汤食谱。

meaning: n. （拉）法律；权利；法律原则；（法）汁液

examples.en: The chef spooned a rich red wine jus over the steak.
examples.zh: 大厨在牛排上浇了浓郁的红酒肉汁。

meaning: n. 数字, 数;a. 数字的, 表示数字的

examples.en: The clock face uses Roman numeral markers instead of plain numbers.
examples.zh: 这座钟面用罗马数字刻度而不是普通数字。

meaning: n. 易怒, 刺激物, 兴奋性;应激性, 兴奋性, 刺激感受性, 兴奋增盛, 过敏

examples.en: Lack of sleep often leads to irritability and poor focus.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足常导致易怒和注意力差。

meaning: n. 河床

examples.en: After the drought, the dry riverbed was cracked and dusty.
examples.zh: 干旱过后，干涸的河床龟裂且满是尘土。

meaning: n. 被撤离者, 被疏散者

examples.en: Each evacuee received blankets and hot tea at the shelter.
examples.zh: 每位被疏散者在安置点领到了毯子和热茶。

meaning: num. 第五十, 五十分之一

examples.en: The company gave him a watch for his fiftieth work anniversary.
examples.zh: 公司在他工作五十周年时送了他一块表。

meaning: a. 可信任的, 可信赖的, 可靠的;n. 可信任的人, 模范犯人

examples.en: He fixed the fence with his trusty old hammer.
examples.zh: 他用那把可靠的老锤子修好了栅栏。

meaning: a. 王子的, 威严的, 王候般的, 豪华的, 奢侈的

examples.en: The startup paid a princely sum for its new office.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司为新办公室付了一大笔钱。

meaning: a. 不能破坏的, 不可毁灭的

examples.en: My childhood teddy bear seems completely indestructible after all these years.
examples.zh: 我的童年泰迪熊经历了这么多年，似乎坚不可摧。

meaning: n. 台, 讲台

examples.en: The principal stood on the dais to greet the graduates.
examples.zh: 校长站在讲台上迎接毕业生。

meaning: a. 打着呵欠的, 裂着大口的

examples.en: A yawning gap appeared between the two teams' scores.
examples.zh: 两队比分之间出现了巨大的差距。

meaning: seek的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: She sought advice from her professor before choosing a major.
examples.zh: 她在选择专业前征求了教授的建议。

meaning: n. 再创造、重塑。

examples.en: The singer's bold reinvention surprised even her oldest fans.
examples.zh: 这位歌手大胆的转型连老歌迷都感到惊讶。

meaning: n. 非会员

examples.en: As a nonmember, he paid extra for the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 作为非会员，他使用游泳池要多付钱。

meaning: a. 宗派的, 教派的

examples.en: The college offers denominational chapel services every Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 这所学院每周日晚举行教派礼拜。

meaning: n. 厌恶, 痛恶, 令人厌恶的事物

examples.en: Locals called the abandoned factory an abomination on the riverfront.
examples.zh: 当地人把废弃工厂称作河畔的讨厌之物。

meaning: n. 神父, 随军牧师

examples.en: The padre held Sunday services inside the army base chapel.
examples.zh: 随军牧师在基地教堂主持周日礼拜。

meaning: adv. 巧妙地, 敏捷地, 便利地

examples.en: Our school team won the debate handily last Friday night.
examples.zh: 我们校队上周五晚轻松赢得辩论赛。

meaning: n. 空气的流动, 气流

examples.en: Open both windows to improve the airflow in the stuffy room.
examples.zh: 打开两扇窗，改善闷热房间的空气流通。

meaning: n. 含糊, 暧昧

examples.en: The vagueness of the instructions left us all confused.
examples.zh: 说明含糊不清，我们全都一头雾水。

meaning: a. 太平无事的, 平静无事的

examples.en: Thankfully, the long road trip was completely uneventful.
examples.zh: 谢天谢地，漫长的公路旅行一路平安无事。

meaning: a. 已贴现的；已折扣的;v. 打折扣(discount的过去分词)；不重视

examples.en: The store sold the discounted winter coats in a single day.
examples.zh: 商店一天之内就卖光了打折的冬装。

meaning: n. 无意识, 意识不清, 人事不省;人事不省, 神志丧失; 无意识

examples.en: The boxer briefly slipped into unconsciousness after the heavy blow.
examples.zh: 遭到重击后，拳击手一度陷入昏迷。

meaning: 独占

examples.en: The club's exclusivity attracts people who value privacy highly.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的专属感吸引着高度重视隐私的人。

meaning: a. 多节的, 有节的；棘手的

examples.en: She finally combed out her knotted hair after the beach trip.
examples.zh: 海边之行后，她终于梳开了打结的头发。

meaning: n. 精神病患者, 精神变态者;精神变态者, 变态人格者

examples.en: The detective realized she was chasing a clever psychopath.
examples.zh: 女侦探意识到自己追踪的是个狡猾的精神变态者。

meaning: a. 出生不满一个月的婴儿;新生的

examples.en: She trains nurses in neonatal care at the city hospital.
examples.zh: 她在市医院培训新生儿护理护士。

meaning: vi. 产生作用(或影响)

examples.en: High costs may militate against the new stadium plan.
examples.zh: 高昂的成本可能不利于新体育场的计划。

meaning: lay的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The workers laid new tiles across the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 工人们在厨房地面铺了新瓷砖。

meaning: 莎士比亚(Shakespeare)的

examples.en: The class performed a Shakespearean comedy in the park.
examples.zh: 班级在公园里上演了一出莎士比亚喜剧。

meaning: n. 鼓声

examples.en: The slow drumbeat set the pace for the parade marchers.
examples.zh: 低缓的鼓声为游行队伍定下步伐。

meaning: n. 大学生联谊会, 大学生联谊会会员

examples.en: His frat organized a charity run every spring semester.
examples.zh: 他的大学联谊会每年春季组织慈善跑步。

meaning: n. 平衡物, 平衡力, 秤锤;配重

examples.en: Engineers added a counterweight to balance the bridge's lifting arm.
examples.zh: 工程师加装配重来平衡桥梁的升降臂。

meaning: adv. 丰富地;n. 丰富, 大量

examples.en: The harvest festival featured pumpkins, apples, and pies galore.
examples.zh: 丰收节上南瓜、苹果和派应有尽有。

meaning: n. 体育活动, 对运动的热爱

examples.en: Her athleticism and teamwork made her the squad's captain.
examples.zh: 她的运动能力和团队精神让她当上了队长。

meaning: 泡沫的;发泡; 泡沫层

examples.en: The foaming bubble bath delighted the two tired toddlers.
examples.zh: 泡沫丰富的泡泡浴逗乐了两个累坏的小宝宝。

meaning: a. 无特色的, 平凡的

examples.en: The desert stretched out as a featureless plain of grey sand.
examples.zh: 沙漠延伸成一片单调的灰色沙原。

meaning: a. 望远镜的, 用望远镜看到的, 套管式的, 伸缩的;望远的

examples.en: The telescopic ladder extends to reach the tall bookshelves safely.
examples.zh: 伸缩梯可以拉长，安全够到高书架。

meaning: n. 疏远

examples.en: Years of estrangement ended when the sisters met at the wedding.
examples.zh: 姐妹们在婚礼上重逢，多年的疏远就此结束。

meaning: vt. 使残忍, 残酷地对待, 使残酷无情, 变成野兽一样残忍

examples.en: The film shows how war can brutalize ordinary young soldiers.
examples.zh: 影片展现了战争如何使普通年轻士兵变得残忍。

meaning: a. 难运转的, 不能实行的

examples.en: The committee rejected the plan as expensive and unworkable.
examples.zh: 委员会认为该计划昂贵且行不通，予以否决。

meaning: adv. 在那附近, 大约, 上下, 左右

examples.en: We left at noon and arrived by two or thereabouts.
examples.zh: 我们中午出发，两点前后到达。

meaning: 螺型位移, 螺旋运动

examples.en: The project stalled as costs kept spiralling upward.
examples.zh: 成本不断上涨，项目陷入了停滞。

meaning: a. 如冬的, 寒冷的, 冬的, 冷淡的

examples.en: A wintry mix of rain and snow slowed the morning commute.
examples.zh: 雨夹雪的寒冷天气拖慢了早高峰。

meaning: vt.& vi. (refurbish的动词过去式或过去分词形式), 再磨光, 刷新;v. 刷新( refurbish的过去式和过去分词 ); 擦亮; 使清洁;

examples.en: The library reopened after its reading rooms were beautifully refurbished.
examples.zh: 图书馆的阅览室焕然一新后重新开放。

meaning: n. 抓, 握;adv. 迎风航驶

examples.en: Grab ahold of the rail while the bus is moving.
examples.zh: 公交车行驶时，请抓紧扶手。

meaning: n. 互殴, 激烈的论战, 混战

examples.en: A melee broke out among fans after the controversial final call.
examples.zh: 那次有争议的判罚后，球迷间爆发了混战。

meaning: a. 司法权的, 裁决权的, 管辖权的;司法权的, 裁判权的, 管辖权的

examples.en: The two agencies resolved their jurisdictional dispute over coastal waters.
examples.zh: 两家机构解决了关于沿海水域的管辖权争议。

meaning: a. 远征的, 考察的, 探险的

examples.en: The museum displays letters from an expeditionary team's polar journey.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出一支远征队极地之旅的信件。

meaning: vt. 使怀孕, 使肥沃, 使充满, 灌输;a. 怀孕的, 充满的

examples.en: Factory workers impregnate the fabric with a waterproof coating daily.
examples.zh: 工厂工人每天给织物浸渍防水涂层。

meaning: a. 没有执照的, 未经当局许可的;未经当局许可的, 无执照的, 无节制的

examples.en: Police closed the unlicensed bar after neighbors complained twice.
examples.zh: 邻居们两次投诉后，警方查封了那家无照酒吧。

meaning: a. 西西里岛的

examples.en: She learned to cook Sicilian pasta from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她跟祖母学会了做西西里意面。

meaning: n. 官场, 官僚圈子, 公务员, 官僚主义;官场, 公务员界, 官吏

examples.en: Local officialdom delayed the permits for the new school library.
examples.zh: 地方官僚拖延了学校新图书馆的许可审批。

meaning: n. 怠惰, 无精打采

examples.en: His laziness cost him the promotion he really wanted.
examples.zh: 懒惰让他失去了真正想要的晋升机会。

meaning: v. 升级；提高品位（upgrade的现在分词）

examples.en: The IT department is upgrading every office computer this weekend.
examples.zh: IT部门本周末将升级全部办公电脑。

meaning: n. 一种长毛垂耳狗, 马屁精

examples.en: The spaniel splashed happily through every puddle on the walk.
examples.zh: 那只长毛垂耳狗散步时开心地踩过每个水坑。

meaning: a. 阴谋的, 阴谋者的;阴谋的, 共谋的

examples.en: She leaned in with a conspiratorial whisper about the surprise party.
examples.zh: 她压低声音，神神秘秘地说起惊喜派对。

meaning: n. 但丁（意大利诗人）

examples.en: Dante wrote his famous poem while exiled from Florence.
examples.zh: 但丁在被逐出佛罗伦萨期间写下了名作。

meaning: n. 堤道, 公路

examples.en: At low tide, walkers cross the causeway to the island.
examples.zh: 退潮时，步行者经由堤道前往小岛。

meaning: n. 叉状物, 耙子;vt. 刺, 贯穿, 翻掘

examples.en: A bent prong on the fork made it useless for spaghetti.
examples.zh: 叉子的一根齿弯了，吃不了意面。

meaning: a. 最高的, 无比的;造冠术(牙); 儿头初露(分娩)

examples.en: Scoring the winning goal was the crowning moment of his career.
examples.zh: 进决胜球是他职业生涯的巅峰时刻。

meaning: a. 无法计数的, 无数的, 不可预料的

examples.en: The flood caused incalculable damage to the farming valley.
examples.zh: 洪水给农业山谷造成了难以估量的损失。

meaning: a. 蔑视的, 轻视的, 毁谤的

examples.en: Avoid disparaging comments about classmates when giving peer feedback.
examples.zh: 同学互评时，要避免贬低性的评论。

meaning: adv. 愚蠢地

examples.en: I stupidly left my umbrella on the crowded subway.
examples.zh: 我稀里糊涂地把伞落在了拥挤的地铁上。

meaning: v. 用文火焖烧, 熏烧, 慢燃( smolder的现在分词 )

examples.en: The smoldering campfire was doused with water before dark.
examples.zh: 天黑前，闷烧的篝火被水浇灭了。

meaning: a. 不庄严的, 无尊严的

examples.en: The politician's undignified outburst shocked the usually calm committee.
examples.zh: 那位政客有失体面的发作震惊了委员会。

meaning: v. 攻克( conquer的现在分词 ); 征服; 破除; 克服

examples.en: After conquering her fear of heights, she tried rock climbing.
examples.zh: 克服恐高后，她尝试了攀岩。

meaning: 推迟, 延迟, 搁置

examples.en: The committee postponed the vote until next month's meeting.
examples.zh: 委员会把投票推迟到下个月的会议。

meaning: n. 圣代冰淇淋

examples.en: The children shared a huge chocolate sundae after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后，孩子们分享了一个巨大的巧克力圣代。

meaning: n. 苗木铲根；修截苗根

examples.en: The goodbye at the airport was wrenching for the whole family.
examples.zh: 机场的道别让全家人心如刀绞。

meaning: a. 抗菌的;n. 抗菌剂

examples.en: The nurse washed with antibacterial soap before the minor surgery.
examples.zh: 护士在小手术前用抗菌皂洗手。

meaning: a. 不能感知的, 微细的

examples.en: The watch's ticking is almost imperceptible in a quiet room.
examples.zh: 在安静的房间里，手表的滴答声几乎听不见。

meaning: n. 诡计, 表袋, 短表链;vt. 骗人, 混骗

examples.en: She clipped the key fob to her backpack zipper.
examples.zh: 她把钥匙扣夹在背包拉链上。

meaning: n. 工艺师, 技术员;技术员

examples.en: The lab technologist prepared the blood samples for testing.
examples.zh: 检验技师准备好了待检的血样。

meaning: n. 大丽花;大丽花, 大丽紫

examples.en: A bright dahlia bloomed by the front porch steps.
examples.zh: 门廊台阶旁开着一朵艳丽的大丽花。

meaning: n. 男式浅顶软呢帽

examples.en: The detective wore a grey fedora in every old photo.
examples.zh: 老照片里，那位侦探总戴着灰色浅顶软呢帽。

meaning: n. 轻便马车

examples.en: She read novels on a wicker chaise by the pool.
examples.zh: 她躺在泳池边的藤制躺椅上看小说。

meaning: a. 被咒语所镇住的, 被迷住的

examples.en: The audience stayed spellbound until the magician's final bow.
examples.zh: 观众们如痴如醉，直到魔术师最后谢幕。

meaning: n. 脓肿;vi. 形成脓肿

examples.en: The dentist drained the abscess and prescribed antibiotics quickly.
examples.zh: 牙医给脓肿排了脓，并很快开了抗生素。

meaning: n. 圆三色堇;三色堇

examples.en: A purple pansy peeked through the crack in the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 一株紫色的三色堇从人行道裂缝里探出头。

meaning: n. 妻与前夫所生的儿子, 夫与前妻所生的儿子;妻与前夫所生的儿子, 继子

examples.en: He taught his stepson to fish at the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 他教继子在安静的湖边钓鱼。

meaning: a. 学校的, 大学的, 大学生的, 社团的

examples.en: The department has a collegial atmosphere that new staff appreciate.
examples.zh: 这个系氛围融洽，新员工都很喜欢。

meaning: vt. 使（协议、计划等）成书面文字形式; 使成为正式, 使具有一定形式

examples.en: The partners will formalise the agreement with lawyers next week.
examples.zh: 合伙人下周将请律师把协议正式定下来。

meaning: a. 预先警戒的, 预防的, 留心的

examples.en: As a precautionary measure, the school closed the old gym.
examples.zh: 作为预防措施，学校关闭了老体育馆。

meaning: a. 可核实的, 可证实的;可检验的, 可作证的, 可证实的

examples.en: Editors require verifiable sources before publishing the research story.
examples.zh: 编辑发布研究报道前要求可核实的来源。

meaning: vi. 吸着鼻子说话, 抽鼻涕;n. 抽鼻子

examples.en: The little boy tried not to sniffle during the vaccine.
examples.zh: 打疫苗时，小男孩忍着不抽鼻子。

meaning: n. 油灰, 淡灰色, 氧化锡;vt. 用油灰填塞

examples.en: Dad used putty to seal the gap around the window.
examples.zh: 爸爸用油灰封住了窗户四周的缝隙。

meaning: n. 后卫

examples.en: The team's rearguard defended bravely in the final ten minutes.
examples.zh: 球队后卫在最后十分钟顽强防守。

meaning: n. 骑自行车者, 骑脚踏车者

examples.en: A bicyclist rang the bell politely on the shared path.
examples.zh: 一位骑车人在共用道路上礼貌地按铃。

meaning: n. 人口过剩;人口过剩

examples.en: The documentary links overpopulation to strain on city water supplies.
examples.zh: 纪录片将人口过剩与城市供水压力联系起来。

meaning: n. 夜小礼服, 无尾夜常礼服

examples.en: He rented a black tux for the school's winter formal.
examples.zh: 他为学校冬季舞会租了一套黑色礼服。

meaning: n. 不妥协, 强硬, 不让步

examples.en: Months of talks failed because of both sides' intransigence.
examples.zh: 由于双方都不让步，数月谈判宣告失败。

meaning: a. 不能防卫的, 无辩护余地的

examples.en: The judge called the company's safety cuts indefensible.
examples.zh: 法官称公司削减安全投入的做法站不住脚。

meaning: adv. 不完全地, 有缺点地, 不完备地

examples.en: He played the song imperfectly but with obvious joy.
examples.zh: 他弹得不完美，却弹得满心欢喜。

meaning: a. 相对论的;相对论性(的)

examples.en: The physicist explained relativistic effects using a simple train example.
examples.zh: 物理学家用简单的火车例子讲解相对论效应。

meaning: 未告发的, 未揭发的, 未引起的

examples.en: Many small crimes go unreported in the busy city.
examples.zh: 繁忙城市里，许多小案件无人报案。

meaning: n. 不服从法律; 不受法律制约; 未实施法律; 目无法纪

examples.en: The gold rush brought sudden wealth and lawlessness to the valley.
examples.zh: 淘金热给山谷带来了突然的财富与目无法纪。

meaning: a. 尽是杂草的, 似杂草的, 瘦弱的, 蔓生的

examples.en: He spent Saturday clearing the weedy corner of the garden.
examples.zh: 他周六清理了花园里杂草丛生的角落。

meaning: n. 印地安那州

examples.en: We crossed Indiana on the drive to Chicago last autumn.
examples.zh: 去年秋天开车去芝加哥时，我们穿过了印第安纳州。

meaning: n. 漏, 溢出, 溢出物;泄漏量

examples.en: The lab rules require immediate cleanup of any chemical spillage.
examples.zh: 实验室规定任何化学品洒漏都必须立即清理。

meaning: n. 太阳黑子, 雀斑

examples.en: Astronomers photographed a huge sunspot group last Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 天文学家上周二上午拍到了一大群太阳黑子。

meaning: n. 步兵

examples.en: His grandfather served as an infantryman during the winter campaign.
examples.zh: 他祖父在冬季战役中当过步兵。

meaning: n. 挖泥, 捕捞

examples.en: The harbor began dredging the channel for larger cargo ships.
examples.zh: 港口开始疏浚航道，以容纳更大的货船。

meaning: n. 木工活, 木工行业

examples.en: Grandpa's woodworking shop smells of pine shavings and varnish.
examples.zh: 爷爷的木工房里满是松木屑和清漆的味道。

meaning: n. 混合, 混合物, 混成;掺合; 倒圆

examples.en: Blending smoothies at home saves money and reduces plastic waste.
examples.zh: 在家自制果昔既省钱又减少塑料垃圾。

meaning: n. 照明灯, 泛光;vt. 用泛光灯照亮

examples.en: A single floodlight lit the parking lot behind the gym.
examples.zh: 体育馆后面的停车场只靠一盏泛光灯照明。

meaning: n. 舷窗, 炮门;窥视孔

examples.en: Moonlight streamed through the ship's round porthole last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，月光从船的圆形舷窗洒了进来。

meaning: n. 不满, 不平, 背叛;挑唆背判, 离判, 不满

examples.en: The party's disaffection grew after the surprise leadership change.
examples.zh: 领导层突变之后，党内不满情绪加剧。

meaning: n. 裂口, 裂缝, 弱点, 叮当声;vt. 使叮当响

examples.en: A thin chink of light appeared under the heavy door.
examples.zh: 厚重的门下透出一线细细的光。

meaning: n. 模仿者

examples.en: Police caught the copycat who mimicked the famous jewel thief.
examples.zh: 警方抓住了模仿著名珠宝窃贼的效仿者。

meaning: a. 被降级的, 落泊的, 退化的

examples.en: The degraded farmland was restored with native grasses and trees.
examples.zh: 退化的农田种上本地草和树后得以恢复。

meaning: n. 宇宙学家, 宇宙论者

examples.en: The cosmologist explained how the universe might eventually end.
examples.zh: 宇宙学家解释了宇宙最终可能如何终结。

meaning: n. 毒理学, 毒物学;毒理学, 毒物学

examples.en: The toxicology report showed no poison in the patient's blood.
examples.zh: 毒理报告显示病人血液中没有毒物。

meaning: n. 阿拉丁

examples.en: Aladdin rubbed the dusty lamp, and smoke filled the cave.
examples.zh: 阿拉丁擦了擦落满灰尘的油灯，山洞里烟雾弥漫。

meaning: n. 不法, 私生, 不规则性, 不合逻辑;私生, 违法

examples.en: Old laws attached harsh penalties to illegitimacy in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家的旧法律对私生身份有严厉惩罚。

meaning: n. 专心于家务, 恋家, 家庭生活

examples.en: After years of travel, she found joy in quiet domesticity.
examples.zh: 多年旅行后，她在宁静的家庭生活中找到乐趣。

meaning: n. 小佃农

examples.en: Her great-grandfather worked as a sharecropper in the cotton fields.
examples.zh: 她的曾祖父在棉田当过佃农。

meaning: a. 球茎的, 球茎状的, 由球茎生长的;球状的, 球的

examples.en: The bulbous nose of the old plane made kids laugh.
examples.zh: 老式飞机的球状机鼻逗笑了孩子们。

meaning: n. 宽容, 默认, 信仰自由;耐量; 耐受性, 耐力

examples.en: The small colony was known for its religious toleration.
examples.zh: 这个小殖民地以宗教宽容闻名。

meaning: a. 玻利维亚的；玻利维亚人的

examples.en: The Bolivian weaving fair visited our school last spring.
examples.zh: 玻利维亚编织展去年春天来到我们学校。

meaning: n. 深谋远虑, 天意, 天命

examples.en: By sheer providence, the missing hikers found a ranger cabin.
examples.zh: 全凭天意，失踪的徒步者们找到了护林员小屋。

meaning: n. 胃灼热, 心痛, 妒忌;胃灼热

examples.en: Spicy late dinners often give me terrible heartburn.
examples.zh: 睡前吃辛辣的晚餐常让我烧心。

meaning: n. 必要的资金;必要的方法, 必要物

examples.en: She finally had the wherewithal to open her own studio.
examples.zh: 她终于有了开自己工作室的资金。

meaning: n. 忏悔, 临终忏悔, 招认, 承认;忏悔, 赦免, 临终忏悔

examples.en: The manager gave short shrift to the complaint about noise.
examples.zh: 经理对噪音投诉不予理会。

meaning: n. (照相机的)取景器;检像器

examples.en: She framed the mountain peak carefully in the camera's viewfinder.
examples.zh: 她透过取景器仔细框住了山峰。

meaning: v. 恢复(促进)经济发展, 重点恢复

examples.en: The city plans to redevelop the old docklands into housing.
examples.zh: 市政府计划把旧码头区重新开发成住宅区。

meaning: vt. 使痛苦, 使苦恼, 虐待

examples.en: Delays continue to bedevil the city's subway expansion project.
examples.zh: 延误继续困扰着这座城市的地铁扩建工程。

meaning: a. 可通行的, 可渡过的, 尚可的, 可流通的

examples.en: The muddy road was still passable with a good truck.
examples.zh: 开一辆好卡车，泥路仍然可以通行。

meaning: n. 正餐时间

examples.en: By dinnertime, the whole house smelled of grandma's dumplings.
examples.zh: 到了晚饭时分，满屋都是奶奶饺子的香味。

meaning: a. 哲学家的, 哲学的, 镇静的, 逆来顺受的, 安之若素的, 达观的, 富于哲理性的

examples.en: He faced the business setback with a philosophic calm.
examples.zh: 他以哲人般的平静面对生意上的挫折。

meaning: n. 鲜血, 血, 生机的根源

examples.en: Tourism is the lifeblood of this small coastal town.
examples.zh: 旅游业是这个海滨小镇的命脉。

meaning: n. 后挡板

examples.en: We packed the cooler and lowered the truck's tailgate.
examples.zh: 我们装好冷藏箱，放下了卡车的后挡板。

meaning: adv. 不感觉地, 微细地, 极微地

examples.en: The tide was imperceptibly rising over the flat sand.
examples.zh: 潮水在平坦的沙滩上不知不觉地上涨。

meaning: v. 举行示威游行（或集会）( demonstrate的过去式和过去分词 ); 示范。展示; 显示; 论证

examples.en: She demonstrated the new app to the whole marketing team.
examples.zh: 她向整个营销团队演示了新应用。

meaning: adv. 偶然地, 随意地；杂乱地

examples.en: The books were stacked haphazardly across the dorm room floor.
examples.zh: 书本乱七八糟地堆在宿舍的地板上。

meaning: a. 绅士的, 绅士派头的

examples.en: He gave a gentlemanly nod and opened the heavy door.
examples.zh: 他绅士地点头示意，拉开了沉重的门。

meaning: n. 乘公交车上下班；经常往来

examples.en: Commuting by bike keeps her fit despite the office job.
examples.zh: 尽管坐办公室，骑车通勤让她保持健康。

meaning: adv. 使人尴尬地, 使人为难地, 使人难堪地

examples.en: It was embarrassingly quiet after his joke fell flat.
examples.zh: 他的笑话冷场后，气氛尴尬得要命。

meaning: a. 有报导价值的

examples.en: The editor doubted the local bake sale was newsworthy enough.
examples.zh: 编辑怀疑当地烘焙义卖是否算得上新闻。

meaning: n. 喧闹游玩, 顽皮女孩;vi. 喧闹玩耍, 轻快奔跑

examples.en: The puppies had a playful romp across the autumn leaves.
examples.zh: 小狗们在落叶上撒欢打闹。

meaning: a. 可接近的, 可亲近的;可接近的, 可进入的, 可亲近的

examples.en: Our new professor is approachable and answers every question patiently.
examples.zh: 新教授平易近人，耐心解答每个问题。

meaning: adv. 友善地

examples.en: The former business partners settled the dispute amicably over coffee.
examples.zh: 昔日合伙人喝着咖啡，友好地解决了纠纷。

meaning: n. 坩锅, 严酷的考验;坩埚

examples.en: The startup's first year was a crucible for the founders.
examples.zh: 初创公司的第一年是对创始人的严酷考验。

meaning: adv. 可靠地, 真正地

examples.en: The small bistro cooks authentically French country food.
examples.zh: 这家小馆子做的是地道的法式乡村菜。

meaning: n. 协变量, 相关变量

examples.en: The model adjusted for age as a key covariate.
examples.zh: 该模型把年龄作为关键协变量加以调整。

meaning: a. 热的, 热量的, (热)卡的;热的

examples.en: The app tracks the caloric content of every meal.
examples.zh: 这个应用记录每一餐的热量含量。

meaning: a. 带淡红色的, 比较激进的

examples.en: They made a pinky promise to meet every summer.
examples.zh: 他们拉钩约定每年夏天见一面。

meaning: a. 不加批判的, 无批判力的

examples.en: An uncritical acceptance of online advice can be risky.
examples.zh: 不加分辨地相信网络建议可能有风险。

meaning: n. 吝啬；卑鄙；劣等

examples.en: There was no meanness in her joke, only warmth.
examples.zh: 她的玩笑没有恶意，只有温暖。

meaning: n. 端点；末端, 终结点

examples.en: The bridge's northern endpoint connects directly to the bike trail.
examples.zh: 大桥北端直接连着自行车道。

meaning: a. 现象学的, 现象论的

examples.en: The course introduces phenomenological methods through everyday experience exercises.
examples.zh: 这门课通过日常体验练习介绍现象学方法。

meaning: vt. 抢先占领, 使全神贯注

examples.en: Final exams preoccupy every student during the month of June.
examples.zh: 六月的期末考试占据了每个学生的心思。

meaning: n. 留下阴影, 描影法, 明暗法, 细微变化;底纹

examples.en: The artist added careful shading to the portrait's background.
examples.zh: 画家给肖像的背景添上了细致的明暗。

meaning: n. 鸡奸, 兽奸;鸡奸, 兽奸, 猥亵行为

examples.en: The court struck down the old sodomy law decades ago.
examples.zh: 法院几十年前废除了那条关于鸡奸的旧法律。

meaning: v. 互相编织

examples.en: Local food and folk music are deeply interwoven in this region.
examples.zh: 在这个地区，美食与民间音乐紧密交织。

meaning: n. 生产, 生殖;生殖, 生育

examples.en: The biology lecture discussed reproduction and procreation in mammals.
examples.zh: 生物课讨论了哺乳动物的繁殖与生育。

meaning: n. 动脉瘤;动脉瘤

examples.en: The scan revealed a small aneurysm that needed monitoring.
examples.zh: 扫描发现一个小动脉瘤，需要持续监测。

meaning: a. 不实的, 不义的, 不忠的

examples.en: It was disloyal of him to share the team's plans.
examples.zh: 他泄露团队计划是一种不忠的行为。

meaning: adv. 教育地, 教育上地, 有关教育地

examples.en: The museum is educationally valuable yet fun for young kids.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆既有教育价值，对小孩也很有趣。

meaning: n. 保护者, 管理员, 管理委员;保护人

examples.en: The painting's conservator repaired the torn canvas with tiny strokes.
examples.zh: 文物修复师用细小的笔触修复了破损的画布。

meaning: n. 空运, 空中补给线, 空运物资;vt. 空运

examples.en: The army organized an airlift of food to the flooded villages.
examples.zh: 军方组织向被淹村庄空运食品。

meaning: n. 推者, 推销员;推料机

examples.en: The film cast him as a street pusher in the city.
examples.zh: 影片让他饰演城里的街头毒贩。

meaning: n. 自助洗衣店, 自动洗衣店

examples.en: She reads novels at the laundromat while her clothes dry.
examples.zh: 她在自助洗衣店边等衣服烘干边看小说。

meaning: int. 极好的；妙的；美味的

examples.en: Yum, this warm cinnamon roll tastes absolutely delicious.
examples.zh: 真好吃，这个热肉桂卷美味极了。

meaning: n. 尿壶, 小便处;尿壶, 贮尿器

examples.en: The bar's tiny bathroom had one sink and one urinal.
examples.zh: 酒吧的小卫生间里有一个洗手池和小便池。

meaning: a. 无敌的, 无与伦比的

examples.en: The food cart's three dollar breakfast taco deal is unbeatable.
examples.zh: 这家餐车三美元的早餐塔可划算得无可匹敌。

meaning: n. 抚慰, 缓解, 平息, 姑息;缓和:缓静, 安抚

examples.en: Historians still debate the appeasement policy of the 1930s.
examples.zh: 历史学家仍在争论二十世纪三十年代的绥靖政策。

meaning: a. 违反直觉的

examples.en: It seems counterintuitive, but walking relieves tired legs.
examples.zh: 听着违反直觉，但走路反而能缓解腿部疲劳。

meaning: n. 化妆用品, 梳妆用具, 化妆用具;化妆用品

examples.en: The hotel provides a small toiletry kit for every guest.
examples.zh: 酒店为每位客人提供一个小洗漱包。

meaning: n. 刺盖太阳鱼属(Pomoxis)鱼

examples.en: The boys fried the crappie they caught at dawn.
examples.zh: 男孩们把清晨钓到的太阳鱼煎了吃。

meaning: n. 可责, 有罪性, 有过失

examples.en: The inquiry cleared the driver of any culpability in the crash.
examples.zh: 调查认定司机对车祸不负任何责任。

meaning: n. 直道;a. 直线行进的, 通俗易懂的, 立刻的

examples.en: The race's long straightaway favors the strongest cyclists.
examples.zh: 比赛的长直道对力量型车手有利。

meaning: n. 糖果, 五彩纸屑

examples.en: Colorful confetti rained over the winning team at midfield.
examples.zh: 五彩纸屑落在场地中央获胜球队的身上。

meaning: v. 停止；停下来（stop的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: The bus stopped suddenly, and everyone grabbed the handrails.
examples.zh: 公交车猛地停下，大家赶紧抓住扶手。

meaning: vt. 包上外壳, 镶嵌外层;vi. 结壳

examples.en: Salt crystals encrust the rocks along the shrinking shoreline.
examples.zh: 盐晶在日渐缩小的湖岸岩石上结壳。

meaning: v. 重新发动, 重新发射;n. 再下水, 再发射; 重整旗鼓, 重新开业; （商品等的）重新投放市场; 重新推向公众, 重新开张

examples.en: The company will relaunch the soda brand with new packaging.
examples.zh: 公司将以新包装重新推出这个汽水品牌。

meaning: vt. 对...采取卫生措施, 消毒, 使无害;卫生处理

examples.en: Staff sanitize the gym equipment every two hours.
examples.zh: 员工每两小时给健身器材消毒一次。

meaning: adv. 懊悔地, 抱歉地

examples.en: We regretfully declined the invitation because of the scheduling conflict.
examples.zh: 因日程冲突，我们遗憾地婉拒了邀请。

meaning: n. 象甲;象鼻虫(米麦仓虫)

examples.en: A weevil had tunneled into the sack of stored flour.
examples.zh: 一只象鼻虫钻进了存放的面粉袋里。

meaning: n. 保留条款, 遁辞, 保护手段, 齐射, 齐鸣;保留条款, 但书, 托辞

examples.en: The editorial's headline fired the first salvo in the debate.
examples.zh: 那篇社论的标题打响了这场辩论的第一枪。

meaning: int. 您好(招呼用语)

examples.en: The cowboy greeted us with a cheerful howdy at the gate.
examples.zh: 牛仔在大门口热情地向我们问好。

meaning: a. 无光泽的, 无生气的;n. 无光泽, 无生气

examples.en: The team's lacklustre first half worried the home fans.
examples.zh: 球队上半场表现平平，主场球迷很担心。

meaning: a. 湿粘的, 病态的

examples.en: His palms were clammy before the job interview began.
examples.zh: 面试开始前，他的手心又湿又黏。

meaning: n. 花花公子, 乖巧的人

examples.en: In the movie, the playboy reforms and opens a bakery.
examples.zh: 影片中，那个花花公子改过自新，开了家面包店。

meaning: n. 锯木厂, 锯木机

examples.en: The old sawmill beside the river is now a museum.
examples.zh: 河边的那座老锯木厂现在成了博物馆。

meaning: a. 抛踢球得分的

examples.en: I dropped my phone and cracked the screen badly.
examples.zh: 手机掉在地上，屏幕摔得稀碎。

meaning: n. 四头肌;四头肌, 四头的

examples.en: Squats and lunges strengthen the quadriceps over time.
examples.zh: 深蹲和弓步能逐渐强化股四头肌。

meaning: v. 鄙视, 看不起某人（某事）( despise的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The corrupt official was despised by the entire village.
examples.zh: 那个贪官受到全村人的鄙视。

meaning: a. 愁闷的, 阴沉的

examples.en: Why so glum on such a beautiful sunny morning?
examples.zh: 这么好的晴天早晨，怎么闷闷不乐？

meaning: n. 赋与生气者, 鼓舞者, 漫画制作者

examples.en: The animator spent weeks drawing each character's expressions by hand.
examples.zh: 动画师花了数周手绘每个角色的表情。

meaning: adv. 任何时候；无例外地

examples.en: Call me anytime you need help with the move.
examples.zh: 搬家需要帮忙，随时打给我。

meaning: n. 圆形建筑, 圆形大厅

examples.en: Students gathered in the Capitol rotunda for the photography exhibit.
examples.zh: 学生们聚集在国会大厦圆形大厅参观摄影展。

meaning: n. 什一税, 十分之一, 小部分;vt. 课什一税

examples.en: Farmers once paid a tithe of their harvest to the church.
examples.zh: 农民曾将收成的十分之一作为什一税上交教会。

meaning: 全息的

examples.en: The exhibition ends with a stunning holographic display of whales.
examples.zh: 展览以震撼的鲸鱼全息展示收尾。

meaning: n. 屈尊, 傲慢态度

examples.en: The waiter's tone carried a hint of condescension.
examples.zh: 服务员的语气里带着一丝居高临下。

meaning: 加法器, 运算器, 声频;金(79号元素)

examples.en: Au is the chemical symbol for gold on the periodic table.
examples.zh: Au 是元素周期表中金的化学符号。

meaning: a. 教会(机构)的

examples.en: The council debated ecclesial matters for three long days.
examples.zh: 会议就教会事务辩论了整整三天。

meaning: n. 修理工

examples.en: The repairman fixed the washing machine in under an hour.
examples.zh: 修理工不到一小时就修好了洗衣机。

meaning: n. 汗衫

examples.en: Dad wore a white undershirt while mowing the lawn.
examples.zh: 爸爸修剪草坪时穿着白色汗衫。

meaning: 生物燃料

examples.en: The airport buses run on biofuel made from cooking oil.
examples.zh: 机场大巴使用食用油制成的生物燃料。

meaning: a. 无特定结构的, 非系统组成的

examples.en: The interview was unstructured, feeling more like a friendly chat.
examples.zh: 这场面试没有固定流程，更像轻松的聊天。

meaning: n. 出身, 血统, 门第, 起源;来历, 出身, 家系

examples.en: The prince's mixed parentage was rare in the royal court.
examples.zh: 王子的混血出身在王室中很罕见。

meaning: n. 混血儿

examples.en: The festival celebrates the mestizo heritage of the mountain town.
examples.zh: 这个节日庆祝山城的混血文化遗产。

meaning: adv. 狡猾地, 秘密地, 俏皮地, 偷偷地

examples.en: The cat watched slyly from atop the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 猫在书架顶上狡黠地望着。

meaning: a. 易于连接的, 连接的;n. 连接物, 关联词

examples.en: In grammar class, we practiced the connective 'however' in essays.
examples.zh: 语法课上，我们练习在作文中使用连接词。

meaning: vi.vt. (使)结晶, (使)定形, 明朗化, (使)具体化;vt. 给裹上糖屑

examples.en: The discussion helped crystallise our plans for the spring trip.
examples.zh: 这次讨论让我们的春游计划明确下来。

meaning: n. 声学, 基础语音教学法

examples.en: The first graders practice phonics for twenty minutes each morning.
examples.zh: 一年级学生每天早上练二十分钟自然拼读。

meaning: n. 审计官;主计, 会计师, 审计

examples.en: The city comptroller reviewed every line of the festival budget.
examples.zh: 市审计官审查了节日预算的每一项。

meaning: n. 哈瓦那, 哈瓦那雪茄烟

examples.en: He brought back Havana cigars from his Cuban business trip.
examples.zh: 他从古巴出差带回了哈瓦那雪茄。

meaning: a. 幼虫的, 幼虫状态的;幼虫的, 蚴的, 隐蔽的, 潜在的

examples.en: Students observed larval frogs swimming in the pond water sample.
examples.zh: 学生们观察池塘水样中游动的幼体青蛙。

meaning: n. 柑橘

examples.en: She packed a tangerine and some crackers for the train ride.
examples.zh: 她为火车旅行装了一个柑橘和几块饼干。

meaning: n. 咯吱声, 挤扁;vt. 把...挤扁, 压扁

examples.en: Don't squish the spider, just take it outside.
examples.zh: 别拍死那只蜘蛛，把它放到外面去。

meaning: a. 不受禁令约束的, 不受拘束的, 自由自在的, 随心所欲的, 大吵大闹的;不受禁令约束的, 无拘束的

examples.en: The toddlers danced with uninhibited joy at the birthday party.
examples.zh: 孩子们在生日派对上无拘无束地欢快跳舞。

meaning: a. 报复的;报复性的

examples.en: The union threatened retaliatory strikes after the sudden wage cuts.
examples.zh: 突然减薪后，工会威胁进行报复性罢工。

meaning: a. 无关系的, 无隶属的, 独立的, 未婚的, 未被查封的, 未任命的, 不连接的;未被逮捕的, 未被扣押的, 未订婚的

examples.en: The cottage is unattached, so we hear no neighbors at all.
examples.zh: 小屋是独立式的，完全听不到邻居的动静。

meaning: n. 吟游诗人

examples.en: A medieval minstrel entertained the crowd with lute songs.
examples.zh: 一位中世纪吟游诗人用鲁特琴歌声娱悦众人。

meaning: a. 极神圣的

examples.en: Sunday family dinner is sacrosanct in my grandmother's house.
examples.zh: 在奶奶家，周日家庭晚餐神圣不可改动。

meaning: n. 辅助练习册, 工作规程书, 工作记事簿, 笔记本, 工作手册;工作簿

examples.en: Finish pages twelve through fifteen in your math workbook tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚完成数学练习册第十二到十五页。

meaning: v. 颠倒, 倒放

examples.en: A sudden wave managed to upend the small kayak.
examples.zh: 一个突然的浪头把小皮划艇掀翻了。

meaning: n. 不忠实, 不忠行为, 不义

examples.en: The captain called leaking private chats an act of disloyalty.
examples.zh: 队长称外传私下聊天属于不忠行为。

meaning: n. 操作者, 机械手;机械手

examples.en: The magician is a master manipulator of audience attention.
examples.zh: 那位魔术师是操控观众注意力的大师。

meaning: a. 全神贯注的, 一心一意的;被吸收的

examples.en: She was so absorbed in the novel that she missed her stop.
examples.zh: 她看小说太入迷，结果坐过了站。

meaning: a. 害怕同性恋的

examples.en: The league fined the player for homophobic slurs on the pitch.
examples.zh: 联盟因球员在场上发表恐同言论而罚款。

meaning: a. 昂贵的, 价格高的

examples.en: The pricy seaside hotel was fully booked all summer.
examples.zh: 那家昂贵的海滨酒店整个夏天都订满了。

meaning: n. 英国约克郡人

examples.en: The friendly Yorkshireman insisted on paying for our teas.
examples.zh: 那位友善的约克郡人坚持替我们付了茶钱。

meaning: n. 干草堆

examples.en: The children hid behind a golden haystack near the barn.
examples.zh: 孩子们藏在谷仓旁金黄的干草堆后面。

meaning: adv. 枉然地, 无益地, 徒然

examples.en: She searched vainly for her lost glove on the train.
examples.zh: 她在火车上徒劳地寻找丢失的手套。

meaning: n. 矛盾修饰法, 逆喻

examples.en: The phrase 'deafening silence' is a classic oxymoron.
examples.zh: 震耳欲聋的寂静是经典的矛盾修辞。

meaning: a. 未经区分的, 未被注意到的, 普通的, 平凡的

examples.en: His undistinguished college record hid a brilliant, curious mind.
examples.zh: 他平平无奇的大学成绩背后藏着出色的头脑。

meaning: n. 弓射手, 持弓的兵, 船首的划手

examples.en: Each bowman kept three arrows ready during the archery contest.
examples.zh: 射箭比赛中，每位弓箭手都备好三支箭。

meaning: adv. 出其不意地, 没想到, 不料, 不知不觉地

examples.en: The April shower caught us unawares without umbrellas.
examples.zh: 四月的阵雨突然袭来，我们没带伞。

meaning: a. 有帮助的, 有用的, 奉承的

examples.en: The old film shows servants subservient to their strict master.
examples.zh: 老电影里的仆人对严厉的主人唯命是从。

meaning: 解折叠; 开折; 伸展

examples.en: We watched the drama unfolding outside our apartment window.
examples.zh: 我们看着窗外的戏剧性事件逐步展开。

meaning: a. 不聚成焦点的

examples.en: His unfocused essay wandered from topic to topic.
examples.zh: 他那篇主题涣散的文章东拉西扯。

meaning: n. 泡, 泡沫, 琐物;vt. 使生泡沫

examples.en: The barista spooned thick froth onto the hot chocolate.
examples.zh: 咖啡师在热巧克力上舀了厚厚一层奶泡。

meaning: 变换器, 转换器, 转接开关;兑换店

examples.en: The tire changer at the garage works remarkably fast.
examples.zh: 修理厂的换胎师傅动作特别快。

meaning: a. 兴高采烈的, 狂喜的, 欢天喜地的

examples.en: The pianist received rapturous applause from the packed concert hall.
examples.zh: 钢琴家收获了全场观众热烈的掌声。

meaning: v. 作为…的动机, 激发, 诱发( motivate的现在分词 )

examples.en: Clear goals are motivating for students during long projects.
examples.zh: 明确的目标能激励学生完成长期项目。

meaning: vt. 宣传, 宣扬；公布, 颂

examples.en: The charity walk was widely publicised across local radio stations.
examples.zh: 慈善健走活动在当地电台广为宣传。

meaning: n. 后面打光；背光式

examples.en: The backlit keyboard makes typing in the dark much easier.
examples.zh: 背光键盘让摸黑打字容易多了。

meaning: n. 司令官

examples.en: The academy's commandant inspected the cadets' neat dormitory rows.
examples.zh: 军校司令检阅了学员整齐的宿舍。

meaning: n. 战俘

examples.en: The museum displays letters written by a POW in 1943.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一九四三年一名战俘写的信。

meaning: a. 似胎儿的, 胎儿的

examples.en: The scan shows the foetal heartbeat at twelve weeks.
examples.zh: 扫描显示十二周时的胎儿心跳。

meaning: n. 焦头烂额；烧焦, 烤焦

examples.en: The scorched toast set off the kitchen smoke alarm.
examples.zh: 烤糊的吐司触发了厨房的烟雾报警器。

meaning: n. 诅咒, 坏话, 家伙;v. 诅咒, 咒骂

examples.en: Grandpa never cusses, but the hammer changed that today.
examples.zh: 爷爷从不骂脏话，但今天那把锤子让他破例了。

meaning: a. 笑剧的, 滑稽的, 笑剧性的

examples.en: The trial scene in the play is deliberately farcical.
examples.zh: 剧中的庭审一幕故意拍得滑稽荒诞。

meaning: n. 可收集的, 可代收的( collectible的名词复数 )

examples.en: His basement holds boxes of comic collectibles from the sixties.
examples.zh: 他家地下室装满了六十年代的漫画收藏品。

meaning: adv. 动摇地；令人不安地

examples.en: The documentary showed disturbingly high plastic levels in the river.
examples.zh: 纪录片显示河水中的塑料含量高得吓人。

meaning: n. 公开性; 公开化

examples.en: The history class discussed glasnost and its era of openness.
examples.zh: 历史课讨论了公开性政策及其开放年代。

meaning: n. 精英主义

examples.en: Critics accused the private club of pure elitism.
examples.zh: 批评者指责那家私人俱乐部纯粹搞精英主义。

meaning: n. 动物的胸部, 动物的胸肉

examples.en: Dad smoked a beef brisket low and slow overnight.
examples.zh: 爸爸把牛胸肉低温慢熏了一整夜。

meaning: n. 商业主义, 商业精神, 利润第一主义, 商业习惯, 商业用语;商业主义, 利润第一主义, 商业精神

examples.en: Some fans feel commercialism has changed the Olympics forever.
examples.zh: 一些观众觉得商业主义永远改变了奥运会。

meaning: n. 漂流者, 漂流物, 漂网渔船

examples.en: The drifter moved through town, fixing fences for warm meals.
examples.zh: 那个流浪汉走村串镇，修栅栏换热饭。

meaning: adv. 能干地, 精明强干地

examples.en: She ably managed the store during the manager's long illness.
examples.zh: 经理长期生病期间，她把店铺管理得井井有条。

meaning: a. 亲社会的,忠实(或拘泥)于既定社会道德准则的

examples.en: Teachers praised the class for its prosocial behavior during recess.
examples.zh: 老师表扬了全班课间的亲社会行为。

meaning: a. 包括在内;包含的

examples.en: The tour price included lunch and museum entrance tickets.
examples.zh: 这次的旅行费用包含午餐和博物馆门票。

meaning: a. 不受怀疑的, 无嫌疑的, 未知的, 意料外的;未被怀疑的, 无嫌疑的

examples.en: An unsuspected talent for singing emerged at the office party.
examples.zh: 办公室派对上冒出了意想不到的歌唱才华。

meaning: n. 芫荽;芫荽, 胡荽

examples.en: She sprinkled fresh coriander over the steaming noodle bowl.
examples.zh: 她在热气腾腾的面条上撒了新鲜香菜。

meaning: n. 产科学;产科学

examples.en: She completed her obstetrics training at the women's hospital.
examples.zh: 她在妇产医院完成了产科培训。

meaning: a. 怀恨的, 怀有恶意的, 恶意的

examples.en: Spreading those rumors was a spiteful thing to do.
examples.zh: 散布那些谣言是一种心怀恶意的行为。

meaning: n. 现世主义者, 宗教与教育分离论者

examples.en: The writer is a firm secularist in education debates.
examples.zh: 这位作家在教育争论中是坚定的世俗主义者。

meaning: 软化处理

examples.en: Softening the butter first makes the cake batter smoother.
examples.zh: 先把黄油软化，蛋糕面糊会更顺滑。

meaning: n. 内脏

examples.en: The mechanic showed us the rusty innards of the engine.
examples.zh: 修车工给我们看了发动机生锈的内部。

meaning: vt. 给...安排新房子, 给...安排好房屋

examples.en: The council promised to rehouse the families before winter.
examples.zh: 市政会承诺在冬天前给这些家庭安排新居。

meaning: n. (赛马用的)马

examples.en: The retired racehorse now gives gentle rides to children.
examples.zh: 退役的赛马现在温顺地让孩子们骑乘。

meaning: a. 未洗的, 不洁的, 平民百姓的

examples.en: The unwashed dishes piled up during finals week.
examples.zh: 考试周期间，没洗的碗越堆越多。

meaning: adv. 倔强地

examples.en: He perversely refused the help that everyone kindly offered.
examples.zh: 别人好心帮忙，他却执拗地拒绝了。

meaning: 缩小性

examples.en: The narrowing mountain road forced us to slow down.
examples.zh: 越来越窄的山路让我们放慢了车速。

meaning: a. 精神分裂症的;精神分裂症的, 精神分裂症患者

examples.en: The clinic supports patients with schizophrenic disorders and their families.
examples.zh: 该诊所帮助精神分裂症患者及其家人。

meaning: n. 甲醇;甲醇

examples.en: The lab labels methanol bottles with bright warning stickers.
examples.zh: 实验室给甲醇瓶贴上醒目的警示标签。

meaning: a. 有可能, 或有条件完成的;v. 使能够, 提供做…的权利( enable的现在分词 ); 使可能

examples.en: The new bus route is enabling more students to commute.
examples.zh: 新开的公交线路让更多学生得以通勤。

meaning: n. mentoring是一种工作关系。mentor通常是处在比mentee更高工作职位上的有影响力的人。他/她有比‘mentee’更丰富的工作经验和知识, 并

examples.en: Senior staff offer mentoring to every new employee each fall.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，资深员工为每位新员工提供指导。

meaning: n. 武装直升机

examples.en: The museum's gunship display includes a restored attack helicopter.
examples.zh: 博物馆的武装直升机展区有一架修复的攻击直升机。

meaning: vt. 剥夺, 使失去, 逐出;抢夺, 霸占, 剥夺

examples.en: The ruling could dispossess hundreds of families from their farms.
examples.zh: 这项裁决可能让数百个家庭失去农场。

meaning: n. 厕所;坑厕, 沟厕

examples.en: Soldiers dug a latrine behind the temporary training camp.
examples.zh: 士兵在临时训练营后面挖了坑厕。

meaning: 假言的;方式, 方法

examples.en: Checking locks twice is the cleaner's modus operandi here.
examples.zh: 把锁检查两遍是这位清洁工的固定做法。

meaning: n. 有盖货车;转换盒

examples.en: The old boxcar now serves as the farm's storage shed.
examples.zh: 那节旧棚车现在成了农场的储物棚。

meaning: n. 平静, 寂静

examples.en: The quietness of the library helped her finish the chapter.
examples.zh: 图书馆的安静让她顺利读完了那一章。

meaning: n. 出纳员, 军需官;出纳员, 军需机

examples.en: The city council acts as paymaster for the summer festival.
examples.zh: 市政会负责为夏季艺术节支付款项。

meaning: n. 鞋带, 小额资本

examples.en: They started the bakery on a shoestring and lots of hope.
examples.zh: 他们靠微薄的资金和满腔希望开起了面包店。

meaning: a. 北方的, 向北的, 来自北方的;adv. 向北, 自北来

examples.en: A cold northerly wind pushed the sailboat off course.
examples.zh: 一股寒冷的北风把帆船吹离了航线。

meaning: n. 海滨地区;a. 靠海滨的

examples.en: They rented a small beachfront cottage for the week.
examples.zh: 他们租了一周的海滨小屋。

meaning: 暗色化

examples.en: We hurried home under the darkening evening sky.
examples.zh: 天色渐暗，我们急忙往家赶。

meaning: 大理石的, 用大理石装饰或建造的

examples.en: The hotel lobby has a beautiful marbled floor in grey and cream.
examples.zh: 酒店大堂铺着漂亮的灰白相间大理石地板。

meaning: a. (疼痛)剧烈而突然的

examples.en: She felt a stabbing pain in her shoulder after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛后她感到肩膀一阵刺痛。

meaning: n. 非正式

examples.en: The restaurant's informality makes it popular with young families.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅氛围轻松,很受年轻家庭欢迎。

meaning: n. 炉边, 家庭, 家庭生活;a. 在火炉边的, 非正式的

examples.en: Grandfather told stories by the fireside on winter nights.
examples.zh: 冬夜里,祖父在炉边讲故事。

meaning: n. 管理者的职位

examples.en: She declined a directorship to spend more time with her kids.
examples.zh: 她拒绝了董事职位,想多陪陪孩子。

meaning: vi. 停止, 控制, 断念

examples.en: The court ordered the company to desist from false advertising.
examples.zh: 法院命令该公司停止虚假广告。

meaning: n. 风向标, 风信旗, 变化不定的事物;轮叶, 叶

examples.en: The weather vane spun wildly during last night's storm.
examples.zh: 昨晚暴风雨中,风向标疯狂旋转。

meaning: n. 叮当声;vi. 发叮当声, 发铿锵声

examples.en: The guard's keys made a loud clank against the metal door.
examples.zh: 狱警的钥匙撞在铁门上,当啷作响。

meaning: 福克斯通(英国肯特郡东部港市)

examples.en: We took the early train from Folkestone to London.
examples.zh: 我们乘早班火车从福克斯通去伦敦。

meaning: 布伦(即滨海市洛涅)

examples.en: They spent a sunny afternoon by the old port in Boulogne.
examples.zh: 他们在布伦老港口边度过了阳光明媚的下午。

meaning: n. 一绺头发, 头发, 发辫

examples.en: A loose tress of hair kept falling across her face.
examples.zh: 一绺松散的头发总垂到她脸上。

meaning: n. 中间人;调解人, 中间人, 中人

examples.en: Farmers sell online now, cutting out the middleman.
examples.zh: 农民现在网上直销,省去了中间人。

meaning: a. 充血的

examples.en: His bloodshot eyes showed he had barely slept.
examples.zh: 他双眼充血,显然几乎没睡。

meaning: n. （早餐营养食品）格兰诺拉燕麦卷

examples.en: She sprinkles granola over yogurt and fresh berries.
examples.zh: 她在酸奶和新鲜浆果上撒格兰诺拉燕麦。

meaning: 出露地表; 矿苗

examples.en: We ate our sandwiches on a granite outcropping above the lake.
examples.zh: 我们坐在湖边花岗岩露岩上吃三明治。

meaning: n. 萨克斯管吹奏者

examples.en: A street saxophonist played outside the cafe all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午,一位街头萨克斯手在咖啡馆外演奏。

meaning: v. 保持( retain的过去式和过去分词 ); 拦住; 保存; 止住

examples.en: She retained her chess championship for a third straight year.
examples.zh: 她连续第三年保住了国际象棋冠军头衔。

meaning: 负债, 债务

examples.en: The report highlights the students' growing indebtedness.
examples.zh: 报告强调了学生日益加重的债务负担。

meaning: vt. 乞讨, 搜寻;vi. 东张西望, 搜寻, 乞讨

examples.en: He tried to scrounge a free lunch from his classmates.
examples.zh: 他想从同学那里蹭一顿免费午餐。

meaning: a. 不同文化间的

examples.en: The summer camp hosts intercultural exchanges for teenagers.
